title: 2027 Academy Engineer Apprentice - Level 5  Higher Level Apprenticeship - Mechatronic Engineering
description:
Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

2027 Academy Engineer Apprentice - Level 5

Higher Level Apprenticeship - Mechatronic Engineering

Start Date: 6 September 2027

Salary: £24,000 per annum

Employee type: Permanent

Location: Belfast (must be a resident of Northern Ireland for the past 5 years)

Working Schedule: Monday – Thursday 0800-1645, Friday 0800-1200 (flexible working available)

Turn your curiosity into a career. If you're passionate about engineering, eager to learn, and looking for an apprenticeship that combines academic study with exciting on-the-job experience, we'd love to hear from you. Our Mechatronics apprenticeship will let you explore different types of engineering before you make an informed decision to specialise in relevant disciple of engineering.

Benefits of the programme:

- Earn a salary while studying for your apprenticeship
- Gain hands-on experience in a real engineering environment
- Receive job-specific training and development
- Achieve a recognised engineering qualification

- Tuition fees for approved training providers are fully covered

- Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship

About the Role

As an Engineering Apprentice, you’ll be learning and building real mechatronic engineering skills - This will help you can grow into a confident, positive, and flexible engineer. You’ll develop a strong technical base and get the chance to work on challenging engineering problems as part of a supportive team.

Mechatronics is where mechanical engineering, electronics, and software come together - so you’ll learn how to think through design, how to create solutions, and how technology helps make systems work automatically.

In this role, you’ll help the team deliver solutions to meet deadlines, quality expectations, and budget. You’ll learn how good engineering decisions are made - balancing performance, cost, and manufacturability all while working with different parts of the business.

How this helps you grow:

- Build practical, transferable engineering skills: you won’t just learn theory - you’ll learn how designs are made ready for real-world production.
- Become more confident in engineering problem-solving: you’ll work with guidance, but you’ll also learn how to break down challenges and find solutions.
- Understand how engineering decisions are made: you’ll see how cost, quality, and performance trade-offs come into the design process.
- Learn through teamwork: you’ll collaborate with people from different disciplines and begin building professional communication skills.

What You Will Learn

- How our business works, especially across Engineering, including software, hardware, and systems
- Engineering and the wider business, together - you’ll be exposed to other functions outside Engineering, so you fully understand how we’re set up and how decisions get made
- Learning from the people who make it all happen - you’ll work with key stakeholders across the business, alongside experienced, long-tenured experts and our leadership teams
- Building your network - you’ll join a large community of future talent (including apprentices, graduates, and interns), helping you grow through connections and shared learning
- Growing your capability through rotation - you’ll develop through a designed pathway with internal rotational programmes, ensuring you get the right experience in the right teams

Apprenticeship Programme

You will be studying towards a Level 5 Higher Level Apprenticeship, Foundation Engineering Degree (FdEng) in Mechatronics with our partners at the South Eastern Regional College in Bangor. During the 3 year programme you will follow an initial rotation plan and then specialise in a particular engineering function.

You will be given 1 day per week to attend college lessons, lectures and tutorials on campus. The other 4 days you will be working in engineering departments, embedding your college learning in a real-life engineering environment.

On successful completion of the Higher-Level Apprenticeship, there will be scope to progress onto the BEng in Mechatronic Engineering at Ulster University.

Entry Requirements

· 56 UCAS tariff points including: A Levels (A2): Typical grade profile CC (to include 1 from Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Design & Technology, Engineering, Electronics or Double Award Science/Applied Science)

· Or BTEC Level 3 Extended Diploma in Engineering with overall award profile MPP or Diploma in Engineering with overall award profile MM

· 5 GCSEs at grade A-C (4-9) or above including English and Maths

We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who are motivated, committed and keen to learn. You will be a self-starter, able to demonstrate time management skills, working on your own, using your initiative and have a genuine interest in Engineering and Thales. Successful candidates will show self-discipline and an aspiration to achieve a degree qualification.

Please Note: due to funding obligations (i) applicants who already hold a relevant degree will not be eligible for this programme (ii) this opportunity is available in Belfast and open to all Northern Ireland residents.

Benefits

· Competitive salary of £24,000 per annum

· Performance-related pay uplifts

· Holiday entitlement of 201 hours a year (plus a company day and bank holidays)

· Contributory Company Pension

· Health Care Cash Plan

· Hybrid/flexible working options

· Employee assistance programme

· Learning and development support

· Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives

· Life Cover

· 80 Hours Volunteering per year (first two years)

Thales Apprentice Recruitment Process

1. Apply Online - submit your application online to register your interest. You only need to register for one role as you will have the opportunity to apply for additional roles at the full application stage.

2. Upload Your CV

3. Check your emails for the invitation to apply – this will come from recruiting@jobalerts.thalesgroup.com

4. Complete Your Application – follow the link provided in the email to complete your application. You can apply for one primary role and up to 3 additional roles.

5. Complete Online Tests - undertake the online assessments designed to evaluate your suitability for the role.

6. Virtual Assessment Centre - candidates who progress from the online assessment stage will attend a virtual assessment centre, which will include group exercises, and competency-based interviews.

7. Job Offer – successful candidates who perform well throughout the recruitment process will receive a job offer from Thales.

For further information about our Future Talent recruitment process, including hints and tips, or to connect with a member of the Future Talent Team, a Graduate, or an Apprentice, please visit Thales Future Talent - Connectr.

Please note, assessment centres for shortlisted candidates will be held between February - May 2027. Induction week for all Graduate and Apprentices will take place from Monday 6 September - Friday 10 September 2027.

Closing date: Our applications will close at 11.59pm on Wednesday 17 February 2027, this is the only time we will be accepting applications this year. Please note, we will be in contact by the end of February 2027 with details of next steps.

Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.

To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.

To be eligible for SC clearance, you will typically need to have lived in the UK continuously for the last five years. As part of the vetting process, you will be asked to provide evidence of your identity, right to work in the UK, any time spent overseas during the last five years, and your employment and/or education history.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels

Combining academic study with hands-on, practical experience, it offers a fantastic opportunity to grow and thrive within a global, innovative & industry leading organisation. • Gain hands-on experience within the Bid & Project Management environment

• Receive job-specific training and development

• Achieve a recognised qualification

• Have your tuition fees fully paid

• Secure a permanent role from the start of your apprenticeship

About the Role:

Bid Management is a key and fast paced role within Thales UK – we deliver proposals to customers to win business by securing new projects which is vital to our success and growth. Bid Managers take responsibility for leading bids and work with other business functions to ensure business strategy is in line with the business goals and targets. As a Bid Management Apprentice, you will take on real responsibility and learn how to lead cross-functional teams to deliver successful bids. You will bring together the right people, information and ideas, manage activities and deadlines and help ensure our proposals demonstrate why customers should choose Thales.

You will gain experience in:

• Understanding and responding to customer requests

• Knowledge in structuring and estimating new projects

• Developing compelling and competitive proposals

• Supporting negotiations and working towards winning new contracts

• Understanding the commercial considerations behind winning business

Bid Apprentices will join a Thales UK domain bid team, you will be encouraged to contribute ideas, build relationships and take increasing ownership as your experience develops. Bid Apprentices will be supported in their learning journey, you will gain hands-on experience across the full bid lifecycle from understanding an opportunity and developing the strategy, through to coordinating and delivering the proposal, supporting negotiations and handing a successful contract over to the project delivery team. No two bids are quite the same, so you will get exposure to different bids/projects/products, customers and challenges while building valuable skills in communication, organisation, project management and business writing.

Responsibilities Include:

• Support the coordination of bids, tenders, proposals and other customer submissions

• Maintain bid plans, action trackers and submission schedules coordinating information and contributions from colleagues across different teams

• Assist with drafting, editing and formatting written responses to help ensure submissions are accurate, consistent, professional and completed on time

• Maintain bid libraries, case studies, standard responses, policies and supporting documentation

• Carry out research into customers, markets and competitors to support bid development

• Assist with preparing presentations and materials for bid reviews and customer meetings.

• Participate in bid reviews and lessons-learned sessions to identify opportunities for continuous improvement

• Develop an understanding of commercial considerations, procurement processes and how organisations win new business

• Complete the required learning and development activities associated with the apprenticeship programme

Apprenticeship Programme:

Through our apprenticeship you’ll be making the most of your talents, getting to understand the Project Management Function from the ground up; and doing so with the help of one of the biggest and best names in the industry.

You’ll receive on-the-job training tailored to work alongside your studies, giving you the hands-on experience needed to develop practical skills and knowledge.

The programme will be delivered via a virtual delivery model, combining:

• live virtual workshops

• 1-2-1 coaching calls

• Self-directed learning activities

This is a 2-year programme, working towards the Level 4 Project Manager Associate Apprenticeship standard, with our training provider, The Apprentice Academy.

Upon successful completion of your End Point Assessment, you will roll off into the Thales UK Bid and Project Management job family into a Project Planner or Project Controller role. We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who are motivated, committed and keen to learn. A self-starter who can manage their time, show initiative and have a genuine interest in bids and Thales UK. Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

2027 Supportability Engineering Graduate

Start Date: 06 September 2027

Salary: £34,000 per annum

Employee type: Permanent

Location: Cheadle

Working Schedule: 37 hours per week (8 hours Monday - Thursday, 5 hours on a Friday)

Are you passionate about engineering? Do you have an inquisitive mind? Do you want to be part of a Graduate Programme that will develop and challenge you? If so, then look no further…

What is the Engineering Development Programme?

This is a 3-year programme with the option to rotate, in Year 3, around the country across different business units experiencing different parts of an engineering lifecycle. You will be assigned to a succession of new or existing programmes where you will work with and be supported by other engineers to design and develop engineering solutions to meet the needs of our customers.

During your time on the programme, you will be under the sponsorship and guidance of the Engineering Leadership team and will follow a structured and detailed learning pathway to fast track your development within your role.

During the programme, you will:

- Complete a 3-year Graduate Development Programme which is accredited by the IET, IMechE and RAeS
- An opportunity to rotate in Year 3 or explore an external secondment with one of our Thales partners
- Complete a core training pathway focusing on transversal skills
- Develop key engineering skills, knowledge and competencies
- Work in a set location and domain for the entirety of the scheme, enabling you to fully understand how the Engineering Function operates
- Work on exciting new and existing products
- Build a professional network across the organisation

Requirements:

This is an entry-level graduate opportunity designed for individuals at the start of their professional career. We welcome applications from candidates who have completed a degree and have limited relevant professional experience.

You will have gained or be on track to achieve a bachelor’s degree in a STEM Subject in one of the following subject areas:

- Aeronautical or Aerospace Engineering
- Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering
- Mechanical Engineering
- Mathematics
- Physics
- Through Life Support Engineering or similar (typically only available as MSc, so any other Bachelors would be acceptable with this)
- Other STEM degrees will be considered (though unlikely to accept Computing/Computer Science/Software Engineering/Information Technology/AI, Machine Learning and Cybernetics etc.)

Benefits:

- Competitive salary of £34,000 per annum
- Performance-related pay uplifts
- Holiday entitlement of 201 hours a year (plus a company day and bank holidays)
- Contributory Company Pension
- Health Care Cash Plan
- Hybrid/flexible working options
- Employee assistance programme
- Learning and development support
- Employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives
- Life cover
- 80 Hours Volunteering per year (first two years)

Thales Graduate Recruitment Process:

1. Apply Online - submit your application online to register your interest. You only need to register for one role as you will have the opportunity to apply for additional roles at the full application stage.

2. Upload Your CV

3. Check your emails for the invitation to apply – this will come from recruiting@jobalerts.thalesgroup.com

4. Complete Your Application – follow the link provided in the email to complete your application. You can apply for one primary role and up to 3 additional roles.

5. Complete Online Tests - undertake the online assessments designed to evaluate your suitability for the role.

6. Video Interview - if successful in the online testing stage, you will be invited to complete a video interview.

7. Virtual Assessment Centre - candidates who progress from the video interview stage will attend a virtual assessment centre, which may include presentations, group exercises, and competency-based interviews.

8. Job Offer – successful candidates who perform well throughout the recruitment process will receive a job offer from Thales.

For further information about our Future Talent recruitment process, including hints and tips, or to connect with a member of the Future Talent Team, a Graduate, or an Apprentice, please visit Thales Future Talent - Connectr.

Please note, assessment centres for shortlisted candidates will be held between February - May 2027. Induction week for all Graduate and Apprentices will take place from Monday 6 September - Friday 10 September 2027.

Closing date: Our applications will close at 11.59pm on Wednesday 6 January 2027, this is the only time we will be accepting applications this year. Please note, we will be in contact by the end of February 2027 with details of next steps.

Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements.

To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.

To be eligible for SC clearance, you will typically need to have lived in the UK continuously for the last five years. As part of the vetting process, you will be asked to provide evidence of your identity, right to work in the UK, any time spent overseas during the last five years, and your employment and/or education history.

In addition, this role supports a UK Eyes Only programme and is therefore subject to government-mandated nationality restrictions. To satisfy the security clearance requirements for access to highly sensitive information, applicants must have been British citizens from birth and must not hold any other nationality. This requirement is determined by the UK Government and is a condition of programme access rather than an employment preference.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for security clearance please follow this link - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Thales is an equal opportunities employer, and diversity and inclusion are integral to the success of Thales.

At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

As an Engineering (IVVQ) Apprentice, you'll work within the Underwater Systems Sonar business, gaining hands-on experience with one of the leading companies in the industry.

Your role will be to support the integration and testing of sonar systems throughout different stages of projects. You'll help make sure both hardware and software products work correctly and meet the required standards before they are delivered to customers.

You'll be involved in:

- Supporting the integration, validation, verification and qualification (IVVQ) of systems.
- Conducting testing activities throughout the project lifecycle.
- Following guidance from Lead Engineers and IVVQ Managers.
- Helping prepare systems for customer acceptance and final delivery.
- Using a range of specialist tools, equipment and diagnostic technology.
- Checking that components, assemblies and complete systems meet technical specifications.
- Becoming an important member of a highly skilled engineering team.

What You Will Learn

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll develop both technical knowledge and practical engineering skills.

You will learn:

- How to integrate and test complex engineering systems.
- The principles of Validation, Verification and Qualification (IVVQ).
- How to use specialist measuring, testing and diagnostic equipment.
- Problem-solving and fault-finding techniques.
- How engineering projects are delivered from development through to customer acceptance.
- Industry-standard engineering processes and best practices.
- How to work effectively within a professional engineering team.

Apprenticeship Programme

As an Engineering (IVVQ) Apprentice, you will:

- Work towards a Level 3 Mechatronics Maintenance Technician Apprenticeship
- Complete a 3-year apprenticeship programme
- Spend one day per week at a local college studying towards the apprenticeship, with four days working within the business, gaining practical experience
- Apply what you learn in college to real engineering projects and activities
- Develop valuable skills and knowledge while working alongside experienced engineers
- Gain broad experience across different areas of the engineering industry

title: ADATS Technical Training Manager
description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – driving this technology are our people.

We’re a trusted partner for defence and government clients, building bespoke training and simulation solutions across a range of fields, such as maritime, aviation & land operations.

The ADATS Technical Training Manager will provide support to all aspects of training, assessment, development and delivery on ADATS (Australian Defence Air Traffic System) and will support the ADATS Though Life Support activities.

BENEFITS @ THALES

- Competitive remuneration + Bonus + Health insurance
- Free medical health insurance for you and your family
- ThalesFlex – flexibility working is our everyday
- Fitness Passport Discount
- Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech)
- Modernised Paid Parental Leave
- Novated Lease options

YOUR ROLE
Located in Rydalmere, on Darug land, your role purpose will be:

- undertake and/or assist in the development of training and assessment material, when required
- lead the delivery of ADATS training and assessment events
- supervise, coordinate, mentor and monitor the performance of trainees undertaking training
- undertake and/or assist in the development or conduct of training evaluation and validation activities
- undertake and/or assist in the development or conduct of training needs analysis activities
- provide an equitable and accessible training and assessment environment for all training customers and participants

ABOUT YOU

To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:

- Certificate IV in Training and Assessment (TAE 40122) or equivalent
- Advanced Certificate in Electronics or equivalent
- vocational experience as a ADF Training Instructor; or
- vocational experience in the Training Instructor for RAN/RNZN/RNZAF/RN/RAF roles.
- demonstrated strong experience in the Air Traffic Management technical domain. Specifically,
- knowledge and experience with some or all the following will be an advantage:
- Primary and Secondary Ground RADAR knowledge and / experience
- UNIX based Data Processing and Display computer system knowledge and experience

GOOD TO KNOW
Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and (role dependent) medical checks. A Defence security clearance is required for this role; applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role.

The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role. The U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR) are applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY
After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process. Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

Votre contribution sera cruciale pour traduire les innovations en IA en solutions opérationnelles robustes, en assurant une collaboration fluide entre Data/AI Scientists, Software Engineers et Solution Architects. Votre travail soutiendra l'ambition de CortAIx de pousser les frontières de l'IA dans des contextes où la fiabilité et la sécurité des données sont primordiales, en vous assurant que les solutions d'IA développées sont non seulement performantes mais aussi parfaitement intégrées dans l'écosystème technologique de Thales.

Job title: AI Intern

As part of our digital transformation, we are launching an innovative Proof of Concept to develop an AI-assisted tool capable of automating the initial drafting of an FMEA. The AI should analyze unstructured and structured exports (e.g. BOMs) and cross-reference them with historical reliability files to predict failure modes and their local effects.

Key Responsibilities

In the Operations team, you will:

- Analyze electronic data: understand and parse unstructured (pdf drawings) and structured outputs from standard EDA software (e.g., Mentor Graphics, Cadence).
- Develop an AI/Data pipeline: design and implement a Python-based AI strategy, combining NLP and Computer Vision techniques (LLMs and LVMs) with graph-based approaches to map circuit topologies and understand component relationships.
- Integrate historical data: connect your algorithm to historical failures files to accurately predict how specific components (e.g., resistors, capacitors, ICs) fail within their specific circuit context.
- Generate FMEA reports: structure the AI’s output into a standardized FMEA format that human engineers can review and validate.
- Test and validate: Work closely with hardware engineers to validate the AI's logic on a simple, baseline electronic board to prove the concept's viability.

Requirements:

- Currently pursuing a Master’s degree or in the final year of an engineering School. Preferred majors: Electrical Engineering or Computer Science /AI.
- Strong programming skills in Python.
- Experience with AI/Machine Learning concepts (NLP, LLM prompting/fine-tuning, or data structuring).
- Fundamental understanding of electronic circuits, components, and schematics.
- Familiarity with EDA tools and file formats (Netlists, BOMs) is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of reliability engineering concepts or FMEA is advantageous.

Soft Skills

- Hybrid Thinker: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware engineering and software/AI development.
- Problem Solver: A pragmatic approach to scoping AI projects (starting simple and scaling up).
- Autonomous & Curious: Eager to dive into historical technical data and experiment with new algorithmic approaches.

Le groupe Thales est une organisation mondiale présente sur tous les continents au service de cinq grands marchés, tous d'importance vitale pour nos sociétés : l'aérospatial, l'espace, la défense et la sécurité et l’identité et la sécurité numérique. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. AI Security Engineer

The AI Security Engineer is a technical and consulting role focused on the design, development and production deployment of AI systems, both for client engagements and to support the organization's internal needs. The role complements the AI Security Advisor: where the latter drives strategy, governance and advisory, the AI Security Engineer focuses on execution. They build, ship and maintain the solutions, with clients and internally, embedding security best practices from design onward.

The role combines a strong appetite for software engineering with curiosity for applied AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, MLOps) and the associated security challenges. A significant share of the activity is dedicated to client engagements: requirements gathering, design, prototyping, development, support to production rollout, and knowledge transfer. In parallel, the AI Security Engineer contributes to the organization's strategic internal initiatives (AI-enabled business tools, agentic automations for security, transverse RAG platforms), which also serve as a learning ground and as a basis for capitalizing on client engagements.

Direct report: AI Security Advisor / Senior Management

Tasks and Responsibilities

Client engagements and consulting

- Deliver on client projects that require software engineering and the secure integration of AI components, with a level of autonomy adapted to the profile and to the engagement context.

- Take part in scoping workshops with clients: understanding the business need, translating it into a technical architecture, identifying security and compliance constraints.

- Design, prototype and develop the solutions delivered to clients: LLM integrations, RAG, agents, AI-driven automations, within the framework set by the AI Security Advisor.

- Support the client through to production: industrialization, secure deployment pipelines, knowledge transfer to the client's internal teams.

- Contribute to pre-sales activities: demos, PoCs, technical estimates, technical sections of RFP responses, alongside the sales teams and the AI Security Advisor.

- Represent the organization in front of clients with a strong level of communication, pedagogy and consulting posture.

- Capitalize after each engagement: lessons learned, reusable components, contributions to internal frameworks and standards.

Development and industrialization of internal AI tools

- AI-enabled business tools : actively contribute to the development and evolution of internal solutions (for example in CRM, due diligence or decision support domains), embedding software quality and security best practices.

- Document processing pipelines : contribute to the development and maintenance of automated document processing tools, ensuring pipeline robustness and the protection of the data being handled.

- Agentic automations for security : develop agentic components for cybersecurity operations (notably SOC use cases), in close collaboration with the Cyber Defense teams and the AI Security Advisor.

- Design and develop internal tools based on RAG, agents and AI-driven automations to support the needs of IT, HR and other departments.

- Industrialize PoCs and PoVs produced by the AI team into robust, maintainable solutions.

- Document, test and maintain the delivered solutions over time.

Embedding security in AI development

- Apply secure coding and application security best practices in the code produced, both internally and for clients.

- Secure AI deployment pipelines: CI/CD, secrets management, dependency control, API and cloud integrations.

- Implement defense mechanisms suited to AI systems: guardrails, input and output filtering, monitoring, control over the tools accessible to agents.

- Contribute, with the AI Security Advisor, to the operational implementation of reference frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF) within projects.

- Take part in threat modeling and code review activities on AI components, in collaboration with the AI Security Advisor.

Watch and capitalization

- Keep up to date on tools, frameworks and best practices for AI development and the associated application security.

- Develop reusable libraries, scripts and components to accelerate future projects.

- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing: lessons learned, demos, documentation.

- Capitalize on project insights to feed the standards and frameworks driven by the AI Security Advisor.

Collaboration and communication

- Work closely with the AI Security Advisor to ensure alignment between strategy and execution.

- Collaborate with delivery and R&D teams.

- Communicate effectively with technical stakeholders (dev, DevSecOps, MLOps) as well as non-technical ones (business, management).

- Contribute to coordination with Thales global initiatives around AI.

Skills

Expected technical foundation

- Solid software engineering fundamentals, ideally in Python, with care for clean, tested and maintainable code.

- Curiosity and first hands-on experience with modern AI architectures: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, API-based integrations.

- Awareness of application security topics: understanding of common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) and secure coding principles.

- Foundations on at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and on DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code).

Topics to grow into within the role

- Design and industrialization of production-grade AI solutions: advanced RAG, agents, orchestration, observability.

- AI-specific risks and the associated defense techniques: prompt injection, data poisoning, guardrails, agent sandboxing, tool access control.

- Reference frameworks and standards in the field: OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, AI Act.

- MLOps practices and the securing of AI deployment pipelines.

Mindset and personal qualities

- Genuine passion for AI and cybersecurity, with visible personal practice: side projects, open source contributions, experimentation, blogging, active watch.

- Strong interpersonal skills and a willingness to work directly with clients: listening, rephrasing, simplifying, defending a position on technical grounds.

- Curiosity, autonomy and the ability to learn fast in a field that evolves every week.

- Strong delivery mindset: finish what you start, ship things that work, and iterate.

- Ability to communicate simply, in writing and orally, in French and English, in a professional context and in front of varied audiences (technical and business).

- Eagerness to work in close collaboration with the AI Security Advisor and to grow on AI, security and consulting topics.

Candidate profile

- The position is open to all experience levels, from junior to senior. The scope of engagements, the level of autonomy and the client-facing posture will be calibrated accordingly.

- The common foundation expected is a software engineering background combined with a real appetite for cybersecurity, AI and consulting topics.

- For more junior profiles, demonstrated passion, fast learning ability and the appetite for project-based work matter more than formal experience. For more senior profiles, prior exposure to client environments and to AI or application security projects will be valued.

- Personal projects related to AI, software engineering or application security are a strong plus regardless of experience level.

Required Languages/

- French or Dutch native
- English is a plus

Valued certifications

No certification is required upon hiring. A skills development plan will be set up and may include the GIAC certifications dedicated to AI security, which directly map to the scope of the role:

- GIAC AI Platform Security (GAIPS) : securing GenAI applications and LLM development pipelines (integrations, APIs, MLOps, agents).

- GIAC AI Security Automation Engineer (GASAE) : automation and AI applied to offensive, defensive and cloud security operations, particularly relevant to agentic automations in cybersecurity.

- GIAC Offensive AI Analyst (GOAA) : offensive techniques related to AI (deepfakes, guardrail bypass, AI-assisted malicious code generation), useful to inform defensive practices.

Other cybersecurity or cloud certifications (OSCP, OSCE, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications, etc.) will also be valued.

From the bottom of the ocean to the depth of space and cyberspace, Thales Group provides a unique range of technologies and services that make tomorrow possible, today. This position is part of the Generative and Agentic AI team that is responsible for designing and proving the value of novel Agentic AI applications with a focus on trustable AI.

The individual must possess deep, hands-on technical skills in the development and training of AI and ML, but more importantly, in the development of solutions using Generative AI, whether deployed as Agentic AI or LLM workflows. In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. Within the group, Thales Digital Solutions (TDS) is a technological innovation hub supporting all sectors of activity, both in the local Canadian market and internationally. Join us to contribute to the development of mission critical solutions. Our various cutting-edge projects use our expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Human Factors, Collaborative Autonomous Systems, Optimization, Knowledge Management, Cybersecurity and Design.

Architecte IA Générative et Agentique

Ville de Québec, QC (Hybride) Temps plein

Résumé du poste

Notre équipe réalise des travaux de recherche et développement (R&D) pour répondre aux besoins du département de la Défense nationale (DND) et des Forces armées canadiennes (CAF). Les projets portent sur des solutions numériques innovantes combinant développement logiciel, intégration de systèmes, infrastructure moderne et intelligence artificielle générative.

Dans le cadre de l'accélération de nos initiatives en intelligence artificielle, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle génération d'applications basées sur l'Agentic AI. Ces solutions vont au-delà des assistants conversationnels traditionnels en permettant à des agents intelligents d'analyser des données, de raisonner, de prendre des décisions, d'orchestrer des workflows complexes et d'interagir avec plusieurs systèmes d'entreprise de manière autonome et sécurisée.

Nous recherchons une personne occupant un rôle d’Architecte IA générative et agentique pour rejoindre notre équipe à Québec, spécialisée dans la gestion des connaissances. Notre équipe multidisciplinaire se concentre sur la collecte, la transformation et l’enrichissement des données. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. Notre équipe utilise également des concepts d'IA et de machine learning (ML) pour accroître l’efficacité des analyses.

Fonctions essentielles

La personne titulaire du poste Architecte IA Générative et Agentique est responsable de concevoir et maintenir l’architecture d’une solution agentique prenant en compte les diverses contraintes, choix technologiques et besoin utilisateurs. La personne doit avoir l’expérience et les aptitudes nécessaires afin de faire les choix, recommandations et pivot nécessaire pour aligner l’architecture et la roadmap de développement sur des besoins et enjeux courts et longs termes. Cette personne doit avoir une bonne connaissance et maitrise des plus récentes technologies du milieu de l’IA agentique incluant les plateformes, API, base de données et meilleures pratiques.

Il agit comme un pont entre les parties prenantes d'affaires : analystes d’affaires, les utilisateurs finaux : avec les designers UX et les équipes techniques : développeurs et scientifiques appliqués, afin de transformer les besoins organisationnels en architectures évolutives. Ce rôle combine une vision stratégique produit, une compréhension approfondie des processus d'affaires, des compétences en architecture de données et une expertise dans la conception de workflows agentiques complexes. Cette personne évalue les besoins de bout en bout et recommande des écosystèmes composés de multiples agents, outils, intégrations et mécanismes d'orchestration afin d'optimiser les opérations, l'expérience utilisateur et la création de valeur.

La personne titulaire du poste Architecte IA Générative et Agentique jouera un rôle clé dans la conception, le développement et la mise en production de plateformes et applications intelligentes intégrant des modèles de langage (LLM), les données et connaissances organisationnelles/métiers et les outils associés. Elle assurera un maintien et une évolution « optimale » des workflow agents, données et outils développés par diverses parties. La personne occupant ce poste contribuera à des projets stratégiques permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, le soutien à la décision et l'automatisation de processus complexes dans des environnements où la sécurité, la fiabilité et la traçabilité sont essentielles. Cette personne devra être autonome, curieuse et à l’aise dans un contexte où les besoins évoluent rapidement. Elle travaillera avec des architectes, des développeurs et des spécialistes en intelligence artificielle afin de transformer des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes, démontrables et évolutives.

Cette personne fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et des capacités de travail d'équipe sont obligatoires. Le candidat idéal est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui faciliteraient le transfert du travail effectué à tous les intervenants impliqués. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.

Responsabilités du Architecte IA Générative et Agentique :

• Concevoir, maintenir et optimiser des solutions impliquant plusieurs agents IA coordonnés, en définissant leurs responsabilités, interactions, outils et mécanismes de collaboration.

• Développer des architectures de workflows intelligents permettant l'automatisation de processus complexes de bout en bout.

• Établir les indicateurs de performance, métriques de succès et mécanismes de suivi des solutions mises en place.

• Assurer la gouvernance des agents IA en matière de sécurité, politique d’accès utilisateurs (RBAC), conformité, qualité des données et gestion des risques.

• Participer aux évaluations de faisabilité, analyses d'impacts et estimations d'efforts pour les projets IA.

Exigences minimales

• Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, systèmes d'information, science des données ou domaine connexe.

• Expérience et connaissances sur les plateformes d'IA générative, LLMs et IA agentiques : open source, entreprise et/ou cloud.

• Capacité à concevoir des architectures composées de plusieurs agents spécialisés collaborant pour atteindre des objectifs d'affaires.

• Compréhension des concepts de représentation et recherche de données non structurées à l’aide de modèles hybrides et sémantiques.

• Maîtrise des principes d'orchestration, planification, raisonnement et exécution des agents.

• Excellente capacité à comprendre les besoins organisationnels et à les traduire en solutions concrètes.

• Aptitude à élaborer une vision produit et à définir une stratégie d'évolution des solutions IA.

• Forte capacité de vulgarisation auprès des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.

Ce poste requiert une bonne connaissance de l'anglais pour interagir, soutenir et/ou fournir des services à des clients, employés et/ou partenaires internationaux ainsi qu’à des autorités gouvernementales étrangères qui ne parlent pas français.

Qualifications souhaitables

Votre quotidien

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

L’activité Microwave & Imaging Sub-Systems (MIS) bénéficie de 70 ans d'expérience dans la conception et la fabrication de sous-systèmes d'imagerie, de radiofréquences et d'hyperfréquences destinés à des applications professionnelles dans la défense, l’espace, l’industrie, la science et le médical.

MIS est divisé en plusieurs pôles et Delivery Units dont le Pôle et la Delivery Unit « SPACE » responsable du développement et la production de Tubes à Onde Progressive (TOP) destinés à l’amplification des signaux RF des antennes des charges utiles des satellites commerciaux (broadcast, données), scientifiques ou de défense. Les principaux clients sont des fabricants d’amplificateurs (Europe), de satellites (Europe, USA, Chine, Inde, Japon) et des agences (ESA, CNES, JPL, …).

Au sein du service projets programmes spatiaux, « nouveaux produits », nous recherchons un.e Responsable Offres et Programmes (PM), basé(e) à Vélizy (78).

Votre profil :

De formation ingénieur, doctorat, ou équivalent, en électronique analogique et numérique, voire mécanique/matériau, de préférence dans le domaine des radiofréquences, vous avez au minimum 10 années d’expérience professionnelle.

Vos premières expériences professionnelles vous ont permis de concevoir des produits électroniques radiofréquences, hyperfréquences. Vous avez validé les produits par test (IVV) en laboratoire et réalisé des actions de mise au point.

Vous avez par la suite acquis une expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans la conduite des projets et des offres (devis) ainsi que des processus associés. Vous avez notamment piloté des équipes de docteurs, ingénieurs et de techniciens, sous-traitants (ingénierie, production) afin de concevoir, valider, fabriquer des nouveaux produits électroniques. La gestion des budgets associés, des risques et des opportunités est une pratique courante pour vous. Vous avez validé et vous maintenez une certification en gestion de projet.

Vous avez également une bonne connaissance du milieu industriel (outils, production, gestion de la sous-traitance), de clients étatiques dans le domaine spatial (CNES, ESA) et du milieu de la recherche (laboratoires universitaires, Thales TRT, …).

Réactif, et méthodique, vous faites preuve d’un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse ? Vous êtes autonome et et vous savez prendre des décisions ? Vous êtes un bon communicant ? Vous avez un esprit d’équipe ? Vous avez une aisance relationnelle, une disponibilité vous permettant d’être à l’aise dans le management transverse ?

Votre anglais est courant, la pratique de l’allemand serait un plus.

Votre quotidien :

Au sein du service, vous êtes Bid & Program Manager.

Vos missions seront de :

- Définir et piloter les projets de développement d’amplificateurs RF Tubes à Ondes Progressives, intégrant de nouvelles technologies, en entretenant une coordination entre le site de Vélizy et le site d’Ulm (Allemagne). Vous veillez en particulier au respect des engagements et à la satisfaction globale du client et des parties prenantes ;
- Définir et piloter les moyens d’IVV permettant de valider la qualification des nouveaux produits ;
- Animer la relation client, gérer les obligations légales et contractuelles ainsi que les éventuels contentieux ;
- Construire les offres associées aux demandes d’évolutions des programmes en cours en coordination avec les ventes ;
- Réaliser les réunions de reporting projet et de revues de phase ;
- Manager le contrat pour l’adapter en permanence à l’évolution du besoin Client et à la stratégie de l’entreprise ;
- Etre force de proposition sur les sujets de pratiques métiers, processus de développement dans le cadre des projets et des offres.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques, industrielles, qualité, achat et ventes afin d’assurer le bon déroulement du projet.

Des déplacements en France et à l’étranger sont à prévoir, en fonction des projets pilotés :

- Chez nos clients qui se situent principalement en France, Europe
- Chez nos fournisseurs principalement en France, Europe
- Sur le site AVS MIS à Ulm (Allemagne

description:
In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Position: Bid Manager

Lokation: Thales Denmark ApS, Ballerup

Hos Thales Denmark ApS arbejder vi med avancerede løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed, netværk og kommunikation. Vi er en organisation i vækst og søger en erfaren Bid Manager, der kan samle mennesker, skabe fremdrift og omsætte kundernes behov til stærke og konkurrencedygtige løsninger baseret på vores brede portefølje inden for netværks- og kommunikationsområdet.

Det er en nyoprettet position, hvor du får en central rolle i vores danske organisation. Du bliver ansvarlig for at opbygge og modne bid management-funktionen i Danmark samtidig med, at du driver tilbudsaktiviteter, understøtter kunderelationer og bidrager til interne aktiviteter, der styrker vores fortsatte vækst.

Selvom du bliver en del af en global teknologivirksomhed, vil hverdagen i Danmark i høj grad være præget af et entreprenant og dynamisk start-up-miljø, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling, og hvor du får stor indflydelse på både rolle, processer og organisation.

Du bliver ansvarlig for tilbudsaktiviteter i Danmark med mulighed for også at bidrage til projekter i resten af Nordeuropa.

En nøgleposition med stor indflydelse

Som Bid Manager bliver du den gennemgående person i arbejdet med identifikation af nye forretningsmuligheder og udarbejdelse af tilbud, der matcher kundernes behov. Du skaber overblik, holder retningen og sikrer, at kunder, specialister, leverandører og kolleger arbejder mod samme mål.

Du er med fra de første dialoger med kunden til det færdige tilbud er afleveret og præsenteret.

Ud over at drive tilbudsprocesser får du en vigtig rolle i at etablere og videreudvikle strukturer, metoder og samarbejdsformer, så bid management bliver en stærk og skalerbar funktion i takt med virksomhedens vækst.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

- Skabe overblik over kundernes planer, behov og kommende projekter.
- Omsætte kundekrav til stærke og konkurrencedygtige løsninger sammen med tekniske og kommercielle specialister.
- Forberede materiale til prækvalifikationer og kommende udbud.
- Lede og koordinere komplekse tilbuds- og udbudsforløb.
- Sikre høj kvalitet i tilbudsmaterialet og holde styr på fremdrift, deadlines og risici.
- Udvikle tilbudsstrategier sammen med salgsorganisationen.
- Koordinere budgetter, omkostningsberegninger og prismodeller.
- Bidrage til kundemøder, præsentationer og forhandlinger.
- Samarbejde tæt med kolleger i Danmark og Frankrig samt eksterne partnere og leverandører.
- Bidrage til udviklingen af interne processer, værktøjer og arbejdsmetoder inden for tilbudsarbejde og forretningsudvikling.

Thales Denmark ApS vokser som forretning, og du vil således også få mulighed for at præge både rollen og organisationen samt tage ansvar for opgaver, der opstår i takt med vores ekspansion.

Hvem er du?

Du trives, når opgaver er komplekse, og når mange interessenter skal samles om en fælles løsning.

Du motiveres af at skabe struktur og resultater i et miljø under udvikling, hvor ikke alle processer er defineret på forhånd, og hvor du selv er med til at sætte retningen.

Du kan komme fra forsvarsindustrien, IT-, teknologi- eller telebranchen, gerne fra en rolle med ansvar for større tilbud, forretningsudvikling eller komplekse salgsprocesser. Erfaring fra Forsvaret eller en operativ baggrund er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

- Har erfaring med tilbudsarbejde, projektledelse eller komplekse salgsprocesser.
- Er stærk til at skabe struktur og fremdrift.
- Trives med at opbygge nye processer og funktioner.
- Har gode samarbejds- og relationsevner.
- Kan kommunikere klart og overbevisende både mundtligt og skriftligt.
- Har forretningsforståelse og interesse for teknologi.
- Trives med ansvar og mange kontaktflader.
- Kan navigere i en international organisation.
- Motiveres af stor selvstændighed og muligheden for at sætte dit eget præg på måden, vi arbejder på.

Sammen styrker vi Danmarks sikkerhed

Hos Thales får du mulighed for at arbejde med projekter, der har reel betydning for samfundets sikkerhed og robuste kommunikationsløsninger.

Du bliver en del af en international teknologivirksomhed med stærke kompetencer og store ambitioner, samtidig med at du får indflydelse i en mindre dansk organisation, hvor beslutningsvejene er korte, og hvor dine resultater er synlige.

Stillingen er baseret i Ballerup og rapporterer til Country Director med tæt samarbejde til Program Manager i Danmark samt Bid- og Offer-funktioner i Frankrig.

Du skal beherske dansk og engelsk flydende. Fransk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Søg allerede i dag. Stillingen vil være åben, indtil den rette kandidat er fundet.

‘The goal is to turn data into information and information into insight’
The Enterprise Information Management team of Thales in the Netherlands is looking for an experienced BI specialist to further professionalize information management.

About the job
Thales in the Netherlands has committed to the objective to become a ‘data-driven company’, where facts and unambiguous information are leading in decision making. As BI specialist, you will be responsible for gathering the requested business information and designing clear dashboards for our internal customer, the business user. At the start of the week, you check the sprint backlog to see what tasks are assigned to you. You align with the product owner and business analyst of the team and you are in touch with the business user to sharpen the information specifications. Together with the solution architect and data manager, you investigate which data is required to build the dashboard and together you determine how much time it will take to extract and validate the data. You are capable of executing ETL activities yourself. In the meantime, you start designing one component of the new dashboard in PowerBI. You are in close contact with the business user to agree upon the visual design. At the end of the sprint, which takes two weeks, you deliver the new component of the new dashboard, and in the next sprint you will extend your work with a new component.

You play an important role in the internal digital transformation journey of Thales in the Netherlands. There is a lot of work to be done; you are a ‘go-getter’ and consider this assignment, which we accepted as a team, to be a journey full of chances and possibilities. You are flexible and know how to work around challenges along the way. You are someone who dares to challenge the status quo and someone who brings new energy to our team. Also, you have strong communication skills and you know to address different audiences.

The most important activities are:

- Develop and design dashboards in PowerBI to meet the information demands of the business user
- ETL activities to extract and format data for the dashboards which need to be developed
- Contribute to the improvement of our work processes

Must have

- Holds a relevant Bachelor degree in IT, Business & IT or similar;
- Has knowledge of PowerBI
- Has experience with an ETL tool, preverably SSIS
- Has experience with an cubes, preverably SSAS tabular

Nice to have

- Has knowlegdge and experience with Kimball dimensional data modelling
- Can align the business information request with the technical possibilities
- Is proactive, flexible, a go-getter, and enthusiastic
- Knowledge of SQL and Mendix is a pre
- Good understanding of the Dutch language

What’s in it for you

- A challenging role in a high tech, innovative environment with room for initiative and new ideas.
- Opportunities for personal and professional growth, including technical and international development.
- Collaboration with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and nationalities.
- A modern, flexible workspace with a healthy work life balance.
- Hybrid working possibilities, typically aiming for a 60/40 home office balance where the role allows.
- Competitive salary based on vakgroep 55/ 60 CLA Metalektro-HP, travel allowance, and customizable employment conditions (e.g., PTO exchange, mobility options, fitness, relocation support).
- 40 days of paid time off per year.

Diversity Statement
We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.

Security Requirements

title: C++ Software Engineer – Electro-Optical (Radar Core Processing)
description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C++ Software Engineer – Electro-Optical (Radar Core Processing)

About Us

Thales Nederland is a top provider of high-tech jobs, active in the Aerospace, Defense, and Security sectors. We design extremely modern radar systems and optical sensors that form part of complete, integrated defense systems. Within the Engineering cluster, our software engineering department is responsible for the software that makes these radar systems tick. These complex systems are used worldwide to protect lives in critical situations.

The Team: Electro-Optical (RCP)

The Electro-Optical team sits within the Radar Core Processing (RCP) department. While traditional radar relies on radio waves for long-range detection, our team focuses on the integration and processing of optical cameras to provide critical short-range surveillance and highly accurate tracking capabilities. We build the software powering a diverse range of cutting-edge defense systems, distinguishing between dedicated electro-optical surveillance products (like Gatekeeper) and precision tracking systems (like MiRADOR). Furthermore, we develop solutions that fuse these domains, seamlessly combining optical sensor data with traditional radar technology (such as in our STIR systems) to deliver comprehensive, multi-domain situational awareness. We are a specialized team that bridges the gap between complex software algorithms and physical hardware, ensuring optical data is flawlessly integrated into the wider defense ecosystem.

The Role

We are looking for a C++ developer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, complex mathematics, and hardware integration.

In this role, you will focus heavily on image and video processing, writing the C++ code that interprets what our optical sensors see. Because this involves transforming high volumes of raw visual data in real-time, you will frequently work with heavy mathematical computations, particularly matrix operations. While this is primarily a software development position, it is highly hands-on; you will regularly step away from your desk to test, verify, and fine-tune your code directly on the actual physical hardware and camera systems.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance C++ software tailored for real-time image and video processing.
- Translate complex mathematical models into efficient, production-ready code.
- Integrate software algorithms with physical optical camera hardware, conducting hands-on testing and verification to ensure real-world accuracy and reliability.
- Optimize video processing pipelines and data flows, utilizing the Gstreamer library.
- Leverage GPU acceleration (CUDA) to maximize the speed and efficiency of our electro-optical processing capabilities.
- Collaborate with broader RCP teams to ensure optical data seamlessly integrates with tracking, extraction, and fire control systems.

About You

We are looking for a strong C++ developer who has a deep interest in making sense of visual data. You should have:

- Solid, proven experience in modern C++ software engineering.
- A strong affinity for and background in image and/or video processing.
- Solid mathematical capabilities, with specific comfort and experience implementing matrix operations in code.
- A hands-on engineering mindset; you enjoy seeing your software run on actual physical hardware rather than just in a simulation.
- Experience with GPU programming, specifically CUDA.
- Preferred but not strictly required: Familiarity with building and managing media pipelines using the Gstreamer library.

What We Offer

- An interesting job in a high-tech environment at our Hengelo campus.
- An open and flexible working environment where work-life balance is considered very important.
- 40 leave days per year.
- Travel expenses and a flexible benefits à la carte package.
- Options to personalize your benefits, including the purchase/sale of leave hours, internet costs, a bicycle plan, company fitness, trade union contributions, or relocation costs.
- Dedicated opportunities for continuous skill development, including active participation in our internal monthly "Learning Moments" professional development initiatives.
- A lot of room for your personal development and own initiatives.

The Certification Officer will be responsible to manage the certification activities associated with the Royal Canadian Navy Arctic and Offshore Patrol Vessels (AOPV), Joint Support Ship (JSS) class vessels managed by Thales under the AOPS & JSS In-Service Support (AJISS) contract, and Minor Warships and Auxiliary Vessels managed by Thales under the MWAV contract.

In this position, you will be the main point of contact for the Classification Society surveyor and support the Service Delivery team with planning and executing the activities associated with Classification Society scheduled surveys and inspections. You will also advise the Service Delivery team and Engineering team on matters relating to certification requirements for corrective maintenance, planned maintenance and engineering changes, and act as the point of contact for all certification-related inquiries, ensuring efficient communication between DND departments (NMRA, FTA, MEPM), the approved Classification Society, and Thales departments (Engineering, Supportability, Service Delivery, Procurement).

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility

The Certification Officer will report to the Certification Manager within TCDS and support the management and coordination of certification activities across AOPS, JSS, and MWAV fleets. This includes, but is not limited to:

- Identifying all re-certification activities (including Classification Society scheduled surveys and material re-certification) and ensuring they are captured within the Class maintenance program planning tool.
- Supporting Thales Service Delivery with certification-related activities, including Classification Society periodic and annual surveys and inspections, and coordinating schedules with Class, Ship Staff, and internal teams.
- Liaising with Classification Society personnel during surveys and inspections, technical issues, and engineering changes impacting Class compliance.
- Assessing the impact of new ship defects and engineering changes on certification, including participation in Technical Risk assessments and management of Conditions of Class mitigation and resolution.
- Maintaining certification tracking tools, including certification issue trackers and deliverable lists for AOPV, JSS, and MWAV vessels.
- Reviewing the Captain’s Ship Book to ensure certificates are kept up to date and aligned with the Technical Data Package, while serving as the point of contact with DND on certification issues.

Minimum Qualifications

The candidate must meet each of the following criteria:

- Demonstrated understanding and experience with Classification Society rules and regulations (Lloyd’s Register, ABS, DNV) for the Classification of Ships, Naval Ship Classification Rules, and Commercial Ship Rules.
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Association of Classification Societies (IACS).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Maritime Organization (IMO).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS).
- Demonstrated understanding and experience with the International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code).
- Language: English (essential).

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience as a Marine Surveyor with a Classification Society.
- Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in surveying or maintenance of vessels to commercial or military standards.
- Familiarity with Navy certification requirements (e.g., ANEP 77 Naval Ship Code).
- Transport Canada Marine Engineer certificate, or military equivalent.
- University degree in a related marine engineering field from a recognized program.
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) within the province of practice.

Work includes inspections onboard naval vessels, including machinery spaces, with activities such as bending, twisting, working at heights, and in confined spaces (training provided).

- Work Location: Mix of office-based work and site visits in dockyards and onboard naval ships as required.

Our Explosive Ordnance Services team enables the Australian Defence Force through storage, distribution, maintenance and disposal of these systems, all across Australia. As a turnkey solution, we offer the opportunity to gain a holistic understanding of our business operations, creating huge opportunities for growth.

Within our logistics services business there are 17+ depots throughout Australia, allowing various development and progression opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Customer Service Officer / Inventory Coordinator to join our team at our Darwin RAAF site. As the first point of contact for our customer, the ADF, you will need a positive attitude, be an active listener with excellent attention to detail and the ability to think on your feet. In turn, we will provide you with the training and support needed to succeed.

- Ensuring accurate operation of the electronic and manual inventory stock management system
- Instruct and train staff as required and to ensure quality standards are maintained
- Planning and controlling work activities, including resource allocation and time management
- Maintain all Technical Publications relevant to the operation of the Inventory Office
- Building & maintaining relationships with both internal and external clients
- Demonstrating a personal commitment to all matters relating to health and safety

YOUR EXPERIENCE

- Relevant experience in a similar environment
- Excellent communication skills at all levels
- Knowledge of inventory management systems would be desirable
- Experience within the Defence and/or Logistics environment would be highly advantageous

WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY

After you have applied, you will receive an email acknowledging your application. We’ll then provide a personalised experience for suitable applicants as we progress the selection and assessment process.

Prior to being offered employment, you will need to complete pre-employment police and depending on the role type, medical checks as well.

A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/.

In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role. - Technical Coordination: Manage technical escalations with vendors and manufacturers and collaborate with SOC, infrastructure, network, application, cloud and other technical teams when required.
- Documentation & Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate technical documentation, inventories, CMDB information and service records, and contribute to knowledge management and reporting.

Covered environments

Cybersecurity solutions within the scope of the role may include, but are not limited to:

a. Network Security

- FW – Firewall
- IPS – Intrusion Prevention System
- VPN – Virtual Private Network
- NAC – Network Access Control

b. Endpoint & Mobile Security

- EPP – Endpoint Protection Platform
- EDR – Endpoint Detection and Response
- MTD – Mobile Threat Defense

c. Secure Access & Connectivity

- SEG – Secure Email Gateway
- SWG – Secure Web Gateway
- ZTNA – Zero Trust Network Access
- SSE – Security Service Edge
- SASE – Secure Access Service Edge

d. Application & Service Protection

- WAAP – Web Application and API Protection
- WAF – Web Application Firewall
- API Security – Application Programming Interface Security
- Bot Management
- DDoS – Distributed Denial-of-Service Protection
- DNS Security – Domain Name System Security

e. Identity & Privileged Access Security

- PAM – Privileged Access Management
- IAM – Identity and Access Management
- ITDR – Identity Threat Detection and Response

f. Data Security

- DLP – Data Loss Prevention
- DSPM – Data Security Posture Management
- Encryption / KMS – Encryption / Key Management Service

g. Cloud & Cloud-Native Security

- CNAPP – Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform
- CSPM – Cloud Security Posture Management
- CWPP – Cloud Workload Protection Platform
- CIEM – Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management
- Container Security
- Kubernetes Security
- IaC Security – Infrastructure as Code Security
- CASB – Cloud Access Security Broker

Job requirements

- Minimum 4 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration or a related technical field.
- Minimum Higher Vocational Training / equivalent qualification in Network Systems Administration, Application Administration or a related technical discipline.
- Desirable: Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
- Practical experience in the administration, configuration, troubleshooting and maintenance of cybersecurity solutions.
- Good knowledge of communications networks and network security concepts.
- Ability to analyse technical problems, work with different technology vendors and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Security & Compliance Requirements

- Secure management of access credentials and strict adherence to established security procedures, including privileged access and multi-factor authentication requirements.
- Strict adherence to established approval and change-management procedures when implementing security policy or configuration changes.
- Accurate documentation of changes and configurations performed on solutions within scope.
- Strict confidentiality regarding security policies, configurations, products, architectures, applications, technical information and internal approval or validation processes.

description:
Location: Ottawa, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

For decades, Ottawa has been a global technology leader. Today, Canada’s capital holds one of the brightest and most diverse technological ecosystems in North America. The Thales Ottawa office has been a major supplier and long-term trusted partner to DND, enabling the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard to achieve mission success.

This is a remote and localized role in Ottawa, ON.

Position Summary

Cyberattacks have been on the rise around the globe, with hackers and other criminals targeting businesses large and small to steal valuable information or bring computer networks to a halt. Cyber Security analysts are valued for their ability to protect an organization’s information and systems from such attacks.

This position is responsible for providing ongoing information security services to all aspects of the on premise and cloud corporate IT environments. The Cybersecurity Vulnerability Engineer will require working across several security functions and have a strong primary focus on incident response activities.

Key Areas of Responsibility

• Must be able to monitor and evaluate newly disclosed and emerging vulnerabilities from Thales CTI, OSINT, Thales CERT, PSIRT, vendor advisories, security researchers, vulnerability databases, and other trusted sources.
• Must be able to Initiate and coordinate enterprise vulnerability-response activities for vulnerabilities with potential impact to Thales businesses and networks.
• Must be able to Engage infrastructure, IT, application, cloud, product, and security teams to validate exposure and determine required actions.
• Must have working knowledge of threat actor tactics and techniques.
• Must be able to establish clear ownership, priorities, response timelines, and escalation paths.
• Must be able to track remediation and mitigation activities through completion and validate that identified risk has been appropriately addressed.
• Must be able to escalate missed timelines, unresolved ownership, significant technical uncertainty, or material residual risk to appropriate leadership.
• Must be able to maintain clear status reporting for technical teams, cybersecurity leadership, and other stakeholders.
• Must be able to analyze newly disclosed vulnerabilities to understand affected components, exploitation prerequisites, attack vectors, required privileges, exploitability, potential impact, and available mitigations.
• Must be able to review CVEs, vendor advisories, security-research publications, proof-of-concept information, exploit intelligence, and relevant technical documentation.
