title: Data Infra Platform Engineer
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Responsibilities

Cloud infrastructure as code

- Build the cloud foundation in Terraform, to a high standard and designed to be configurable, so the platform can provision clusters of different profiles (front-facing, data-oriented, developer-oriented) from the same well-factored code.
- You treat infrastructure as code as software: small, composable modules with the versioning, review, and testing that make them reliable and reusable. The desired state lives in Git, the platform reconciles to it through GitOps, and drift is detected rather than discovered.

Data platform engineering on Kubernetes

- Build and operate the infrastructure that runs the data platform: a lakehouse on Apache Iceberg with a Polaris catalog and Trino, event streaming on Kafka, orchestration with Airflow, and managed databases such as CloudNativePG, all on object storage (ADLS Gen2). Your focus is on the platform beneath these systems: deploying, securing, scaling, and upgrading them as first-class capabilities, with the multi-tenancy, RBAC, governance, and FinOps that keep a shared platform healthy.
- Deep expertise in how data is modelled or processed is not required. A working understanding of how these systems are used is highly desirable, but the core of the job is keeping the infrastructure reliable, secure, and available.

Data governance and metadata

- Operate the catalog and metadata layer that makes data discoverable and governed for cataloguing, lineage, and classification, and Polaris for catalog-level access. You enforce the conventions and controls that keep data well managed, such as naming standards, access policies, and retention. This is infrastructure and policy work: you run the tooling and the guardrails, without owning the meaning of the data.

Data self-service

- Build the interfaces that let teams' provision what they need, such as Kafka topics and credentials, Iceberg tables and catalogs, Airflow connections, namespaces, and query access, without the platform team becoming a bottleneck. The goal is a platform that scales through self-service rather than manual requests, with capabilities maturing toward self-served or provided by default. You document these paths as you build them, so runbooks and guides are part of the deliverable.

Operate and keep it reliable

- Own the data platform at runtime, not just at provisioning. You define and measure the SLIs and SLOs, including data freshness and availability, write the runbooks that make failure recoverable, and lead incident response when the platform degrades or data stops flowing. You run lifecycle work such as cluster, broker, and engine upgrades with no data loss and minimal disruption, and trace failures to root cause.

REQUIREMENTS:

Education

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field.
- Masters degree in Computer Science or Information Technology if applicable

Essential Skills/Experience

- Several years building platform or data-platform capabilities end to end, production-grade, self-service solutions (three to five years is a useful guide).
- Strong, hands-on production of Kubernetes, including operating stateful, distributed systems (databases, brokers, query engines) and resolving issues under pressure.
- Hands-on experience operating at least one core data system (Kafka, Iceberg/Trino/Spark, or Airflow) as a platform service.
- Experience running data exploration and visualization tooling such as Grafana, Apache Superset, Elasticsearch, and Kibana.
- Solid infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or OpenTofu) and GitOps delivery (FluxCD or Argo CD).
- A working command of CI/CD pipelines and release strategy (GitLab, or equivalent).
- A sound grasp of cloud-native security: least privilege, network segmentation, secrets management, identity, and supply-chain integrity.
- Operational maturity: defining SLOs, incident response, and safe upgrades with no data loss.
- Proficiency in Python and one of Go or Bash, and comfort on Linux.
- The conviction that infrastructure is code: version-controlled, reviewed, tested, and secured.

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Working knowledge of SQL and data modelling. Valued but not required; the role centres on the infrastructure, not the data itself.
- Depth in Azure services (AKS, ADLS Gen2, AI Foundry, Key Vault, Entra ID, Private Endpoints).
- Kafka and Strimzi, including topics, schema, and credential management.
- Lakehouse and query engines: Iceberg, Polaris, Trino, and Spark on object storage.
- Airflow, including providers and connection management.
- Metadata and governance: DataHub, lineage, classification, and catalog RBAC.
- Managed databases on Kubernetes (CloudNativePG or similar).
- Building or operating an internal developer or data platform.

Essential / Desirable Traits

- You see systems end to end and resist thinking in silos.
- You treat the platform as a product: you measure adoption and let evidence, not assumption, guide what to build, harden, or retire.
- You have learning agility, flexibility, and initiative.
- You are comfortable in an agile team, engaging directly with the developers you serve.
- You hold your convictions with humility, welcome feedback, and stay resilient.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Les réseaux satellitaires ou SatCom seront de plus en plus basés sur des technologies standards (ex : 3GPP Non-Terrestrial Network). Afin de pouvoir d’accompagner les clients à savoir les opérateurs satellite, il convient de savoir introduire les nouvelles fonctionnalités dont ils ont besoin. - rédiger les contributions techniques éventuellement basés sur des simulations, les partager avec les acteurs de l’industrie 5G

Vous savez prendre des décisions en autonomie ?

title: Electrical Lead Engineer
description:

Electrical Lead Engineer

Over het team
Binnen de afdeling MEE (Mechanical & Electrical Engineering) is het team Electrical Design verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp en de integratie van alle (elektrische) subsystemen die samen een radar- of gevechtsmanagementsysteem vormen. De ontwikkeling van deze systemen vereist een multidisciplinaire aanpak met behulp van state-of-the-art technologie, initiatief en teamwork. Onze producten werken en worden onderhouden onder extreme omstandigheden. Dit vereist dat we verder kijken, en de technische grenzen van componenten opzoeken om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan.

Binnen deze grote organisatie zijn we onze persoonlijke aanpak niet uit het oog verloren. We hebben een leuke werkomgeving, fijne collega’s en zijn erg flexibel.

Over jouw toekomstige baan
Wil jij jouw leiderschap, technische en teamwork vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen? We zijn op zoek naar iemand die het elektrische focuspunt van een van onze productsegmenten kan zijn.

Ben jij in staat om meerdere Electrical Engineers te coachen, begeleiden en te ondersteunen waarbij je creativiteit en persoonlijk initiatief bevorderd? De Electrical Lead Engineer leidt een divers team van (junior-medior-senior) engineers om producten op te leveren. We maken onze elektrische schema’s in Eplan en beheren onze producten in ons PLM-systeem Windchill. Waarbij we altijd op zoek zijn naar manieren om onze werkmethodes en software te optimaliseren.

Creëer jij kansen en zet jij jouw invloed in om belangrijke projectmijlpalen te halen? De Electrical Lead Engineer werkt nauw samen met de Hardware Architect en de Work Package Manager om de radar en combat managementsystemen van de toekomst te ontwerpen binnen tijd en budget.

Je bent in staat om te anticiperen op project- of klantwensen en snel originele, verregaande oplossingen te formuleren. Je werkt samen met de Hardware Engineers in je team, Lead Engineers uit andere disciplines en de Hardware Architect om de oplossing te ontwerpen.

Op een typische dag ga je: bespreken en documenteren van jouw design keuzes. Coach je engineers uit je team en help je met technische problemen of normen. Rapporteert over team voortgang aan jou projectmanager. Troubleshoot je een probleem in een van je designs of prototypes.

- Hebt een HBO of WO-diploma, in de richting van Elektrotechniek of Mechatronica.

description:
Location: Den Helder, Netherlands

Over het team:

Binnen Thales Hengelo is Services een domein wat sterk groeit en is één van de speerpunten voor de toekomst. De totale Services-afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 100 mensen.

Over jouw toekomstige baan:

In de functie van elektromonteur maak je deel uit van een team van monteurs en test engineers die werkzaam zijn namens Thales bij de onderhoudsorganisatie van de Koninklijke Marine (DMI) in Den Helder. De Marine heeft meerdere schepen die zijn uitgerust met high tech radarsystemen van Thales en gedurende de gehele levenscyclus ondersteuning nodig hebben. Daarnaast wordt in Den Helder ook voor de Koninklijke Landmacht de radarsystemen onderhouden. Je bent met het team verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoer van verschillende services activiteiten.

Gedurende deze periode zul je diverse trainingen volgen en inwerken op de GM200-systeem. In Den Helder zul je daarnaast inwerken op andere systemen van Thales.

Na de eerste 6 tot 12 maanden werk je hoofdzakelijk op het terrein bij de Marine en eventueel op klantlocaties over de hele wereld om onze services aan de klanten te leveren om ervoor te zorgen dat de systemen operationeel beschikbaar blijven. Incidenteel zul je bij Thales in Hengelo werken.

- Monteren van mechatronische (sub)systemen en kabinetten met zowel statische als dynamische delen.

- Enige werkervaring in de machinebouw is een pre.

title: Electronic Warfare System Architect
description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) UK is a principal supplier of Electronic Warfare (EW), Radar and UAS equipment to the UK armed forces, as well as an exporter of these capabilities worldwide.

We are looking for senior engineers with the skills and experience to enhance our EW portfolio, delivering cutting edge products including:

- Digital Radar Electronic Support Measures (RESM) that provides situational awareness and identify threats even in busy electronic transmission environments
- Radar Electronic Countermeasures (RECM) that can protect assets by denying tactical advantage and distracting incoming threats.

We are seeking EW Systems Architects with experience of working within the field of Electronic Warfare and/or Radar, or related fields such as RESM, CESM, ECM or similar. You will have prior knowledge of the key principles of the domain and can quickly grasp the science and technology that sits behind a modern digital EW suite. You may have a military background, having operated EW equipment in the field, or have worked in the design, development or testing of similar products.

As an EW Systems Architect you’ll be working alongside other engineers, procurement and production teams to drive our EW product line forward, both in terms of Features and Non-Functional characteristics to meet the growing demands of our customers.

Role Description

In an EW System and Solution Architecture Role within Thales, you will:

- Define and recommend candidate architectures for the corresponding level (solution or solution element) to satisfy stakeholder expectations according to the standards and re-use policies, the technology roadmap and the business strategy
- Establish the solution architecture by making trade-offs between stakeholder expectations, technical and technological solutions and costs, risks and schedule, document the associated artefacts (architecture justification in the design and justification file, product breakdown structure, system/segment design document) and approve the resulting lower-level specifications (internal or external)
- Assist in the solution development cycle and in defining the co-engineering approach
- Manage, all along the project life cycle, the assignment of the corresponding level requirements, the management of the performance evaluation and the critical parameters, the definition of the interfaces, the technical negotiation between the different stakeholders (internal or external).

Principal Relationships

- EW Product Line Engineers, Architects and Managers
- EW Project Delivery Teams (including Project Management)
- Domain Technical and Engineering Managers
- Domain Functional Management
- The wider multi-discipline engineering team

Experienced required

Profile

- You graduated with an Engineering or Scientific degree, and you have significant experience in architecture and engineering systems
- You are a leader willing to engage and develop your team through the use of collaborative work and challenging approaches
- You are responsible and show a great sense of initiative
- You are convincing and persuasive
- You like to be involved with the customer
- You have good communication and relationship skills

Competencies

- You are aware of the description of the operational concept
- You have a deep knowledge of the field and its technical strategy
- You are familiar with operational analysis
- You are able to work in co-engineering (Lean Thinking, Obeya...)
- You understand the different actors involved in the project and are able to contextualise and change the perspective (political, economic, social, technical, environmental, legal...)
- You are familiar with Concept, Design, Experimentation and Simulation tools, as well as modelling tools and frameworks
- You are familiar with working with Integration Verification Validation Qualification and Agile methods

Desired Knowledge or Skills

- Experience in EW Domain concepts
- Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
- System Design
- RF Systems (EW, CESM, Comms)
- RF Performance Modelling/Budgets

Your Career at Thales UK

Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your Competencies in different areas:

- Room and attention to personal development
- Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
- Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
- Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

What we can offer

We are committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.

Our packages will include significant bonus, car allowance, a strong pension contribution, private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities. Further support can be provided towards academic and membership attainments.

Security Clearance Statement

This role will require UK Security Check (SC) clearance. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant will undergo, achieve, and maintain SC clearance.

To be eligible for full SC clearance, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

For further details of the evidence required to apply for a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) check and SC please refer to the United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) website: United Kingdom Security Vetting - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)

The Electronics Engineer role will be part of a diverse team of engineers, technicians, production staff and management supporting the Undersea Warfare business sector of Under Water Systems in Australia. Specifically, performing engineering related tasks to maintain and support the Scylla sonars and associated equipment and systems.

Our Underwater Systems team are proud to support the Royal Australian Navy, providing integrated mission-critical solutions to below-surface platforms. With access to some of the world’s most advanced technologies, our people enable naval forces around the world with our state-of-the-art Sonar and undersea combat systems.

- Competitive remuneration + Profit Share
- Annualised Performance Review Process

- Veterans Leave

- The design of new components for equipment and systems or test fixtures.
- Undertaking Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on location or on components returned from site.

- IEAust recognised Electrical / Electronics Engineering degree able to meet the requirements for Professional membership of Engineers Australia.

- Knowledge of the engineering design, manufacture, verification and configuration processes.

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Location: Reading, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Electronics Engineer

Location: Reading – Hybrid Working

Are you looking for a new challenge? Would you like an opportunity to develop your electronics skills in a close-knit, dynamic team environment? Thales OME designs a range of state-of-the-art solutions for some of the most technically advanced defence and security platforms in the world, and we’re seeking talented engineers who can apply their knowledge and skills in an electronics role.

This role is a development role, intended to give an engineer with some existing design experience the opportunity to build their technical skills, widen their exposure to different aspects of the design lifecycle, and learn about complex defence products in more detail. The role will cover all aspects of the product lifecycle, from concept studies, requirements, selection of technology, design and development, integration, validation and qualification.

There are positions available based at our sites in Glasgow and in Reading. While some of the role may be carried out from home, some attendance on site will be necessary for lab testing, system integration and some aspects of collaborative work.

Key responsibilities of the role

- Undertake design of electronic circuit assemblies, from concept through design, test and system integration
- Engage with a multi-disciplinary team across the project (systems, mechanical, software, safety, etc) to develop an optimum solution
- Work collaboratively with the project team to ensure products meet all requirements
- Contribute to the development of the wider electronics team, including proposing and implementing improvements, participating in peer reviews and sharing knowledge and good practice across the team
- Generate design documentation such as specifications, test plans and design records
- Prepare for and participate in peer reviews and project design reviews
- Report progress of work against cost, schedule and performance

About you

We are looking for an innovative and forward thinking individual with the following skills, experience and attributes:

- Experience of electronic/electrical design in a real-world environment (circuit simulation, block diagrams, drawing schematics, etc)
- Use of schematic capture packages (Cadence, Mentor Graphics or similar)
- Practical experience of lab work (eg. soldering, circuit testing, cable assembly, debug, etc)
- Some experience testing at circuit board and system level (eg. board bring-up and debug, EMC testing)
- General understanding of engineering process and design lifecycles
- Personal organisational and time-management skills

Core Benefits:

On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) plus opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare (grade dependent)
- Pension scheme
- Life cover24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts
- You can read about some of our other benefits here: UK benefits | Thales Group

Connect with Fiona Tal, Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-FT1 who is eager to explore together with you this exciting opportunity.

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

title: Electronics Production & Process Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
Location: Madrid, Spain

Thales people architect solutions at the heart of the defence-security continuum. Interoperable and secure information and telecommunications systems for defence, security, and civil operators, are based upon innovative use of radiocommunications, networks, and cybersecurity. We are ground breaking new digital technologies such as 4G mobile communications, cryptography, cloud computing and big data for use in physical protection systems, and critical information systems.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

In Defence and security, armed forces, governments and global organizations entrust Thales with helping them achieve and maintain security, tactical superiority and strategic independence in the face of any type of threat. In an increasingly unpredictable world, governments rely on our expertise to protect their citizens and make the world safer, from designing smart sensors and connecting soldiers on the digital battlefield to delivering solutions that protect states, cities and critical infrastructures.

In Spain, Thales Sistemas is specialized in Command and Control systems, Tactical Communications and Modeling and Simulation addressing solutions in the domain of Defense and Security. Thales is the Spanish leader in tactical Land CIS (Communication and Information Systems) covering all the product life cycle (design, development, production, ILS). Based in Leganés, Thales Sistemas employs a highly specialized workforce of more than 100 people, most of them engineers that participate in the following activities:

- Communications and Information Systems (CIS) to support Command function and Decision Making
- Embedded electronics for military aircraft
- Tactical Communications
- Radio Navigation Aids for air traffic

As an Electronics Production & Process Engineer, you will play a key role in the continuous improvement of our manufacturing systems, ensuring quality, efficiency, and compliance with standards. Your main responsibilities will include:

- Design, implement, and optimize electronic production processes (PCB assembly, testing, and subcontractor management).
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scalability, reliability, and alignment with product requirements.
- Analyze production data to identify improvement opportunities (lead time reduction, cost savings, defect minimization).
- Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, ESD, etc.).
- Drive automation and digitalization initiatives (PLM/ERP systems, data analysis tools like Power BI/Python).
- Troubleshoot technical issues on the production line and propose innovative solutions for process enhancements.
- Develop technical documentation (procedures, reports, work instructions, and manuals).
- Lead technical projects from conception to implementation, ensuring on-time delivery and quality.
- Customer/results-oriented approach, with a focus on internal and external stakeholder satisfaction (including Thales as a key client).

Education:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields (with a specialization in Electronics).
- Advanced level of English and Spanish (B2 or higher). French is desirable.

Experience:

- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in electronics production, manufacturing processes, and continuous improvement (valuable sectors: defense, aeronautics, or automotive industries)

Competences:

Technical/functional skills:

- Electronics: strong knowledge of digital/analog electronics and test systems/benches.
- Process Analysis: Ability to analyze assembly and testing processes for optimization.
- Standards & Compliance: Proficiency in IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, and quality standards.
- Software:
- CAD tools (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, ProEngineer/PTC Creo).
- PLM and ERP systems (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter, Oracle, SAP).

- Manufacturing Processes:
- PCB assembly and subcontractor management (machining, quality control).

- Continuous Improvement:
- Lean manufacturing tools (5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping - VSM).
- Data analysis (Excel, Power BI, Python) and AI-driven process optimization.

Behavioral skills:

- Strong planning and organizational skills with great attention to detail.
- Proactive attitude and commitment to continuous improvement.
- Ability to work effectively in teams and good interpersonal skills.

Additional Requirements:

- Availability for occasional national and international travel.

What do we offer?

- Flexible working hours.
- Shorter working days on Fridays and during summer.
- Remote-friendly - 2 days a week working from home.
- Restaurant allowance and social benefits (health insurance, kindergarten, transport).

Embedded Software Architect (m/w/d)

- Ableitung und Design der Softwarearchitektur aus der Systemarchitektur für kryptografische Geräte im Bereich Sicherheitstechnik

- Entwicklung modularer und wiederverwendbarer Softwarekomponenten mit abstrakten Schnittstellen für flexible Einsatzmöglichkeiten in verschiedenen Projekten

- Berücksichtigung gerätespezifischer Randbedingungen sowie Implementierung von Schutzmaßnahmen für sensible Daten in der Embedded Software

- Ganzheitliche Begleitung des Entwicklungsprozesses von der Angebotsphase über die Spezifikation und Entwicklung bis hin zur Serienproduktion der Geräte

- Technische Erfassung, Analyse und Umsetzung von Kundenanforderungen in robuste Softwarekonzepte und Architekturen

Darauf freuen wir uns:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Fachrichtung Nachrichten-/Informationstechnik, Technische Informatik oder vergleichbar

- Langjährige Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler und -architekt mit Schwerpunkt auf hardwarenaher Softwareentwicklung in C/C++ inklusive Templates und komponentenbasierter Programmierung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Aufbau und der Definition von Continuous Integration Toolchains sowie Anwendung moderner Entwicklungstools wie Enterprise Architect, UML, Jira und Confluence

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

title: Engineer (Software Solutions)
description:

From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Job Description: Full Stack Engineer (Software Solutions)

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our agile, international team. You will design, implement, and evolve robust, scalable backend and frontend components. This position requires strong technical ability, attention to code quality, and a passion for delivering reliable products.

Job Responsibilities

- Deliver Full-Stack Features: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend(spring boot) and frontend (React) features. Uphold code quality, performance, and maintainability standards.
- Exp:- 6 to 8 Yrs

Participate in Software Architecture Discussions: Collaborate with the team to ensure alignment on technical choices and contribute to the improvement of architectural solutions.

- Contribute to Code Reviews and Technical Problem Solving: Review peer’s code, identify issues, and share solutions to build a robust product.
- Collaborate Across International Teams: Work closely with distributed teams, product owners, architects, and stakeholders. Ensure clear communication, alignment, and efficient coordination in an international environment.
- Contribute to Integration & Test Strategy: Help define, implement, and evolve the overall software integration and test strategy, focusing on performance, robustness, scalability, and endurance.

Mandatory Skills

- Programming language: Strong Proficiency in Java/JavaScript Programming
- Software Architecture: Good Experience with modern microservices architecture and REST APIs
- Frontend Framework: Strong Proficiency in Frontend frameworks like React

Good experience in developing modern web application using React and Spring bootGood experience in Test driven developmentGood understanding of Object-Oriented Concepts, Data structures and AlgorithmsGood experience in preparing technical documentation.Good in experience in setting up Gitlab CI/CD pipelines

title: Engineering Delivery Manager
description:
Location: Glasgow, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Optronics & Missile Electronics (OME)

We help forces to find the right information at the right time to make the right decision. For over 130 years we’ve proudly led the development of Optronics for military, scientific and commercial use. We cover three sectors: Air, Land and Sea.

Engineering Delivery Manager

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Engineering Delivery Manager within Thales Optronics and Missile Electronics (OME).

This role will be on at least one of our significant development and production projects within OME. As an Engineering Delivery Manager you will work in collaboration with the Programme Managers, the Engineering Delivery Lead, the Head of Engineering Delivery and the wider engineering team to ensure delivery of the engineering development projects.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- leading high performing, multi-discipline engineering teams to generate engineering solutions that meet the Customer needs
- the definition of the engineering delivery strategy and resource profile based on the engineering estimates to ensure the delivery of the project
- managing the interfaces with the overall delivery strategy for the wider programme
- defining the organisation and work breakdown, with the Programme Manager, required to deliver to the Customer needs
- defining and being in charge of meeting cost, schedule and quality of the whole engineering delivery for the programme
- defining the engineering team’s work packages in terms of resources required, budgets assigned to each task, risks and assumptions on these and the timescales to deliver within
- the planning and prioritisation of activities required to deliver the solution to the contract schedule, costs and quality
- day to day management of the engineering team’s activities ensuring proactive management of issues, opportunities and risks
- managing and reporting of the engineering efficiency for the project
- the identification of re-use opportunities across the project
- act as the People Manager for the engineering team on the project and provide feedback into the people manager reviews with the functional discipline leads

The successful candidate will have a strong background in engineering with experience in successfully defining and leading the delivery of multi-disciplinary engineering projects. They will be highly customer focused with excellent communication skills and have the ability to work in a fast moving environment with multiple parallel objectives and have an understanding of systems engineering life cycle, practices and tools. Knowledge and experience of naval, air or land products would be beneficial to this role.

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following, aligned to the Thales Leadership Behavioural Model:

- acting with agility to ensure that the business objectives remain in focus
- dealing with multiple strands of complexity to achieve business objectives
- engaging with stakeholders to achieve a common goal
- creating a competitive advantage by managing risk, identifying opportunities and fostering continuous improvement
- supporting the development of others to ensure we continuously improve for our customers

This role will work closely with the Programme Manager and the Project Design Authority (PDA) for the specific projects. This role will report to the Head of Engineering Delivery.

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Benefits

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

title: Engineering Delivery Manager
description:

Project: The project focuses on the maintenance, development, and evolution of a safety-critical Air Traffic Control (ATC) system. The role involves coordinating delivery activities for a team of approximately 20 professionals, ensuring system reliability, delivering new features, and improving product performance to meet current and future customer needs.

Role purpose:

- The Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM) owns the engineering delivery interface with customers and segments, ensuring that successive product or solution versions are delivered in line with agreed needs, quality expectations and commitments.
- The EDM defines the overarching delivery strategy and master schedule, aligns initiative owners and stakeholders, and steers progress, priorities, risks and corrective actions across the engineering lifecycle.

Key responsibilities:

Customer and stakeholder management

- Act as the primary engineering delivery interface for customers and segment stakeholders; build trusted relationships and maintain clear expectations.
- Coordinate internally with Initiative Owners, Business Managers, Solution Management and engineering teams; communicate a shared delivery vision and strategy.

Delivery strategy and execution

- Define the global delivery strategy, multi-version roadmap and associated master schedule, translating customer needs into requirements and a coherent development approach.
- Own and coordinate delivery of successive versions to customers and segments; structure the delivery process, milestones, dependencies and commitments.
- Align and arbitrate priorities between versions and Initiative Owners, taking decisions when trade-offs or uncertainty arise.
- Oversee technical engineering activities across the project lifecycle, including development planning, technical debt, co-contracting and subcontracting.

Performance, quality and risk

- Monitor and report delivery progress to the program using dedicated KPIs and the consolidated multi-version backlog.
- Identify and manage risks, opportunities and schedule deviations; request root-cause analyses and drive appropriate corrective actions.
- Ensure engineering deliverables and proposed solutions meet customer needs and expected quality, including requirements, operational concepts and architecture choices.

Continuous improvement and issue resolution

- Plan the deployment of new processes and engineering practices in line with project constraints and delivery priorities.
- Facilitate cross-team collaboration and continuous improvement; in coordination with Solution Management, lead targeted deep dives into critical topics when needed (e.g., engineering environment).

Candidate profile

- Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related university discipline.
- At least 7 years of experience in Engineering Management, Technical/IT Project Management or Software Engineering Management.
- Proven ability to lead technical teams in complex environments, engage stakeholders and develop collaborative ways of working.
- Customer-oriented, persuasive communicator with sound judgment, including in uncertain situations.
- Strong commitment to continuous improvement, team development and engineering excellence.
- Required competencies
- Engineering lifecycle management, delivery planning, scheduling and multi-version coordination.
- Ability to review and challenge engineering deliverables: customer needs, operational concept documents (OCD), requirements and architecture decisions.
- Risk and opportunity management, delivery KPIs, root-cause analysis and corrective-action follow-up.
- Stakeholder influence, priority setting, decision-making and cross-functional collaboration.

Nice to have: Specific domain, product or project knowledge — to be defined by the hiring manager and Talent Acquisition.

Development opportunities

- Opportunities to grow across Thales domains, products, customers and locations, and to develop along either technical expertise or leadership career paths, including international opportunities.

- Développer la culture d’ingénierie à la fois dans la rigueur d’application des standards et dans l’analyse critique des opportunités ou obstacles qui influencent l’efficience de la stratégie d'ingénierie.

Amélioration Continue :

- Favoriser une culture d'innovation et d'amélioration continue des processus et des technologies pour optimiser la performance des équipes.

- Organiser régulièrement des rétrospectives et des revues des processus & pratiques afin de catalyser l’amélioration continue de l’ingénierie de son organisation.

- Fédérer la capitalisation au sein de son organisation, notamment les standards et leurs ajustements mis en œuvre ainsi que le partage de retours d’expérience pour permettre l’amélioration des standards de CortAIx

- S’assurer du partage des axes d’améliorations (écarts constatés, opportunités, futurs enjeux) pouvant alimenter les Learning Moments afin de soutenir la démarche d’organisation apprenante.
​

Gestion des Stakeholders :

Votre quotidien
Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique.

Sur le site de Thales Alenia Space Cannes, au sein de la Direction Ingénierie Telecom, vous intégrerez le groupe AOCS/AM composé d’une trentaine de personnes.

Dans le cadre du développement et de la validation des fonctions de guidage et navigation à des fins de rendez-vous orbital, Thales Alenia Space recherche un stagiaire afin de concevoir, développer et réaliser une maquette représentative d’un satellite, permettant de disposer d’un stimulateur avec une représentativité pour assurer la qualité des essais de validation GNC pour le RDV en orbite.

Le stage consistera à identifier les besoins de la maquette et les caractéristiques d’utilisation, définir/concevoir un modèle CAO permettant d’atteindre les objectifs, et réaliser la maquette pour la tester et la valider sur le banc Robotique. - Etudier les besoins : besoin d'usage (RDV, Operations de proximité, manœuvrabilité, représentativité...), contraintes d'utilisation (masse, encombrement, montage…) ;
- Réaliser un modèle simplifié de maquette sur la base d'une structure EROSS sur CATIA V5, analyse mécanique de la tenue de la maquette, estimation de caractéristiques (cout, masse, montage...).
- Réaliser la maquette avec récupération des matériaux (production, AIT, labo...) et l'utilisation des moyens du Fablab (impression 3D, découpe laser...)
- Tester et valider sur le banc ROBY et mise en œuvre sur un cas concret.

Nos engagements, vos avantages

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques.

Description du projet / rôle / missions

En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez les équipes de Thales Cybersecurity & Digital Identity, au sein des activités Border & Travel. Vous intervenez directement auprès de nos clients, principalement sur des sites sensibles tels que des aéroports et gares équipés de solutions biométriques (e-Gates, kiosques…), afin de garantir leur disponibilité et leur bon fonctionnement. En tant que Support Technician / Support Engineer, vous êtes le point de contact privilégié de nos clients pour assurer le support et la maintenance de nos solutions d’identité et de contrôle aux frontières. Vous intervenez aussi bien sur le terrain que dans l’analyse des incidents afin de garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service et le respect des engagements contractuels.

Vos principales missions consistent à :

- Assurer le support technique auprès des clients (téléphone, e-mail et interventions sur site) et garantir le respect des niveaux de service (SLA).

- Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents matériels et logiciels, puis escalader les problématiques complexes vers les équipes de développement lorsque cela est nécessaire.

- Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements déployés chez les clients.

- Participer aux déploiements et aux mises en service des nouvelles solutions sur les différents sites clients.

- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la fiabilité des services en analysant les logs, en identifiant les causes récurrentes des incidents et en proposant des axes d’amélioration des produits.

- Assurer le suivi du matériel, des outils et des stocks nécessaires aux interventions, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les Service Delivery Managers et les équipes R&D.

Votre priorité est d’assurer un service de qualité et de garantir la disponibilité de solutions critiques directement chez nos clients ?

Vous aimez intervenir sur le terrain, résoudre des problématiques techniques variées et évoluer dans un environnement où la relation client est essentielle ?

Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation technique ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en électromécanique, informatique industrielle ou équivalent, et vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans le support technique ou la maintenance d’équipements.

Vous disposez idéalement de compétences dans :

- La maintenance électromécanique et le diagnostic de pannes matérielles et logicielles.

- Le support technique sur des équipements complexes, en environnement client.

- Les environnements informatiques et réseaux.

- Les bonnes pratiques ITIL (gestion des incidents) seraient un plus.

- L’anglais professionnel est indispensable ; la maîtrise de l’espagnol constitue un atout.

Autonomie, sens du service, rigueur, organisation, capacité à gérer les priorités et excellent relationnel sont des qualités que l’on vous reconnaît ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

- Poste basé à Meudon, avec des déplacements très réguliers sur les sites clients (principalement en Île-de-France).

title: Finance Director - UK Financial Control, Accounting and Planning
description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Finance Director - UK Financial Control, Accounting and Planning

Location: Crawley (hybrid, 3 days a week)

Closing date for applications: Friday 30th October 2026

A rare opportunity to lead the financial integrity and governance of one of the UK's most innovative and high-profile technology organisations.

About the role:

We are seeking a Finance Director to lead our UK Financial Control, Accounting & Planning function.

Reporting to the UK CFO, this role sits at the centre of financial governance, assurance and technical excellence across the organisation.

This is not a traditional Finance Director role focused on operational finance, commercial partnering or business unit performance. Instead, this is a highly specialised leadership opportunity for an experienced finance professional with deep expertise in accounting, external audit, financial control and statutory reporting.

You will lead a compact team of subject matter experts spanning Financial Reporting, Tax, Treasury and Financial Shared Services, acting as the key interface between Thales UK, Thales Group, external auditors, banking partners and regulatory bodies.

This role is ideal for a highly experienced finance professional who combines deep technical accounting expertise, audit leadership experience and a passion for delivering financial excellence. You'll act as the trusted authority on financial reporting, financial control and statutory compliance, ensuring the integrity of our financial position while supporting the long-term success of the business.

What You'll Be Doing

- Leading all UK financial reporting, accounting and financial control activities
- Ensuring accurate, timely and compliant statutory and Group reporting
- Providing expert advice on complex accounting and financial governance matters, including IFRS interpretation and implementation
- Overseeing UK tax, treasury and financial shared services activities
- Leading relationships with external auditors, advisers, actuaries and banking partners
- Driving the successful execution of annual audits and statutory account production
- Supporting budget, forecast and multi-year planning processes at UK level
- Providing financial insight and challenge to support strategic decision-making
- Leading finance transformation and continuous improvement initiatives
- Developing and coaching a high-performing team of specialist finance professionals

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proven finance leader with outstanding technical expertise and significant experience operating within complex, highly regulated organisations.

You will bring:

- Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent)
- Extensive experience in financial control, statutory reporting and corporate accounting
- Deep understanding of IFRS and UK reporting requirements
- Significant experience leading external and statutory audits
- Strong knowledge of financial governance, risk management and internal controls
- Experience managing relationships with auditors, banks, advisers and senior stakeholders
- Demonstrated success operating at Finance Director, Controller or Head of Financial Reporting level
- Strong leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing specialist teams
- The ability to influence, challenge and advise senior leaders with confidence and credibility

Core Benefits:

On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) plus opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts
- You can read about some of our other benefits here: UK benefits | Thales Group

Thales is an equal opportunities employer and diversity and inclusion are integral to the success of Thales.

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

The Firewall Support Engineer plays a crucial role in safeguarding the company's data and systems. This individual is responsible for day-to-day administration of security infrastructure, monitoring breaches, conducting in-depth incident investigations, and implementing technical solutions to mitigate risks. The role requires a deep understanding of network protocols, security tools, and the ability to work under pressure during security incidents.

Responsibilities:

- Incident Response: Investigate and respond to security incidents and breaches escalated from L1 support, performing root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
- Monitoring & Analysis: Monitor and analyze security alerts and events from various sources, including SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platforms (e.g., QRADAR) and security dashboards.
- Vulnerability Management: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate penetration testing activities to identify weaknesses in systems and networks.
- Security Infrastructure Management: Implement, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain security technologies such as firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortigate, Check Point), intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), EDR/AV, CipherTrust (Tokenization Server), HSM, 2FA, PAM, IBM Guradium and Rapid 7.
- Policy & Documentation: Develop, maintain, and enforce security policies, procedures, and documentation, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
- Threat Hunting: Proactively search for hidden threats, malware, and vulnerabilities in the system to enhance detection capabilities.
- Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with IT, development, and L3 teams to address security issues and implement best practices. May also assist in training and mentoring junior (L1) security staff.
- Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and documentation of security incidents, analyses, and system status for management and compliance purposes.
- On-Call Support: May require participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation to address critical incidents and ensure minimal downtime and be onsite if necessary

Requirements:

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- Experience: 3+ years of proven experience in cybersecurity or information security roles, with a focus on L2 support or similar responsibilities. Minimally 1-2 years of experience in supporting mission critical systems with a stringent SLA of 99.9%
- Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of security protocols, TCP/IP, network security, operating systems (Linux, Windows), and cloud security concepts. Well-versed in IT Service Management (ITSM) standards, processes, guidelines and best practices is an advantage.
- Tool Experience: Hands-on experience with security tools such as SIEM, firewalls, vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), and incident response platforms.
- Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CISSP are highly valued.
- Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Résumé du poste

Notre équipe réalise des travaux de recherche et développement (R&D) pour répondre aux besoins du département de la Défense nationale (DND) et des Forces armées canadiennes (CAF). Les projets portent sur des solutions numériques innovantes combinant développement logiciel, intégration de systèmes, infrastructure moderne et intelligence artificielle générative.

Dans le cadre de l'accélération de nos initiatives en intelligence artificielle, nous souhaitons développer une nouvelle génération d'applications basées sur l'Agentic AI. Ces solutions vont au-delà des assistants conversationnels traditionnels en permettant à des agents intelligents d'analyser des données, de raisonner, de prendre des décisions, d'orchestrer des workflows complexes et d'interagir avec plusieurs systèmes d'entreprise de manière autonome et sécurisée.

Nous recherchons une personne Développeur Full Stack spécialisée en IA générative et en Agentic AI pour rejoindre notre équipe à Québec, spécialisée dans la gestion des connaissances. Notre équipe multidisciplinaire se concentre sur la collecte, la transformation et l’enrichissement des données. Nos projets impliquent la définition et le déploiement de chaînes de traitement automatisées pour rendre les données accessibles aux utilisateurs. Avec le soutien de nos scientifiques de données, l'équipe conçoit, entraîne et intègre des modèles d’intelligence artificielle, y compris l'IA générative (GenAI) basée sur des grands modèles de langue (LLM), afin d’améliorer l’analyse des données. Notre équipe utilise également des concepts d'IA et de machine learning (ML) pour accroître l’efficacité des analyses.

La personne titulaire du poste Développeur(se) Full Stack spécialisé(e) en IA générative et Agentic AI jouera un rôle clé dans la conception, le développement et la mise en production de plateformes et applications intelligentes intégrant des modèles de langage (LLM), des architectures multi-agents, des moteurs RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), des outils d'orchestration et des services cloud de nouvelle génération. La personne occupant ce poste contribuera à des projets stratégiques permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, le soutien à la décision et l'automatisation de processus complexes dans des environnements où la sécurité, la fiabilité et la traçabilité sont essentielles. Cette personne devra être autonome, curieuse et à l’aise dans un contexte de R&D où les besoins évoluent rapidement. Cette personne travaillera avec les équipes d’architecture, de développement et les spécialistes en intelligence artificielle afin de transformer des concepts techniques en solutions concrètes, démontrables et évolutives.

Cette personne fait partie d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Un fort esprit d'équipe et la capacité de travailler en collaboration sont obligatoires. La personne idéale est donc en mesure de démontrer des compétences transversales qui facilitent le transfert du travail effectué à l'ensemble des parties prenantes concernées. Par conséquent, de bonnes capacités de communication sont requises.

• Participer à l’intégration de solutions d’IA générative, de pipelines RAG, d’embeddings vectoriels et de mécanismes de recherche sémantique.

• Développer ou intégrer des MCP tools et MCP servers.

• Contribuer à l’intégration de modèles de langage, d’agents ou de composants IA dans des solutions applicatives.

• Développer des connecteurs permettant aux systèmes IA d’interagir avec des API, des bases de données, des services internes ou des systèmes externes.

• Participer au prototypage, à l’expérimentation et à l’évaluation de solutions basées sur l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques.

• Développer des services backend, des API, des microservices et des composants d’intégration principalement en Python.

• Participer au développement d’interfaces légères, de prototypes web, de démonstrateurs ou d’outils internes.

• Intégrer des composants frontend, backend, des services IA, des bases de données, des API et des systèmes externes.

• Développer, adapter et maintenir des Helm charts pour des environnements Kubernetes.

• Participer à l’automatisation des déploiements, des configurations et des environnements d’exécution.

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes liés aux conteneurs, aux dépendances, aux configurations et aux environnements Kubernetes.

• Collaborer avec les architectes, les développeurs, les spécialistes IA et les autres parties prenantes techniques.

description:

Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages

- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants.

Le programme GALILEO est le système de positionnement par satellites (radionavigation) mis en place par l'Union européenne (UE).

Le segment sol de mission (GMS, Galileo Mission Segment) est chargé de créer le message de navigation diffusé par le satellite (garant des performances des services), de détecter les éventuelles anomalies et d'en prévenir les utilisateurs (dans le message diffusé par les satellites), ainsi que de mesurer les performances du système.

Thales Alenia Space est responsable de l’ingénierie, du développement, de la qualification et du déploiement de ce segment de mission ainsi que du GSF (Galileo Security Facility).

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un/une Responsable de Migration/Mise en Opérations afin d’encadrer le déploiement des évolutions du GMS et du GSF sur les différentes chaines des sites opérationnels.

Vous aurez en charge les missions suivantes :

Définition de la stratégie de migration et participation aux réponses à appels d’offres :

- Rédaction de la stratégie de migration

Encadrement des activités de migration et gestion des plannings :

- Pilotage des CCR (Configuration Change Request) et des tests usines
- Pilotage des équipes techniques
- Pilotage des ressources (internes, sur site, ...) en adéquation avec les plannings
- Pilotage des livraisons documentaires et SW à destination des clients et fournisseurs
- Reporting au SDM (Service Delivery Manager)/EDM (Engineering Delivery Manager)

Gestion des risques associés aux activités :

- De déploiements/mises à jour (HW/SW)
- Techniques (préparation, répétition des séquences, …)
- Proposition, implémentation et suivi de mitigations

Négociation afin de sécuriser les jalons contractuels :

- Interne (déploiement, fourniture, disponibilité, …)
- Externe avec nos clients (dimension de représentation de Thales Alenia Space auprès de nos clients institutionnels ESA/EUSPA) et notre fournisseur représentant Thales Alenia Space sur les sites opérationnels (équipe IVQ Site)

Votre profil :

- Vous êtes diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur (Aéronautique / Spatial, Informatique, Electronique …) ou d'un parcours universitaire avec un Master 2 (BAC +5) avec une expérience significative et prouvée (5 ans minimum) en IVVQ de systèmes critiques complexes HW/SW.
- Vous savez mener à bien un Work Package de la phase de Bid à la mise en opérations
- Vos compétences en architecture software et infrastructures informatique vous permettent de comprendre le fonctionnement des plateformes hébergeant un système complexe à dominante logicielle
- Vous avez des compétences au niveau système : réseau, virtualisation, linux, infrastructure, administration système
- Vous faites preuve d'un fort leadership et êtes attentif au respect des délais et des coûts pour effectuer les tâches qui vous sont confiées
- Vous savez communiquer de manière efficace avec les parties prenantes dans le cadre d’un programme complexe
- Vous êtes familier avec les problématiques de cybersécurité
- Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais
- Une connaissance du système Galileo est un gros plus

Le poste nécessite une habilitation CUE (Confidentiel Union Européenne)

Des déplacements fréquents en Europe (Allemagne et Italie) sur les sites opérationnels sont nécessaires. Cela représente 15 à 20 missions par an soit 30 à 50% du temps.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

- Compétence technique approfondie sur plusieurs disciplines HW (électronique analogique et numérique (FPGA, Processeur)),

- Le dimensionnement de plateforme de calcul pour équipement embarqués : identification cœur processing (FPGA, microprocesseur, processeur) et périphériques (mémoires, oscillateur, flux de données)

- The Frameworks: Practical knowledge of EKF, UKF, Lie Group UKF, or Physics-Informed ML is highly advantageous.

- The Stack: Fluency across C++, MATLAB/Mathematica, and Python.

- The Background: Typically a Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, paired with few years of recent experience in low-TRL ASP/PNT research.

This is a high-visibility position where you will bridge the gap between breakthrough R&D, consortia collaboration, and business development. You will shape the technical roadmap, mentor emerging talent, and drive innovation where classical engineering meets the future of AI.

description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – driving this technology are our people.

Our Underwater Systems team are proud to support the Royal Australian Navy, providing integrated mission-critical solutions to below-surface platforms. With access to some of the world’s most advanced technologies, our people enable naval forces around the world with our state-of-the-art Sonar and undersea combat systems.

The Senior ILS Engineer will form part of the Engineering Support Team and is responsible for provision of Logistic Support Analysis services and deliverables in support of the Scylla Sonar suite deployed on the Collins Class Submarines under the Scylla In-Service Support (ISS) contract. The Senior ILS Engineer collaborates with stakeholders including Management, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply and Training functions as well as the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team.

BENEFITS @ THALES

- Competitive remuneration + Bonus + Medical Insurance
- Annualised Performance Review Process

YOUR ROLE
Located in Rydalmere, on Darug land, your role purpose will be:

- Leading ILS engineering tasks using approved plans, policies, procedures, tools and processes.

- Conducting supportability analysis to identify deficiencies with stock levels.

- Performing spares analysis and modelling to identify requirements for spares and repair parts.

- Managing the Failure Reporting and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) and conducting analysis to identify reliability issues.

- Managing the Allowance Parts List (APL) and Shipboard Allowance List (SAL).

- Submission of new part codification requests.

- Performing Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Testability (RAMT) analysis of Sonar and Towed Array systems.

- Building Reliability Block Diagrams and conducting Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA).

- Providing support for maintenance planning, using Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM), to identify predictive and preventive maintenance tasks.

- Supporting the engineering team with obsolescence studies.

- Identification of ILS products to support the development of ECPs and CCPs.

- Developing logistic support products and reports to meet the requirements of the Contract.

- Ensuring that ILS procedures, processes and work practices are sufficiently comprehensive to enable production of the ILS deliverables to the satisfaction of the Contract.

ABOUT YOU

To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:

- Tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in a relevant Engineering discipline.

- Formal qualifications in ILS preferred but not essential.

- Planning and executing the identification and development of logistics support and system requirements for military or maritime systems.

- Experience in performing logistic engineering tasks.

- Understanding contracted requirements and the application of technical specifications and standards.

- Aptitude and experience for interpreting technical engineering information (drawings and manuals)

- Experience in managing technical documentation life-cycles.

- Working knowledge of engineering lifecycles and Configuration Management requirements.

- Experience in an In-service Support (ISS) environment performing reliability studies, Maintenance Requirements Determination (MRD) or field service studies.

With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Key Responsibilities

- Repair Capability Setup & Industrial Engineering: Support repair operations within the Industrial Engineering function, with primary responsibility for establishing and maintaining repair capabilities. This includes reviewing maintenance documentation, validating test benches and tooling, and ensuring all required equipment and resources are available and fit for purpose.
- Maintenance Documentation Review & Validation: Review maintenance and repair documentation to ensure procedures, technical requirements, tooling, equipment and supporting information are complete, accurate and aligned with the required repair capability.
- Test Bench & Tooling Validation: Conduct checking, verification and validation of test benches, tools and equipment required for repair activities. Coordinate with relevant engineering and technical teams to ensure equipment is suitable and ready for operational use.
- Consumables Verification: Review and validate required chemicals, consumables and other repair materials, ensuring that specifications, quantities, storage requirements and usage requirements are properly defined and aligned with repair processes.
- Repair Capability Submission: Prepare and coordinate repair capability submissions, including the review and compilation of required maintenance documents, equipment, test benches, tools, chemicals and consumables for submission and approval.
- Central Engineering Coordination: Work closely with Central Engineering and supporting technical teams to identify and resolve discrepancies relating to maintenance documentation, tooling, test equipment, chemicals and consumables.
- Maintenance Document Modification: Coordinate with Central Engineering and other supporting teams to review, update and modify maintenance and repair documentation based on technical requirements, repair findings, engineering changes and operational feedback.
- Quality Documentation & Submission: Prepare the necessary technical documentation, supporting records and paperwork for submission to the Quality team for review, verification and approval. Ensure documentation is complete, accurate and submitted in accordance with established quality procedures.
- Procurement of Tools & Consumables: Identify requirements and coordinate the purchase of new tools, equipment, chemicals and consumables when necessary to establish, enhance or maintain repair capabilities.
- Discrepancy Resolution: Investigate and coordinate the resolution of discrepancies identified during document reviews, equipment/tool validation, consumables checks and repair capability assessments.
- Repair & Maintenance Support: Provide ongoing industrial engineering support to repair activities, including equipment and tooling maintenance, troubleshooting, validation and continuous improvement.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve repair processes, documentation, tooling, test equipment and consumable management to enhance repair capability, quality, reliability and operational efficiency

Requirement

- Min 3 years working experience in electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, Aerospace or MRO
- Similar repair capability set up experience (good to have)
- Able to perform under pressure and work with tight timeline.

The work is performed in multi-disciplinary agile teams with specialists in software/system/test engineering and functional design. {OPEN}

About the assignment

Background

At Thales, a project is currently ongoing to migrate away from the currently used Maven build system to Bazel for increased build performance, more granular caching, better parallelism and more deterministic artifacts. The current work for the Bazel migration project mainly consists of adopting or creating Bazel variants of the tools used within the different departments to build software components, systems and applications. One of these tools called Cucumber is used to run behavior driven integration tests. This is used to run containerized integration tests of software components using Podman containers in an environment similar to an actual deployment environment.

One of the advantages of Bazel is its highly efficient parallel execution of so-called actions, which include tests. However, this is currently conflicting with the limits of our integration test setup, mainly due to the limitations of Podman being single-threaded and non-reentrant which is at best unreliable when run in parallel, or will simply fail. This requires that parallel execution is disabled for these tests, significantly increasing build time and reducing part of the advantage that Bazel provides.

Assignment

It needs to be investigated what options are available within the closed Thales environment to fully parallelize containerized integration tests when using Bazel as the build system, Podman as the container orchestrator and Cucumber as the integration testing framework.

The goal for this assignment is to create a proof-of-concept of an improved testing infrastructure capable of running containerized integration tests in parallel. The PoC needs to adhere to the following:

Support Bazel as the build system (working with Maven is a nice to have)

Uses Podman as the container orchestrator

Uses the current testing infrastructure as a base

Uses Cucumber as the integration testing framework

No tests shall require the ‘exclusive’ flag, which forces given tests to run sequentially.

Ideally, no test shall require the ‘flaky’ flag, which executes a test ‘n’ number of times, where the test is considered as passed so long as one of the attempts passes. Since this is also highly dependent on the tests themselves, this is not a hard requirement.

{OPEN}

Linux, Open Source, Java/C++, OCI containers, Bazel, DevOps

IT Project Manager, Facilities and Real Estate Specialist

Position Summary

Thales is looking for an IT Project Manager, Facilities and Real Estate Specialist to be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of IT projects and initiatives, with a primary focus on Real Estate and Facilities-related efforts, including site openings and closures, renovations, workplace modernization, infrastructure enablement, and smart building technologies.

This role partners closely with internal stakeholders—including Real Estate, Corporate Security, Procurement, and IT functional teams—as well as external partners such as general contractors, subcontractors, telecom providers, and IT vendors to ensure seamless integration of technology into physical working environments.

In this position, while supporting a broader IT project portfolio, you will also be required to have deep experience in facilities-driven programs and serves as a subject matter expert for IT delivery of services in the context of various physical facility use cases including but not limited to new site fit up, renovations, as is moves, carve in and carve outs of business units. Success in this position depends on good working knowledge of site build & IT fit up processes, strong cross-functional coordination, effective vendor management, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards, governance, and financial objectives.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List, the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, the Canadian Industrial Security Program, the US International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the US Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access including eligibility to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program and able to obtain a Canadian NATO Secret clearance.

- Lead full lifecycle delivery (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure) of IT projects, with emphasis on Real Estate and Facilities initiatives (e.g., site builds, moves, upgrades); elicit & manage IT requirements (includes Business Stakeholder & Corporate IT requirements); define the project’s WBS and IT Work Packages; develop and manage detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, risk plans, and dependencies for both facilities and non-facilities projects; ensure alignment with enterprise PMO methodologies and governance standards.
