Context

The ITM Project aims to build a resilient and flexible ICT infrastructure that enhances business continuity and disaster recovery. It prioritizes replacing the legacy NS network with a modernized ITM Operational Network (ON) across the NATO Command Structure. The initiative transforms NATO’s IT operations from a decentralized model—characterized by distributed networks, server rooms, and local support—into a centralized approach with standardized services, centralized provisioning (IaaS), and a centralized ESOC managing infrastructure and service operations. This modernization enhances efficiency, security, and service consistency.

Job summary

The IVV ITM team role is to integrate and assure that the new features, requirements and bug fixes are implemented correctly (no new defects were introduced from one release to another). You will receive and analyze Dev team delivery (to accept or reject based on specific criteria), integrate the delivery following installation procedure on reference platform based in NATO facilities (Integration can be either remotely and/or in NATO facilities).

Responsibilities:

- Understand and clarify, if needed, any requirements related to testing new features and/or bug fix

- Create manual and automated tests for the ITM platform

- Create / Update test cases and associated tests data in order to test the new features and/or bug fix (manual and automated)

- Run test cases (manual and automated) during the testing phase of each release (enhancement releases, patches…)

- Investigate when problems occur during the tests in order to precisely define what the problem is (a bug, a wrong installation on tests platforms, inconsistency among test data and/or test sheet…) and synchronize with FRANCE team to share information and take the relevant actions and resume the activities

- Monitor and reports on the progress of tests activities using appropriate quality assurance processes to ensure that projects are carried out in accordance with agreed standards, methods and procedures

- Testing existing system processes and provide recommendations for improvements

- Meeting with key stakeholders to determine business system needs and requirements

- Conducting and reporting on technical and business analyses

- Assessing new software requirements and features for compatibility with current systems

- Ensuring product quality throughout the development process

- Integrate/commissioning from NATO facilities

- Support project deployment

- Capacity to move for several days/weeks (depending project phases) to NATO facilities

Testing in order to validate the customer requirements

All of the tests will be automated -> automation skills -> CI/CD chain

- Terraform – nice to have

- Palo Alto firewall -> same: no need to configure it manually as the tests + deployments it will be automated, having previous experiences is required to design test cases - Mandatory
- NSX – Nice to have

- Python - nice to have

Knowledge of the technologies used - Mandatory

The knowledge on how to deploy by hand - Mandatory

- Self-driver

- Proactive, problem solver

- Team player

- Highly proficient in spoken and written English

- NS clearance

- Very flexible to travel (between France, Belgium, Netherland)

- Command line configuration of applications running under Linux

- French

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Junior Project Buyer to be responsible for coordinating and executing procurement activities for assigned projects, ensuring all goods and services are sourced to meet project specifications, timelines, and budgetary requirements. This role manages the full purchase cycle, engages in supplier negotiations, fosters supplier relationships, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to support project goals while adhering to company policies and ethical standards.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and /or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Request-to-Order Fulfilment (PR to PO):

• Receive, review, and process internal purchase requisitions (PR) for project-specific goods and services in accordance with company policies and requirements.

• Convert PRs into accurate and compliant purchase orders (PO), verifying commodity codes, ship-to locations, supplier information, and required documentation (with guidance as needed).

• Check PO details for completeness and compliance before release (e.g., contractual/quality requirements, lead times, and ordering constraints).

• Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders to clarify PR/PO details and resolve discrepancies.

Sourcing & RFx/RFP Administration:

• Support sourcing activities for project requirements, including assisting with RFx/RFP documentation and coordination.

• Help organize and administer RFx/RFP communications (e.g., issuing documents, collecting responses, and maintaining supporting records).

• Support local negotiations as delegated, ensuring outcomes are accurately reflected in PO terms and documentation.

PO Management, Expediting & Delivery Tracking:

• Manage PO administration end-to-end, including PO creation, PO acknowledgment follow-up, and maintaining order records.

• Proactively expedite and track purchase orders to support on-time delivery and adherence to contractual terms and quality standards.

• Monitor delivery progress and identify risks such as delays, backorders, or incomplete confirmations; escalate as required.

• Provide timely updates to internal stakeholders on order status, delivery commitments, and expected changes.

Supplier Coordination & Issue Resolution:

• Liaise with suppliers to secure PO acknowledgment and delivery commitments and maintain strong supplier relationships.

• Support resolution of order discrepancies, supplier disputes, and delivery/invoicing issues; escalate significant matters to the Supply Chain Manager, Category Buyers/Managers, or Procurement Project Managers.

• Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to manage changes, cancellations, or amendments to POs when required.

Invoice Resolution & Supplier Support (with AP/Finance):

• Support invoice resolution by following up on supplier queries, missing information, or discrepancies impacting PO/invoice matching.

• Liaise with suppliers to obtain accurate and timely invoice details as needed, and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolution.

• Support accounts payable follow-ups on outstanding or missing invoices, maintaining clear records of communications and actions.

Reporting, Cost/Status Monitoring & Continuous Improvement:

• Monitor and report on purchasing activities, including open order status, basic cost/status tracking, and visibility of sourcing opportunities (with guidance).

• Support KPI tracking and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Supply Chain Manager.

• Identify process improvement opportunities (e.g., reducing cycle time, improving data quality) and contribute to implementing best practices.

Compliance, Documentation & System Support (ERP/SAP):

• Maintain accurate documentation and records to support audit readiness and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO quality standards, defense regulatory requirements, and Thales policies).

• Support ERP/SAP-related procurement activities, including maintaining master/order data and participating in process or functionality upgrades.

• Uphold ethical standards and ensure compliance in all purchasing activities in accordance with Thales policies.

• Support additional supply chain department activities as required.

Minimum Qualifications

- The candidate must meet one of the following criteria sets (a&b or c&d):

a) possess a high school diploma; and

b) possess a minimum of 5 years of demonstrated experience in the field of administration

c) possess a university degree in any field and possess a minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 5 years; or possess a diploma from a recognized college program in procurement, finance, economics, commerce, accounting or materiel management and possess a minimum of 18 months of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 6 years; and

d) possess a minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity in the federal government, either as a civilian or military Crown employee or as a contractor personnel through extensive experience dealing with the federal government.

- Proven experience in supply chain operations, financial/accounting, order management.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in supply chain management or financial/accounting software experience (SAP) and MS Office Suite.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written english.
- Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments and with external suppliers.
- Problem-solving mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Purchasing or Financial Certification and/or 5 years of applicable experience; and
- Previous experience in the Defense Industry;

Special Position Requirements

- Role will require working from both home and office (hybrid).
- Schedule: 40 working hours per week Monday- Friday. Flexible time, however, accommodating core hours of 9am-3 pm, project needs and global/international time zones.

Management, RH & Leadership (50%)

Life Cycle and Materiel Manager (LCMM) – Combat Systems Specialist

Position Summary

Thales Canada is looking for a Life Cycle and Materiel Manager (LCMM) – Combat Systems Specialist to support its non-Combatant In-Service Support Programs for the Royal Canadian Navy.

The LCMM – Combat Systems Specialist is responsible for engineering support and technical oversight of various systems including but not limited to Navigation Systems, Communications Systems, Command and Control systems, Data processing systems, Above water and underwater sensor systems and Ship’s weapons systems, on board the various platforms of the Royal Canadian Navy. Accountable to the Operational Support Manager and working directly with various internal and external stakeholders, this role manages various activities to establish and maintain the configuration and design intent of the marine auxiliary and other mechanical systems on the ships and manage any changes through their end-of-life and divestment.

The successful candidate will leverage their existing knowledge and expertise in marine mechanical systems and equipment to become a subject matter expert and main point of contact for all technical matters associated with the systems assigned thereto. The principal objective is to maximize effectiveness and efficiency, while minimizing the Life Cycle Cost (LCC) associated with the support of their systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility

The key functions and areas of responsibility for the LCMM – Combat Systems Specialist include but is not limited to:

- Performing Life Cycle and Materiel Management functions including but not limited to equipment obsolescence, material compatibility issues, alternate part investigations, maintenance management, and disposal management;
- Supporting and managing activities associated with the design and configuration control of the vessels including conducting functional and physical configuration audits, as well as deviations and waivers documentation;
- Providing technical advice to enable auxiliary and mechanical equipment and/or systems to be correctly operated or maintained;
- Monitoring systems and equipment performance through various reports such as but not limited to Unsatisfactory Condition Reports (UCRs), Pre-installation failures (PIFs) and technical investigations (TIs) conducted by the customer;
- Ensuring proper level of spares are maintained throughout the life of the systems and equipment; support the cataloguing process;
- Conducting technical investigations into problems associated with combat systems, equipment and/or software issues, including failure analysis and solution recommendation;
- Developing and reviewing technical documentation including equipment specifications, installation and maintenance instructions, test and trials agendas, and engineering change documentation and drawings;
- Analyzing requirements associated with baseline changes to the ships configuration, equipment and software;
- Liaise with OEMs, Service Providers and ship staff to support the investigation and resolution of defects;
- Preparing documented work scopes, suitable for the solicitation of quotations from external resources such as OEMs, manufacturers, suppliers, testing facilities or specialist service providers; and
- Preparing and managing Work Packages and cost estimates for customer approval.

Minimum Requirements

- 3-year technical program diploma (for Technologists) or 2-year technical program diploma (for Technicians) in a marine technical field offered by a recognized technical institute; or
- Certified a technologist or technician by a recognized provincial, state, or federal (national) licensing body in a relevant field or certified body; or
- Certified as one of the following technical trades of the Canadian Armed Forces:
- QL6B Naval Electronics Technician
- RQPO1 WEng Tech

- Possess a minimum 8 years of demonstrated professional work experience in the naval, marine, or offshore industry within the last 15 years;
- Extensive knowledge of combat systems and equipment
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite;
- Familiar with safety standards;
- Strong communication skills (oral and written);
- Language: English (Essential).

Preferred Qualifications

- Minimum 10 years of experience as a Technical Specialist with marine with marine communications, navigation or naval combat systems;
- Previous experience with the Royal Canadian Navy or Canadian Coast Guard;
- Previous experience as a Life Cycle Materiel Manager in the communications, navigation or naval combat systems field;
- Demonstrated project management experience;
- Familiar with the Department of National Defense (DND) maintenance management and implementation system “DRMIS”;
- Experience in delivering marine in-service support of operational assets; and
- Familiar with certification requirements including but not limited to Classification Society, SOLAS/IMO, IEEE, CSA, Naval Ship Code, and DND regulations.

Physical Demands

- Predominantly office work but will be required to occasionally travel to and work in dockyards and onboard Naval ships
- May be required to undertake inspections on Naval ships which may involve involving bending and twisting, and working aloft

Special Position Requirements

- Schedule: 40 hours per week
- Travel: Occasional domestic or international travel may be required in support of the ships

description:

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages

- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Situé à proximité d'Orléans, le site est une référence dans le soutien des systèmes d'armes et radars dans le monde. Il abrite des activités d’ingénierie, de développement et d'intégration de systèmes de défense aérienne.

Le logisticien assure une ou plusieurs activités de la logistique : la réception, stockage des composants et des équipements à réparer, approvisionnement des lignes, manutention et/ou stockage des produits réparés, préparation des expéditions.

A ce titre vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

- Réaliser la réception administrative (contrôler le bordereau de livraison par rapport à la commande passée).
- Décharger le camion et orienter la destination des pièces
- Transporter les pièces entre les batiments en garantissant la tracabilité.
- Assurer la gestion et la manutention des pièces, composants, matériaux et sous-ensembles en magasin.
- Réaliser des opérations d'entrées et de sorties magasin (physique & logique) et les formaliser dans le système ERP.
- Réaliser des inventaires.
- Prélever les produits fabriqués et les transporter sur le lieu de stockage ou d'attente spécifié dans le système (ERP).
- Rassembler l'ensemble des documents nécessaires à la réception chez le client.
- Réaliser la mise en conditionnement suivant une gamme prédéfinie.
- Réaliser les activités de chargements.
- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes terrain et les prestataires externes pour anticiper et résoudre les problèmes logistiques en étant force de proposition (prise de hauteur).
- Participer à l’analyse des indicateurs de performance (délais, non-conformités, retours) ainsi que leur animation en AIC.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de coordination logistique ainsi qu’à la standardisation des pratiques.

Votre profil

Vous justifiez d'une expérience professionnelle préalable d' au moins 2 ans en logistique, gestion des stocks ou Supply Chain dans un contexte industriel ou commercial ?

Vous possédez idéalement une expérience en industrie aéronautique ?

title: Machine Technician
description:
Location: Belfast, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales people architect solutions that are relied upon to deliver operational advantage at every decisive moment throughout the mission. Defence and armed forces customers rely on us to deliver the full range of defensive systems for land, sea, and air. From early warning, to threat neutralisation, our platforms cover all levels from very short-range systems, to extended protection across the entire battle-space including Airspace Mobility Solutions, Vehicles and Tactical Systems and Missile Defence, Optronics, and Radar.

Together we offer fantastic opportunities for committed employees to learn and develop their career with us. At Thales UK, we research, develop, and supply technology and services that impact the lives of millions of people each day to make life better, and keep us safer. We innovate across the major industries of Aerospace, Defence, Security and Space. Your health and well-being matters to us and that’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, home working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times. Where possible, we support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions.

Join Thales as a Machine Technician – Be Part of Innovation in Manufacturing!

POSITION: Manufacturing Technician
DEPARTMENT: Manufacturing
LOCATION: Belfast

Our Opportunity

As a CNC Machinist, you will support lead the manufacture and inspection of high precision components, sub-assemblies, tooling and fixtures in a total quality team environment in order to meet production schedules and requirements.

About You

As a Machine Technician, you will ideally have served an apprenticeship as a turner or skilled machinist and with proven post apprenticeship experience with mill/turn or multi-axis being advantageous.

To be successful in this role, you will already have the ability to understand information given on technical drawings and apply that information in the programming and in the operation of CNC machine tools.

Key Duties

- Responsible for the set-up and operation of major plant equipment within a high volume production environment i.e. C.N.C. machine tools in order to manufacture high precision missile components, Tooling, Gauging, Jig and fixture details and R&D hardware.
- Shop Floor programming using M.D.I. and G codes to produce C.N.C. programmes for the manufacture of R&D hardware and Tooling and to edit C.N.C. part programmes during prove out and production runs and to ensure any changes are fed back to manufacturing engineering to maintain traceability.
- Responsible for the step by step prove out of program by diagnosing errors therein to prevent damage to plant equipment and ensure correct manufacture of components.
- Responsible for recording data on statistical process control (S.P.C.) data base units or control charts. Monitoring and analysing such data to resolve problems in controlling the machining process.
- Responsible for calibration/plausibility checks on post process gauging (P.P.G) to assure correct part measurements.
- Responsible for the quality of machine components to drawing specification and quality standards, using meteorology equipment and to ensure equipment is within calibration requirements.
- Accountable for own productivity and quality and the recording any necessary quality defect data on factory management system (F.M.S.) to facilitate traceability.
- Responsible for progressing finished components to other work groups by actively participating in materials handling and processing correct progress data on the factory management system (F.M.S.)
- Responsible for identifying any errors found within process sheets and measurement plans and to ensure any such errors are reported to M.E. for correction.
- Responsibility to work in a continuous improvement environment to achieve maintain and improve product quality and to strive to reduce machining cycle times, lead time and production costs.
- Detailed training of other employees and apprentices in the most effective methods of performing tasks & duties.

​​Why Thales?

- By joining us, you become part of a global powerhouse at the forefront of aerospace, defence, and security technologies. We offer you:
- A supportive, inclusive workplace where your contributions make a difference.
- Opportunities to develop your skills with expert training and clear career pathways.
- The chance to work on impactful projects that protect and connect communities worldwide.
- A company culture grounded in innovation, collaboration, and respect.

What we can offer

- 4 day working week
- Pension Scheme
- 28 days annual leave (Plus Bank Holidays)
- Progression and Development Opportunities
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

You will be supported by an additional ongoing training program over 2-3 years on steadily larger and more complex jobs to meet the manufacturing and quality requirements in line with the total quality concept.

Please note current working hours are due to change and any successful applicants must be open to future shift patterns.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
At Thales, we know technology has the ability to make our world more secure, sustainable, and inclusive – and that it’s all driven by human intelligence.

Because it takes human intelligence to build and power the systems and solutions that people depend on every day. So we stay curious and make space for diverse points of view. We share what we know and we challenge what’s possible.

From manufacturing and engineering to cybersecurity and space, we’re driving progress in some of the world’s most important industries – and working together to build a future we can all trust.

OUR BENEFITS

Competitive remuneration + Super

Fitness Passport Discount – Access to a network of Gyms across AUS from $15 P/W

Employee discounts with a number of affiliates (Travel, Car hire, Tech, Medical Insurance)

Modernised Paid Parental Leave

Veterans Leave

Novated Lease options

Personal & professional training development opportunities

Sonder – Wellbeing & Support Partner

OUR TEAM

Our Munitions teams in Benalla and Mulwala produce propellants, explosives and munitions for defence and commercial uses. With ongoing investment into research and development, we produce some of the world’s most high-performing guided weapons and explosive ordnance systems. And being at the forefront of a rapidly evolving industry gives our teams constant opportunities to build on their technical expertise.

YOUR ROLE

Acting as the 2IC to the Maintenance Manager, you will support the leadership and coordination of maintenance operations, ensuring safe and efficient site performance.

- Lead and mentor a high-performing team with focus on safety and compliance
- Coordinate maintenance and IWT activities and resources to achieve production targets, asset reliability and contractual commitments
- Drive HSE compliance and asset management best practices across maintenance and IWT operations, and contractor activities
- Manage maintenance systems and planning processes
- Champion continuous improvement initiatives, incident investigations and corrective actions to enhance operational outcomes

YOUR EXPERIENCE

- Trade or Engineering qualification with significant maintenance experience in a manufacturing, industrial or similarly complex environment
- Proven experience leading teams and delivering maintenance programs
- Strong understanding of safety, compliance and reliability methodologies
- Demonstrated ability to lead change, influence stakeholders and drive continuous improvement initiatives
- Experience using CMMS platforms and Microsoft Office

AUSTRALIAN DEFENCE ROLES & SECURITY

A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

description:

Marine Surveyor

Halifax, N.S., (CAN.), Hybrid

Position Summary

We have a current vacancy for a Marine Surveyor to join our team supporting Royal Canadian Navy Non-Combatant In-Service Support Programs on Canada’s East Coast.

The Marine Surveyor will be responsible for providing project management and technical support to various Royal Canadian Navy Non-Combatant Platforms managed by Thales under its In-Service Support contracts.

In this position, you will work closely with the Thales LCMM, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams to support the planning and execution of ship surveys and inspections. You will be responsible for preparing survey reports, repair specifications, and other technical documentation required to support vessel certification and configuration management. You will also provide technical guidance and support for maintenance, repair, and certification activities, ensuring effective coordination between Royal Canadian Navy stakeholders and Thales teams to maintain vessel operational readiness and compliance.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility

The Marine Surveyor will report to the Engineering Services Manager and support the planning and execution of ship surveys, certification activities, and configuration management initiatives across Royal Canadian Navy Non-Combatant Platforms. This includes, but is not limited to:

- Supporting the planning and execution of Classification Society surveys, certification activities, and related compliance requirements in collaboration with the Thales Certification Officer and Engineering teams.
- Planning and conducting pre-docking surveys, Annual Condition Surveys, and other vessel inspections, while preparing associated survey reports in accordance with DND and Classification Society requirements.
- Supporting the development of docking specifications, work packages, technical proposals, and scopes of work to facilitate maintenance, repair, and certification activities.
- Developing repair plans and technical specifications for hull, mechanical, and equipment repairs, while providing technical support for vessel certification and configuration management requirements.
- Preparing and reviewing technical documentation, baseline configuration records, and engineering work scopes for external suppliers, OEMs, repair facilities, and specialist service providers.
- Identifying opportunities for process improvement within Engineering and Certification Management activities, applying lessons learned from previous surveys and dockings, and providing technical analysis and recommendations for equipment and system issues.

Minimum Qualifications

The candidate must meet each of the following criteria:

- A diploma in a marine-related technical discipline from a recognized technical institute, certification as a technologist or technician through a recognized licensing body, or equivalent qualifications obtained through relevant Canadian Armed Forces marine technical trades.
- A minimum of eight years of professional experience within the marine or offshore sector, including at least five years of experience in vessel surveying, maintenance, repair, or certification activities supporting commercial or military fleets.
- Previous experience as a Marine Surveyor with a Classification Society, the Royal Canadian Navy, or a comparable marine organization supporting vessel inspection and certification activities.
- Demonstrated experience planning, managing, and executing ship dockings, dry dock refits, vessel inspections, and associated maintenance programs.
- Strong knowledge of Classification Society rules and regulations (including Lloyd’s Register, ABS, and DNV), as well as familiarity with IACS, IMO, SOLAS, Naval Ship Classification Rules, and Commercial Ship Rules.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare technical reports, develop repair specifications, and effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience managing ship repair, engineering change, and vessel maintenance projects within commercial, government, or military marine environments.
- Experience supporting the design, testing, certification, and maintenance of shipboard lifting appliances, including marine cranes and associated equipment.
- Familiarity with vessel weight and stability management, including weight calculations, lightship surveys, inclining experiments, and stability assessments.
- Knowledge of applicable marine regulatory frameworks and standards, including the International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code) and ANEP 77 (Naval Ship Code).
- Previous experience supporting the Royal Canadian Navy, Canadian Coast Guard, or other government maritime organizations, including the delivery of in-service support for operational marine assets.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal; proficiency in French is considered an asset.

Special Position Requirements

- Schedule: 40 hours per week.
- Physical Environment: Hybrid position requiring a mix of work from home and onsite support, including office locations and onboard Royal Canadian Navy vessels at waterfront facilities.
- Travel: Occasional domestic and international travel may be required in support of vessel surveys, inspections, and other program activities
- Work Location: Combination of office-based work and site visits to shipyards, waterfront facilities, and naval vessels as required.
- Transportation: Personal transportation is required to travel between home, office, waterfront, and shipyard locations.

- Vérifier la cohérence du Plan de Production et du plan d’approvisionnement pour les ressources critiques.

- Identifier toute dérive de la réponse industrielle aux besoins clients, remonter les alertes majeures et proposer des scénarios alternatifs.

PREVISIONNEL DES APPROVISIONNEMENTS

- Décliner les besoins de pièces vers les Achats et Planificateurs pour établir le plan d'approvisionnement.

AMELIORATION CONTINUE

- Valoriser l'impact de ces différents scénarios correctifs, sur les VEX (Valeur d'Exploitation).
- Analyser les indicateurs Supply Chain de son périmètre et piloter les actions menant à leur amélioration.

- Maîtrise du processus Supply Chain et des flux Industriels.
- Maîtrise du processus S&OP.
- Maîtrise des processus de Production et de Réparation.

- Mise en œuvre des outils de l’amélioration continue et de pilotage.
- Connaissance des techniques d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
- Maîtrise de l’anglais

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

In Ditzingen erwarten Sie Sicherheitslösungen zur Überwachung und Absicherung von Grenzen und Grenzkontrollen, für den Schutz ziviler und militärischer Einrichtungen sowie für die taktische Kommunikation. Ihre Mission:

- Entwicklung und Untersuchung eines neuartigen Chip-Placement-Ansatzes basierend auf strömungsmechanischer und thermodynamischer Modellierung
- Modellierung von Chipbausteinen als wärmeabgebende Partikel in einem zweidimensionalen Fluid unter Berücksichtigung von Wärmeleitung und Fluiddynamik (Navier-Stokes-Gleichungen)
- Berechnung eines thermodynamischen Gleichgewichts, das die Entropie maximiert und so die Plazierung der Bausteine optimiert
- Implementierung und Validierung numerischer Verfahren zur Lösung des globalen Placement-Problems und Analyse der Auswirkungen auf Chip-Performance

Darauf freuen wir uns:

- Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mathematik, Physik, Luft- und Raumfahrt an der Universität Stuttgart
- Interesse an Chipdesign, numerischer Simulation und Optimierung
- Erste Kenntnisse in Strömungsmechanik, Wärmeleitung, Navier-Stokes-Gleichungen oder verwandten Gebieten von Vorteil
- Programmiererfahrung (z. B. Python, MATLAB, C++ oder vergleichbare Sprachen)
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Betreuung ITLR: Prof. Dr.-Ing. Bernhard Weigand

title: Mid Billing Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania
Job Description — SRE Billing

Who are we?

S3NS was created through an industrial partnership between Thales, a global leader in cybersecurity, and Google Cloud, a global leader in cloud solutions. Our ambition is to offer the best of both worlds to organizations concerned with protecting sensitive data, including public institutions, Critical Infrastructure Operators (OIVs), and Essential Service Operators (OSEs). We provide a cloud solution equivalent to Google Cloud Platform (including both GCP IaaS and PaaS services) while meeting the requirements of the SecNumCloud certification.

The Trusted Cloud offering has been generally available in France since October 2025. Google deploys GCP services in a region fully operated by S3NS, including hardware, software, and networking. S3NS has also built a private PaaS hosting S3NS's administrative information system. This consists of all the services required to secure end-customer sensitive data, such as encryption and root-of-trust management, Google source-code inspection, and identity management.

Responsibilities:

This is a hybrid role. The successful candidate will be responsible for operating native Cloud Billing components, including APIs, BigQuery exports, and quotas, within a strict security framework. They will also maintain the internal billing engine that processes raw data to meet the specific requirements of a trusted cloud environment, including re-billing, margins, and sovereignty controls.

Operations & Reliability (SRE)

- Operational Maintenance (MCO): Ensure the availability and performance of billing data export pipelines to BigQuery.
- Billing Observability: Build monitoring and alerting dashboards to identify consumption anomalies, such as cost spikes, and verify the integrity of incoming data.
- Security & Compliance: Ensure that billing data is properly isolated and audited in accordance with trusted-cloud requirements, including encryption and local controls.

Billing Engine Engineering

- Development: Maintain and enhance the internal billing engine that transforms raw Cloud Provider data into "Sovereign" customer invoices.
- FinOps Automation: Develop scripts in Python/Go to automate billing-related functions, such as applying discounts (CUDs), taxes, and specific support fees.
- Data Quality: Design automated data-quality tests to detect discrepancies between actual consumption and billing, such as duplicate records or missing SKUs.

Skills

- Public Cloud: Advanced knowledge of a cloud platform, ideally GCP, and its billing system, including SKUs, pricing models, and credits.
- Data & SQL: Strong SQL skills, particularly BigQuery, for processing large volumes of billing data.
- Development: Ability to code in Go for pipeline automation.
- Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform skills for deploying billing-related resources.
- FinOps: Understanding of CUD (Committed Usage Discounts) mechanisms and cloud cost structures.

Personal Skills

- Extreme attention to detail: Billing cannot tolerate approximation, as it has a direct impact on revenue and customer trust.
- Ethics & Discretion: Ability to handle sensitive financial data.
- Intellectual curiosity: Ability to perform deep functional analysis and understand every line item of consumption.
- Ability to synthesize: Ability to translate complex technical data into clear financial reports.

Technical Environment

- Stack: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Grafana, Metabase
- Tools: Terraform, GitHub/GitLab CI, Python, DBT (Data Build Tool)
- Context: SecNumCloud / Sovereignty / High Security / Billing Management

Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager

Position Summary

Thales Canada Defence & Security (TCDS) is looking for a Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager to provide resource management to the Naval Architecture team.

The Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager provides Naval Architecture leadership and support for Thales Canada’s ongoing projects throughout their respective life cycles; from requirements analysis and design, through development, integration, test and acceptance.

The Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager supports the Manager, Naval Architecture in inspiring and catalyzing the improvement of best practices, processes, tools and governance within the Naval Architecture discipline, ensuring that they are effectively deployed, mastered, and continuously improved.

They act as a primary point of contact on complex subjects and take on an educational role so that their team can reach discipline excellence and deliver competitive solutions within a multidisciplinary environment. They are a mentor and coach - serving the discipline’s engineers and offering a diverse and inclusive environment. They are the guardians of an engineering discipline excellence in a learning environment which contribute to our highly competitive advantage.

The Naval Architecture Sub-Discipline Manager reports to the Manager, Naval Architecture.

Key Areas of Responsibility

The main responsibilities are:

As a Resource Manager,

- Coordinate appropriate resources to deliver bids, projects and products;
- Plans the team’s workload in the short, medium and long term;
- Develops team skills to support bids, projects and products;
- Supports recruitment, onboarding, performance management, career management and succession planning for the team;
- Coaches, mentors and develops the team;
- Leads the team to meet company expectations for productivity, chargeability, quality, continuous improvement and accomplishment of objectives;
- Ensures that company policies and procedures are followed, including timesheets, time off, and travel;

- In the establishment, standardization and evolution of processes, procedures and tooling for the discipline
- In ensuring that the discipline processes, procedures and tooling meet the current and future needs of the bids, projects and products
- In the development of lessons learned and the sharing of knowledge and experience across the discipline
- Foster continuous improvement based on root cause analysis, problem solving and new practice deployment
- For developing bid, project and product estimates for the discipline and sub-disciplines

As a member of the Naval Architecture team

- Performing Life Cycle and Materiel Management functions for platforms including but not limited to new vessel addition, obsolescence, environmental assessment, and vessel disposal management.

- Prepare stability calculations for vessels undergoing towing and docking evolutions.
- Prepare documented work scopes suitable for solicitation of quotations from external resources such as OEM’s, manufacturers, suppliers, repair and testing facilities, or specialist service providers.
- Prepare technical proposals and cost estimates for Customer approval.
- Development and review of Engineering plans, processes and procedures.
- Assure compliance with applicable standards including SOLAS, Classification Society, and Naval Ship Code.

- An engineering degree or technical program diploma in Naval Architecture or a related technical field from a recognized university or college program;
- Expertise with industry standard Naval Architecture tools and standards (SOLAS, LSA, ISO, IACS, etc.);
- A minimum of 2 years of experience as a people or resource manager;

- A Master’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field
- Professional Engineer (P. Eng) designation (or eligibility for licensure in a Canadian province)
- Experience in the Defence industry
- Familiarity with shipboard installation practices, naval classification society expectations, and platform integration constraints.
- Fluency in French
- Recent experience responsible for a Naval Architecture team and/or Naval Architecture functions;

- Travel: Occasional national and international travel. About 4 times per year.

title: Obsolescence Manager
description:
Location: Templecombe, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

UK Services is a holistic life cycle process through which the combination of management and engineering actions necessary to assure effective and economical through-life support of a system or capability are accomplished as an integral part of the acquisition process.

The Obsolescence Management function within UK Services has cross-domain responsibilities.

Obsolescence Management activities are aimed at ensuring that Obsolescence is managed as an integral part of the whole product life cycle, in order to minimize the obsolescence risk and hence cost and detrimental impact.

Based Crawley or Templecombe - Hybrid working arrangement: 3 days per week on site (based on full time hours )

Primary Purpose of the role

Normally based on the Project Site, the primary purpose of the Obsolescence Manager Role is to:

Manage the obsolescence activities to minimise risk to the Project(s) and to deliver coherent and relevant Obsolescence Plans and Reports on time, within budget and meeting quality standards.

Interface between the Component Engineering function and the Project team and its customers.

Core tasks and responsibilities

- Issue the obsolescence deliverables on time, within budget, and in accordance with specified contractual requirements. The Obsolescence Manager shall ensure that all obsolescence-related documents delivered to the customer are published in the company Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. He/she is responsible for managing the document review process.

- Manage the Work Package(s) budget and resources he/she is accountable for. He/she shall ensure that the required resources are allocated in the company Programme Management tool.

- Define and maintain the obsolescence strategy on related equipments covered by the Project(s) he/she is responsible for, flow-down that strategy internally and to suppliers via the Subcontract Management function and monitor obsolescence accordingly.

- Regularly report progress on his/her Work Package(s) to the relevant Project Manager(s) and Functional Management as required.

- Pro-actively monitor obsolescence issues (current or forecasted) affecting the programme(s) he/she is responsible for and recommend appropriate mitigation activities and managing the LTB procurement process as necessary.

- Liaise with customers (internal and external) to ensure that expectations are aligned;

- Risk identification, management and reporting to the Project Manager;

- Additional Project-specific activities and responsibilities as agreed with the Project and Functional Managers.

Project Specific Tasks and Responsibilities

The role may additionally have need for Project-specific skills and experience as agreed with Project and Functional Management.

Qualifications & Experience Required

- Engineering degree or HND in a numerate discipline.

- Microsoft Office (mandatory). Microsoft Office (mandatory): Strong proficiency beyond basic usage, including experience with macros and advanced Excel functionalities.

- Relevant experience preferred.

- The experience required depends on the size and exposure of the programme(s). But, as a minimum, an experience of one year in one of the following domains is required: Programme Management; Programme Control; Work Package Management; UK SERVICES; Engineering

- Experience in the obsolescence domain is not necessary but is preferred.

Security Clearance Requirement:
Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a sole British National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats.. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.
To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.
Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. description:

Our Team

Our Air Mobility Solutions team creates, develops and deploys air management systems that are critical for safe aircraft movement. With products covering 40% of the world’s airspace, we enable the safe take-off and landing of 2 in 3 aircrafts globally. We offer the opportunity to work on complex systems that push what’s possible in air traffic management including drone technology with room to grow in both technical and team-leading roles.

Your Role

As an On-site Integrator Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of platform deployment, integration, and validation for critical systems.

This is a permanent full-time position and involves regular travel across Australia to deploy and integrate subsystems at customer sites.

This hands-on, technical role involves:

- Onsite hardware and software deployment (racks, switches, servers) and troubleshooting
- Automating deployments using Ansible, Jenkins, Python, and CI/CD pipelines
- Validating Thales-developed operating systems and subsystems before handover to validation teams
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams (network, cybersecurity, DevOps) to resolve complex issues
- Ensuring compliance with functional, performance, security, and robustness requirements
- Ideal for engineers who enjoy fixing systems, automating workflows, and thriving in dynamic environments

Key Responsibilities:

- Install, configure, and validate Thales operating systems and subsystems on-site
- Ensure seamless integration of 6-8 subsystems into Thales-developed environments
- Conduct integration testing, performance assessments, and security checks
- Resolve Linux/Unix, Windows, and virtualized environment issues (VMWare, Proxmox)
- Use Wireshark, Zabbix, and scripting (Python/Shell) for diagnostics
- Leverage Ansible playbooks, CI/CD pipelines, and Git for efficient deployments
- Automate system administration tasks and test/measurement tools
- Work with hardware teams, validation teams, and remote support to ensure system readiness
- Produce integration test reports, risk assessments, and knowledge-sharing artifacts
- Uphold Thales’ OHSE policies

Your Experience

On day one in this role, we'll expect you to bring the following skills, experience and behaviours:

- 2+ years integrating complex software-centric real-time systems

- Linux/Unix expertise (VMWare, SNMP, RSYSLOG) and Windows administration

- Scripting (Python, Shell) and automation tools (Ansible, Jenkins).

- Network fundamentals (TCP/IP, UDP, SNMP) and debugging tools

- Experience with C++, Java, or Go

- Familiarity AI-driven automation highly regarded
- Problem-solving mindset, you thrive in dynamic, on-site environments

- Strong communication skills to explain technical issues to diverse stakeholders

- Team player to collaborate across global teams with a curious and accountable approach

- Domestic travel is mandatory as part of the role

Australian Defence Roles & Security

A Defence security clearance is required for this role, applicants must be Australian citizens and eligible to obtain and maintain an appropriate clearance.

Additional information with regards to clearances is available from the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website http://www.defence.gov.au/AGSVA/. In some cases, individuals who hold a current clearance from a foreign government may be eligible to have this clearance recognised by the Australian Government and be eligible for this role.The Australian Defence Trade Controls Act (DTCA) is applicable and as such, your nationality may be a factor in determining your suitability for this role.

title: Pick & Place operator
description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

About us

Actief in de sectoren Aerospace, Defense en Security is Thales Nederland met ruim 2.500 medewerkers de topaanbieder van hightech banen. Productinnovatie en snel inspelen op de nieuwste technologische mogelijkheden zijn onze drijfveren. Spraakmakende producten zijn radar-, communicatie- en command & control systemen voor marineschepen en communicatie-, beveiligings- en betaalsystemen voor het bedrijfsleven. Thales Nederland is onderdeel van de Thales Group met 68.000 werknemers in ruim 50 landen en behoort daarmee tot de grootste elektronicabedrijven van Europa.

Binnen het cluster Naval Industrial Competence center in Hengelo is de afdeling RSA (Radar subassemblies) verantwoordelijk voor de productie en het testen van elektronische en mechanische subassemblages en eindproducten voor de Luchtvaart en Marine. Deze complexe producten en systemen bevatten geavanceerde oplossingen op het gebied van informatieverwerking, informatiemanagement, gebruikersinteractie en sensoraansturing. Voor de afdeling RSA zijn wij op zoek naar een Pick & Place Operator/monteur.

welke onder andere verantwoordelijk is voor het monteren van mechanische en elektronische producten met behulp van verschillende procesmachines behorende bij het Pick & Place proces (Pastajetten, component plaatsing, soldering en schoonmaken). Daarnaast help je mee met het visueel beoordelen van werk van collega`s volgens gestelde normen zoals IPC en SMR en assembleer je printen en fijn-mechanische delen.

About the job

Jouw week als operator ziet er gevarieerd uit, in ons digitale shopfloor controle systeem kijk je welke werkzaamheden aangepakt moeten worden, de variatie van producten is groot. Met je collega’s stem je af wie wat doet om de werkzaamheden goed te verdelen en zo efficiënt mogelijk te werken. Je assembleert de producten volgens instructies en voorschriften en zorgt dat deze aan de gestelde eisen voldoen. Tijdens montage maakt je gebruik van verscheidene procesmachines behorende bij een Pick & Place cell. Bij problemen van P&P programma`s stem je af met de verantwoordelijke technoloog. Tevens maak je gebruik handgereedschap, (kleine) schroefmachines, microscoop, lijmen en chemicaliën.

Je hebt ook nauw contact met de QC medewerkers met name als er je afwijkingen constateert, ook met de logistieke afdeling is er veelvuldig contact i.v.m. mogelijke impact van afkeur op de leverdata. Je bent een belangrijke spil in het productieproces omdat producten meerdere keren via de machines hun route vervolgen, daarmee druk je een belangrijke stempel op het eindresultaat. In de inspectie bepaal jij feitelijk of een product goed of fout is. Opsomming van een deel van je dagelijkse taken:

- Montage van elektrische componenten middels (voorop vastgestelde) processen en machines.
- Montage van elektrische en fijn mechanische onderdelen volgens instructiebladen.
- Verrichten van visuele inspecties van (deel)producten a.d.h.v. voorschriften en normen.
- Controleren en koppelen van serienummer dragende delen.
- Opsporen en waar mogelijk (laten) herstellen van afwijkingen.
- Afwijkingen veroorzaakt door montage terugkoppelen aan collega`s.
- Correct registreren van afwijkingen t.b.v. analyse.
- Afstemming met technologen/QC bij moeilijk te beoordelen afwijkingen.

About you

Heb je een passie voor techniek en lijkt het je leuk te werken aan hightech producten? Dan ben jij de persoon die wij zoeken.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO studie en affiniteit met techniek. Deze functie past goed bij je als je het leuk vindt om complexe systeem onderdelen in bedrijf te stellen, om fouten op te sporen en vervolgens in staat bent deze fouten op te lossen. Het helpt daarbij als je als persoon creatief bent, open staat voor zaken vanuit verschillende standpunten, flexibel bent, het leuk vind om te werken met (machine)computers, en je kunt opereren als een teamspeler.

Thales offers you

- een interessante baan binnen een leuk team in een internationale hightech omgeving;
- goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, met onder andere 40 vakantiedagen per jaar;
- ruimte en aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief;
- de mogelijkheid om te groeien binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, management, commercieel of internationaal vlak;
- een open en flexibele werkomgeving waarbij een goede work-life balans belangrijk is.

Austin, Hybrid

We are seeking a PMO Specialist to join Thales in Austin, TX.

As a Project Management Office (PMO) Specialist for the Identity and Biometrics Solutions team in the USA, you will serve as a key member of the Projects and Portfolio Management organization, providing advanced analytical, governance, reporting, and project management support across the NORAM portfolio.

The PMO Specialist is responsible for analyzing complex project and portfolio data, establishing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), identifying trends and risks, and translating data into meaningful insights and recommendations for project teams and leadership. The role will independently develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, templates, governance practices, and portfolio-level processes that improve visibility, consistency, compliance, and decision-making.

This position partners closely with Project Managers, functional teams, Finance, and business leadership to support project scheduling, financial analysis, portfolio reporting, project governance, internal audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. The PMO Specialist will also contribute to executive-level project and portfolio reviews by ensuring information is accurate, consistent, and presented in a manner that supports effective business decisions.

The Identity and Biometrics Solutions team designs and develops innovative products and solutions ranging from desktop applications integrating biometric devices to high-performance server applications, secure identity-document issuance solutions utilizing PKI, encryption, and cryptography, and emerging digital identity technologies such as Digital Driver’s Licenses.

The Projects and Portfolio Management team is responsible for leading the definition, execution, acceptance, and handoff of projects across the business line within the region.

Must have U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain the post-hire Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Clearance from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and must be able to obtain post-hire clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investments in the U.S. (CFIUS) and Department of Justice.

Key Areas of Responsibility

• Independently analyze and interpret complex Projects and Services data to identify trends, patterns, risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, visualizations, and analytical tools that provide meaningful insight into project, portfolio, and business performance.

• Analyze large and diverse datasets, validate findings, draw informed conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations for Project Managers and leadership.

• Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Projects and Portfolio KPIs, including defining measurement methodologies, monitoring performance, identifying variances, and recommending corrective or improvement actions.

• Partner cross-functionally with Project Management, Finance, Operations, Engineering, and other stakeholders to interpret project and portfolio performance and resolve reporting or data inconsistencies.

• Apply and promote Thales Manage Project, DDQS, and other applicable governance processes across NORAM projects; conduct internal compliance reviews and identify opportunities to strengthen adherence.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Projects and Portfolio Management, including improvements arising from bids, projects, lessons learned, PPE activities, and portfolio performance analysis.

• Evaluate and enhance project governance tools, templates, reporting standards, and deliverables to improve consistency, quality, efficiency, and the customer and executive experience.

• Analyze project financial performance and develop portfolio-level reporting that provides visibility into financial trends, variances, contingencies, risks, and overall project health.

• Lead the preparation and coordination of monthly executive project and portfolio reviews, including project financials, schedule performance, KPIs, variances, contingencies, risks, and key management actions.

• Develop and distribute recurring NORAM Projects and Services communications and reporting, including weekly portfolio reports, quarterly newsletters, dashboards, and executive presentations.

• Partner with Project Managers in the development and maintenance of project schedules; develop and maintain integrated master schedules and portfolio-level schedule views to identify dependencies, risks, and potential impacts.

title: Presales & Bid Manager Cyber – Maroc & Afrique
description:

Contexte et mission

Basé(e) au Maroc et intervenant sur le Maroc et l’Afrique, le/la Presales & Bid Manager Cyber accompagne la croissance du business en détectant, qualifiant et développant les opportunités, puis en pilotant de bout en bout la construction de propositions compétitives, robustes et différenciantes. Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble

Vous contribuez directement au développement du portefeuille Cyber, à la qualité du pipeline et au taux de transformation des opportunités. Vous intervenez dès les phases amont pour comprendre l’environnement client, construire la stratégie de valeur et fédérer les contributeurs jusqu’à la signature, puis sécuriser le transfert vers les équipes de réalisation.

Vos responsabilités

- Développer les opportunités : promouvoir le portefeuille Cyber, accompagner les équipes commerciales et les partenaires, contribuer aux plans de comptes, qualifier les besoins et alimenter un pipeline réaliste sur le Maroc et l’Afrique.

- Construire la stratégie de capture : analyser l’écosystème client, les concurrents, les critères de décision et les risques ; recommander le positionnement, les partenaires, la stratégie de différenciation et la décision bid/no-bid.

- Piloter les offres de bout en bout : définir la gouvernance, le planning, la matrice de responsabilités et le plan de production ; coordonner les contributeurs internes et externes ; garantir la conformité, la qualité, les délais et la traçabilité des engagements.

- Concevoir la solution : traduire les exigences métier et techniques en architecture cible, modèle de services et trajectoire de transformation ; mobiliser les experts pour détailler le design, les flux, les dépendances, les prérequis, la haute disponibilité et la reprise d’activité.

- Élaborer le chiffrage et le business case : consolider charges, unités d’œuvre, coûts, hypothèses, risques et marges ; challenger les scénarios de delivery et assurer la cohérence entre solution, prix, planning et engagements contractuels.

- Produire une proposition gagnante : structurer le message de valeur, rédiger ou coordonner les contributions techniques et commerciales, établir les matrices de conformité et préparer les revues internes.

- Porter l’offre face au client : conduire ateliers, présentations et soutenances, traiter les clarifications, contribuer aux négociations et accompagner la finalisation jusqu’à la signature.

- Sécuriser le démarrage : organiser le transfert vers les équipes projet et delivery, partager le contexte et les engagements, valider les prérequis et contribuer aux premières revues de conception.

- Sécurité des infrastructures : Active Directory, réseaux et segmentation, environnements Windows/Linux, virtualisation et plateformes hybrides.

- Sécurité applicative : WAF, API Security, reverse proxy et TLS/SSL.

- SOC et opérations de sécurité : SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, détection des menaces et gestion des journaux.

- Cloud Security : Azure, AWS, GCP, architectures hybrides et Zero Trust.

- Services associés : intégration, audit et diagnostic, conseil, services managés, remédiation, gouvernance technique et accompagnement de la transformation.

- Formation Bac+5, école d’ingénieur, ou équivalent, avec une forte culture technologique.

- Expérience confirmée, idéalement de 8 à 15 ans, en avant-vente, bid management, architecture de solutions ou développement commercial dans la cybersécurité.

- Capacité démontrée à piloter des réponses complexes et multi-acteurs, depuis la qualification jusqu’à la négociation et au transfert vers le delivery.

- Bonne compréhension des architectures de cybersécurité, de l’intégration de solutions, des services managés et des modèles économiques associés.

- Maîtrise de l’analyse des exigences, du chiffrage, de la gestion des risques, des revues de design et de la gestion de partenaires ou fournisseurs.

- Connaissance des référentiels ISO 27001, ISO 27005, ISO 22301, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires applicables au Maroc et dans les pays adressés.

- Leadership transversal, capacité à fédérer, sens client, écoute, négociation, esprit de synthèse et excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et de présentation.

- Autonomie, rigueur, réactivité, orientation résultats et aisance dans un environnement multiculturel, multi-pays et multi-projets.

- Français et anglais professionnels indispensables ; l’arabe constitue un atout.

- Mobilité ponctuelle en Afrique.

Indicateurs de réussite

- Qualité et progression du pipeline Cyber sur le Maroc et l’Afrique.

- Taux de transformation et contribution aux prises de commandes.

- Respect des jalons, de la gouvernance et des exigences de conformité des offres.

- Pertinence, compétitivité et maîtrise des risques des solutions proposées.

- Qualité du transfert vers le delivery et satisfaction des parties prenantes.

- Capitalisation et réutilisation des actifs d’avant-vente.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous rejoignez une équipe engagée sur des enjeux de confiance numérique, de protection des données et de résilience des organisations. Vous occupez un rôle visible, au cœur de la relation client et de la construction des solutions, avec l’opportunité de contribuer concrètement à la croissance de nos activités Cyber au Maroc et en Afrique.

- Field Enablement and GTM: Equip Sales and Sales Engineering to sell on value — pricing guidance, competitive training, and value articulation.

- 10+ years in outbound product management, product marketing, pricing strategy, or GTM strategy for enterprise B2B software — with at least 5 years personally owning pricing, competitive, or win-loss outcomes
- 5+ years in security business
- Hands-on ownership of a real pricing or packaging change: what you changed, why, what it did to ASP or win rate, and what you got wrong
- Hands on experience with analyzing pipelines and performing win-loss analysis
- Experience with leading GTM activities
- Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Operations without authority over any of them
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Team player who brings evidence, states plainly when the data is thin, and makes the call anyway

description:

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

Organisation Context

The Airspace Mobility Solutions (AMS) business, part of the Global Business Unit Land and Air Systems, provides leading-edge Air Traffic Management (ATM), Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM), Security, and Digital Aviation solutions for the Commercial and Defence sectors.

The AMS manages 11% of the world's airspace and, with revenues of over 500 million Euros worldwide, is the global market leader in airspace management solutions. In Singapore, the business focuses on the delivery and support of ATM solutions in the Asia Pacific region.

Role Description

The Principal Integration Engineer is responsible for the integration of software and hardware components within a complex software-centric ATM system. The role involves coordinating and executing integration activities, troubleshooting system issues, and ensuring that various components work seamlessly together while satisfying functional and performance requirements.

Working within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) or Agile Squad, the role may also involve Verification and Validation activities.

Responsibilities

- Conduct the successful integration and test of software releases for systems and/or subsystems, in accordance with the approved schedule

- Lead integration activities at Factory and Customer Site facilities

- Proactively participate in Program Increment planning and backlog refinement including contributing to the effort estimation

- Manage and/or contribute to the setup of environments to facilitate the integration, testing and acceptance activities required by the program. Provide instruction on the setup of environments to support validation activities.

- Define and/or contribute to testing activities across multiple platforms (regression, interface, simulation scenarios and test tools) to support project milestones and deadlines

- Able to analyse System/Subsystem technical and functional issues, ensuring they are identified early, captured fully and logged according to internal processes.

- To collaborate with System, Subsystem and Infrastructure teams to ensure that the integration activities are in line with the design and specifications

- Develop and deliver documentation and engineering artefacts (E.g. System Integration Test Documentation) with the expected level of compliance (functional, performance, robustness, security and quality) that are aligned with internal configuration management processes.

- Develop scripts in order to automate system administration tasks.

- Manage and/or implement test & measuring tools used for system performance, loading and response-time assessment

- Provide technical support and mentoring to junior integrators and the V&V teams

- Making recommendations on strategies to improve performance or productivity

- Identify risks, and proposing effective solution early and executing mitigation actions

- Providing input into the planning and coordination of program integration activities

- Work directly with the customer and internal integration training (as required)

- Identify risks, and propose effective solutions; execute mitigation actions and report on outcomes / cost savings and residual risks

- Assist bid activities with integration estimation

- Authoring and/or reviewing documentation and documentation updates

- Contribute to the development of Integration Policies, Processes and Procedures to ensure best practice.

- Promote knowledge sharing ensuring that work is captured sufficiently for re-use across projects

- Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or relevant experience

Essential Experience

- 7+ years of experience in similar positions integrating complex software-centric real-time systems

- ATM Domain Experience

- Ability to understand the structure of and troubleshoot Virtualisation Platforms/Operating Systems (Clients/Servers): 3+ years

- Linux/Unix Operating Systems, SNMP Services, RSYSLOG

- Windows Operating Systems

- VMware

- Scripting: Python, Shell, XML – 3+ years

- DevOps and Automation Tools: Ansible, Jenkins

- Configuration Management: GIT (Bitbucket), JIRA

- Cybersecurity: LDAP, AD, PKI

- Network Protocols and Technologies: SNMP, UDP, TCP, IP

- Debugging tools (e.g., Wireshark)

- Infrastructure monitoring tools

- Adept at troubleshooting issues quickly and efficiently

- Aptitude to work effectively in a multi-disciplinary integrated team environment with colleagues based in remote sites or other countries

- Positive attitude combined with excellent interpersonal and motivational skills

- Ability to effectively communicate complex engineering issues and concepts, both verbally and in writing, tailored appropriately for stakeholders

Desirable

- Programming Languages: Java, C++

- Site integration and deployment experience

- Knowledge of networks and network configuration / exposure to distributed systems

- Experience with System Engineering Tools (e.g., DOORS, Polarion, Jira, MBSE)

- Experience in ATM Domain and related standards (e.g., ICAO, Eurocontrol) or safety-critical systems

- Experience working in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)

General Requirements

- Advocate for a culture of continuous improvement

- Advocate for accountability, transparency, and curiosity

- Comply with all relevant company policies and procedures

In this position, you will also develop engineering execution strategies, resolve significant technical and delivery issues, and guide projects from requirements definition through design, integration, qualification, certification support, and acceptance. You will be expected to exercise independent judgment in ambiguous situations, influences decisions across functions and organizational levels, and provide technical leadership and guidance to other engineers.

- Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams in the development, integration, qualification, and fielding of aircraft entertainment and connectivity products and systems. Coordinate hardware, software, systems, test, quality, and other engineering functions to resolve complex technical issues and manage interfaces between solution elements.
- Own the engineering execution plan for assigned projects, including technical scope, milestones, resources, risks, dependencies, and engineering budgets. Monitor performance and take corrective action when needed. Serve as Work Package Manager when assigned, with accountability for the work package’s defined scope, budget, schedule, risks, and deliverables.
- Partner with the Program or Project Leader and Project Design Authority to align technical decisions with customer requirements and project cost, schedule, and quality commitments. Serve as a primary engineering interface with customers, key subcontractors, and internal stakeholders on assigned projects.
- Define and tailor the development strategy and Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) for assigned solutions. Lead requirements definition and solution design, including preparation for preliminary design reviews (PDR), critical design reviews (CDR), validation, qualification, certification support, and final acceptance.
- Lead engineering reviews and ensure technical decisions, risks, actions, and design changes are documented and addressed. Analyze engineering performance measures and recurring issues, determine root causes, and lead improvements to project execution, product performance, or engineering processes.
- Identify engineering resource and skill needs and work with functional leaders to secure appropriate staffing for bids, projects, and product delivery. Mentor engineers, share technical and project execution practices across teams, and perform other duties as assigned by the employee’s manager.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of progressively responsible engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership and accountability for engineering execution on complex, multidisciplinary projects.

- Demonstrated ability to apply systems engineering and development processes across requirements definition, design, integration, verification, validation, and applicable qualification and certification activities.
- Experience developing and managing engineering execution plans, resource requirements, schedules, budgets, and work packages, including addressing deviations that affect project commitments.
- Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment, evaluate solution trade-offs, manage engineering risks, and lead resolution of complex technical problems.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews, communicate recommendations to customers and leadership, and influence decisions across functional boundaries; Proficiency with tools used for engineering planning, analysis, documentation, and reporting.

description:
