title: Senior Customer Operations Analyst
description:
Location: Belfast Arnott House, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Title: Senior Customer Operations Analyst

Team: Customer Intelligence, Customer Success

Reports to: Director, Customer Intelligence

Base location: Belfast, N. Ireland (Hybrid model)

About the Role

Imperva, A Thales Company, is seeking a Senior Customer Operations Analyst to join the Customer Intelligence team within our Customer Success organisation.

This role keeps Customer Success running on accurate data, efficient processes and well-used tools. You will be the go-to person for how Customer Success operates: running our Customer Success platform (Planhat), keeping customer data accurate across Planhat and Snowflake, improving the processes our Customer Success teams use every day and producing the reporting that shows leaders how the business is performing, as well as putting AI to work for our Customer Success teams through Planhats AI suite, in house LLM’s and other relevant technologies.

You will work alongside Customer Success leadership to turn data into practical improvements for our teams and customers. This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role for an experienced analyst who combines strong data skills with a passion for making operations work better.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Success Platform & Systems

- Act as lead administrator and subject-matter expert for Planhat, managing configuration, workflows, playbooks, automation and ongoing optimisation.
- Support system integration and data ingestion between Planhat, Snowflake, Salesforce and other business systems, working with IT and Data Engineering.
- Gather, document and prioritise requirements for new tooling, automation, reporting and process changes.

AI & Automation

- Configure, roll out and continuously improve AI features within Planhat, such as account summaries, AI-assisted insights and automated workflows, so they genuinely help Customer Success teams in their day-to-day work.
- Work with our in-house LLM to build and refine AI-powered use cases for Customer Success, such as account and meeting summaries, answering questions about customers, and drafting customer communications.
- Write, test and refine prompts, and prepare and maintain the customer data and knowledge sources the AI tools draw on, making sure outputs are accurate, relevant and useful.
- Identify manual, repetitive tasks across Customer Success and find ways to remove them using AI and automation.
- Train and support Customer Success teams in using AI tools effectively and responsibly, gathering feedback to improve them.
- Make sure AI use follows company data security, privacy and responsible-AI guidelines, working with IT, Security and Data teams.

Operational Process & Enablement

- Design, maintain and continuously improve Customer Success operational processes, such as onboarding, account reviews, success plans, renewals handovers and customer engagement, using data to measure how well they work.
- Provide enablement and training to Customer Success teams on Planhat, reporting and processes, and create clear documentation and guides.
- Act as the first point of contact for Customer Success teams on tools, data and process questions, resolving issues and spotting recurring needs.
- Contribute to cross-functional projects with Sales, Product, Finance and Support that affect how Customer Success operates.

Data Quality & Governance

- Own data quality across Customer Success data, identifying issues and driving them to resolution at the source.
- Write and maintain SQL queries and data sets in Snowflake to support Customer Success reporting and operations.
- Maintain clear data definitions, field standards and documentation so teams use data consistently.

Reporting & Operational Insight

- Build, maintain and continuously improve Customer Success reporting in Planhat and PowerBI, from leadership dashboards to day-to-day operational views for Customer Success.
- Analyse product usage, customer engagement and operational data to answer business questions, track team performance and highlight areas to improve.
- Present findings and recommendations clearly to Customer Success teams, project leads and business leaders, including data for business reviews and leadership updates.
- Collaborate with the Data Strategist on customer health and retention insight, making sure the data behind it is accurate and the results are visible to Customer Success teams.
- Work with stakeholders to understand their needs, set priorities and manage multiple projects at once.
- Share knowledge with and support less experienced analysts and Customer Success colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

- Planhat is well adopted, accurate and automated, saving CSMs time.
- Customer Success processes are clear, documented and measurably more efficient.
- Data quality issues are caught early and fixed at the source.
- AI tools in Planhat and our in-house LLM are widely used by Customer Success teams and save them measurable time.
- Customer Success teams and leaders trust and regularly use accurate, up-to-date reporting.

Job Requirements

title: Senior Digital Hardware Engineer
description:
Localizacion : Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

Thales Alenia Space people architect and deliver satellite-based systems that help position, connect and observe our planet, and push the boundaries of our understanding of planet's resources. Our systems are in orbit at 400 km, 20000 km, 36000 km and beyond to the edges of the solar system.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Join one of Europe's leading space engineering teams and design the next generation of telecommunications satellites. Design advanced FPGA-based hardware and work with state-of-the-art digital technologies, high-speed interfaces and space-qualified electronics in an international engineering environment where your designs will fly in orbit for more than 15 years.

As part of our Digital Hardware team, you will contribute to the development of cutting-edge telecommunications satellites, working alongside experts in FPGA design, signal integrity, embedded processing and space-qualified electronics.

What you will do:

- Define digital architectures for next-generation telecommunication satellites.
- Design complex boards based on FPGAs, microprocessors and high-speed digital interfaces.
- Develop solutions involving DDR memories, SpaceWire, high-speed serial links and advanced processing architectures.
- You will work with technologies including Xilinx Kintex UltraScale, Microchip PolarFire and RTG4 FPGAs, DDR4 memories, SpaceWire interfaces and multi-gigabit serial links.
- Perform signal integrity and power integrity analyses.
- Lead technical decisions throughout the complete product lifecycle, from concept to qualification.
- Collaborate with international multidisciplinary teams across Europe.
- You will have significant technical ownership of the hardware architecture and will influence key design decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

Required

- 5+ years in digital electronic design.
- FPGA and/or processor-based designs.
- High-speed digital electronics (Such as 1GB+ Ethernet, PCIe, SpaceFibre, Aurora, WizardLink, etc.).
- Board development lifecycle.

Nice to have

- Space industry experience.
- ECSS standards.
- Radiation-tolerant FPGAs.
- Hyperlynx or equivalent SI tools.
- RISC-V architectures.
- VITA Standard
- Knowledge of design tools: LTspice, Simplis/Simetrix, OrCAD, …

We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet every preferred qualification. We value potential, motivation and the ability to learn as prior experience.

Languages:

- Good written and verbal Spanish and English as a minimum. French knowledge will be valued.

What do we offer?

- Work on real satellite hardware operating in orbit.
- Long-term participation in flagship European space programs.
- Hybrid working model (40% remote work, 60% work at the Tres Cantos facility).
- Flexible schedule and excellent work-life balance.
- Individual career development plan and technical growth path.
- Continuous training on advanced digital electronics and FPGA technologies.
- Free meals at the office.
- Pension plan.
- 28 business days of vacation plus Christmas and Easter weeks.

Join us and help design the electronics that will power the next generation of telecommunications satellites. Your work will contribute to systems operating hundreds of kilometers above Earth and serving customers worldwide.

We will consider being in possession of a certificate of disability.

Thales is a company committed to equal opportunities between women and men, and for this reason, we work to raise awareness and disseminate information on the subject both internally and externally.

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

title: Senior Electronics Engineer
description:
Location: Reading, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Senior Electronics Engineer

Reading - Hybrid Working

Thales OME designs a range of state-of-the-art solutions for some of the most technically advanced defence and security platforms in the world, and we’re seeking talented engineers who can apply their knowledge and skills in an electronics role.

We have over 100 years’ experience in design and manufacture of state-of-the-art Periscopes and Optronics and have led Optronics innovation on a global scale, by combining world-leading expertise from across the Thales group.

Overview

This role covers all aspects of the product lifecycle, from requirements through specification, concept studies, design and development, integration, validation and qualification. This is a great opportunity for an experienced electronics engineer to build technical skills, widen their systems understanding and develop their career.

Key responsibilities of the role

- Undertake design of complex electronic circuit assemblies or architectures, from concept through to system integration & qualification
- Lead discussions with a multi-disciplinary team (systems, mechanical, software, safety, etc) to develop an optimum solution
- Work collaboratively with the project team to ensure products meet all their requirements and comply with regulatory safety and environmental standards
- Contribute to the development of the wider electronics team, including mentoring junior members of staff, overseeing the implementation of improvements and reviewing the work of peers
- Generate electronics specifications, architectures, and development or verification plan
- Support the bid process through generation of estimates and consultancy on electronic solution
- Present robust engineering solutions at design reviews
- Monitor progress of work against cost, schedule and performance

Experience and skill required

We are looking for a forward thinking individual with the following skills and experience:

- Experience of electronic design throughout the design lifecycle
- Previous use of schematic capture packages (Cadence, Mentor Graphics or similar)
- Development of electronic products in a formal environment
- Experience testing at circuit board and system level (eg. board bring-up and debug, EMC testing)
- Preparation of sub-system requirements/procurement specs
- General understanding of engineering process and design lifecycles

What we can offer

We’re committed to giving you opportunities to be your best. We believe in embracing the passion and potential of our people, and to achieve this we offer market leading training, development and experiences, along with the opportunity to be mentored and coached by some of the smartest minds in the industry. We hire from within as our first priority, so you’ll have a myriad of opportunities within our diverse, global organisation.

Our packages will include bonus, a strong pension contribute plan matched up to 7%, Private healthcare, development focused targets and relocation support can be provided if required along with a variety of learning, development and career enhancement opportunities.

Flexibility

Your health and well-being matters to us and that’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, home working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times. Where possible, we support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions.

Connect with Fiona Tal, Talent Acquisition Partner #LI-FT1 who is eager to explore together with you this exciting opportunity.

UK Eyes Only:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here.

If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here.

Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

Qualifications: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication or equivalent discipline with 3 to 7 years of relevant experience.

Location: Thales India Private Limited, Richmond Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025.

title: Senior Legal Counsel & Contract Manager
description:

Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

WHO ARE WE?

The Job Holder will be part of the Legal, Contract and Compliance (LC&C) Department of Thales international division (DGDI) for Southeast Asia. The LC&C Department support all Thales’ businesses in Southeast Asia (“the Region”).

Within DGDI, you report hierarchically to the Legal, Contract and Compliance Director for Southeast Asia.

Thales has been present and has grown from strength to strength in the Asian region for over 50 years, providing state-of-the-art solutions for customers in the avionics, secure communications and information systems, defense mission systems and strategy, research and technology, and digital security domains. The position particularly covers Defense & Security, Air Management Systems, Research & Development activities in Singapore and in the Region.

WHO ARE YOU?

· You hold an advanced academic background in Law, Contract Management, Business, or related field, equivalent to a Master’s degree‑level qualification (EU/UK/SG/US or other comparable higher‑education systems) including a Specialization in Law,

· You have 10 to 15 years of demonstrated experience as a legal counsel or contract manager working in an international context and as part of the legal department of a multinational company,

· Endowed with analytical and synthesis skills, you assess situations accurately and can easily propose pragmatic solutions,

· You understand the stakes associated with a major international Group’s compliance program,

· You master the techniques related to third-party review (third-party screening) and are able to conduct compliance analyses,

· During your experience, you have developed strong proactivity towards stakeholders and good ability to manage priorities,

· You have appetite in leadership and coaching, fostering your others growth

· You enjoy sharing your experiences and best practices, with a collective and collaborative mindset,

· You also have good listening and communication skills,

· You are keen to work in diverse teams and have inter-cultural awareness and interest,

· You have full mastery of IT tools, all types of data exchange platforms, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint,

· You can travel on regular basis over the Region (up to once a month) and from time-to-time to Europe (up to once a year).

WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGETHER?

The Job Holder will lead the contract management function for the assigned portfolios and will provide day-to-day and strategic oversight of the Contract Manager currently supporting these activities. The role includes managing performance, ensuring contractual compliance, setting standards and processes, and ensuring timely and effective execution across the contract lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own contract lifecycle delivery for the perimeter

- Lead negotiation strategy and provide commercial/legal recommendations

- Manage contract risks and ensure governance processes are followed

- Manage the Contract Manager: set priorities, run regular check-ins, coach, review outputs, ensure quality, and escalate risks

- Maintain auditable contract documentation and reporting

1. Contractual Support for Tender, Offers, Variations & Extensions

· Recommend contractual structures that enhance competitiveness while respecting applicable regulations and internal governance

· Draft, revise, and negotiate contractual documents with customers, partners, and subcontractors

· Contribute to internal risk reviews, financial exposure assessments, and mitigation plans

· Ability to identify opportunities to protect or improve the project's financial performance

· Support the capture and preparation of variations, extensions, new phases or related offers connected to existing program

· Prepare and present contractual sections of internal approval documentation, including clear recommendations to management

2. Contract Management Throughout Project Execution

· Establish, manage, and continuously update the contractual baseline from contract signature to project closure

· Ensure full contractual awareness across the project team, enabling correct application of obligations, rights, deadlines, and deliverables

· Anticipate deviations and manage them proactively through contractual notices, waivers, amendments, claims, clarification requests, and other contractual instruments

· Anticipate and drive the project’s risk and opportunity strategy, in close collaboration with project leadership, including claim preparation, defensive measures, and value‑protection initiatives, proposing defensible, practical solutions

· Oversee all incoming and outgoing contractual communications with the customer, ensuring consistency, traceability, and strategic alignment

· Coordinate with the Litigation Department when disputes arise, including fact‑finding, documentation, evidence management, and support to legal strategy

· Handle contractual aspects of key subcontractors and suppliers or coordinate with dedicated contract management teams where applicable

3. People Management, Governance, Leadership & Coordination

· The position includes 1 direct report: Lead and manage the Contract Manager’s day-to-day activities, including prioritization of workload, assignment of contract tasks, and escalation of risks.

o Set clear objectives and performance expectations for the Contract Manager; conduct regular 1:1 meetings and agreed check-ins.

o Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and structured feedback on contract drafting/review quality.

o Ensure the Contract Manager adheres to company contract governance processes (e.g., approval workflows, recordkeeping, version control).

o Drive consistent contract interpretation and commercial decision-making aligned with company policy and risk appetite.

· Act as the reference point for all contractual matters within the perimeter

· Provide strategic and operational contractual advice to internal stakeholders

· Participate in departmental initiatives such as improving templates, tools, and best practices, contributing expertise linked to complex project execution

4. Compliance Activities

Although the role is primarily focused on contract management, you will:

· Support relevant compliance processes for the tenders and projects (e.g., third‑party screenings) in coordination with the Compliance Officer (Antitrust, Anticorruption, Personal Data Protection (incl. GDPR), Trade compliance & Duty of vigilance), in particular:

· Escalate any potential non‑compliance issues where required.

5. Transversal Activities

· Provide country legal intelligence and knowledge to the relevant global, regional, or corporate stakeholders

· Interface with external counsels for analysis and management of specific legal issues in the framework of complex contractual and/or legal arrangements or claim/litigation procedures in the Region on a need-basis,

· Participate in a cross-functional working group for Legal, Contract and Compliance Department (contract management, IP, standard contracts, insurance…),

· Contribute to the development and delivery of training to operational teams (compliance, contract management,…)

WHAT WE OFFER

· A unique opportunity to manage the contractual dimension of a flagship, technically complex program in Singapore.

· High impact, visibility, and autonomy within the organization.

· Exposure to senior internal stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.

· A collaborative and international working environment.

The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Senior NPI Engineer (EMS)

Primary Purpose of the Role

Thales is expanding its presence in India through the development of a Group Engineering Competence Centre (ECC), reinforcing its position as a leader in all its markets. Launching in early 2019 in Bengaluru, the ECC will expand Thales’ footprint in its core business areas and cement its long-standing relationship with India. Strong of more than 500 engineers as of today, ECC will grow to >1200 by 2029. This role is part of the Industrial Process Engineering function within the AVS-FLX team. The position is Senior NPI Engineer – PCB,PCBA, responsible for managing the introduction of new products and overseeing industrial transfer activities.

AVS-FLX has an objective to expand industrial process engineering function in India ensuring remote engineering support to FLX Industry and preparing industrial footprint expansion in the region. Achieving a high level of maturity for our products in production is one of the major challenges of the AVS/FLX industry, both during the industrialization phase and throughout the product's life cycle. Supplier Industrialization in India is the core area in Industrial Footprint expansion. You will join the Supplier Industrialization team responsible to develop & production of Thales Parts/Products at Supplier End.

JOB Description:

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

- NPI - You work Closely with Design Team from India/France to understand the design requirement & then work with Suppliers(India/Asia) to manufacture the PCB/PCBA complaint with Thales requirements

- Industrial Transfer - You are responsible to reindustrialize the production of PCB/PCBA Boards from Global Location to India/Asia Suppliers.

Detailed Responsibilities below:

Project Planning and Execution

- Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of PCB and PCBA projects from concept through production and final shipment.

- Develop detailed project schedules, milestones, and timelines ensuring all deliverables meet quality, cost, and deadline targets.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams including design, procurement, manufacturing, and quality assurance.

- Monitor project progress and adjust plans as necessary to address risks, delays, or technical issues.

Technical Management

- Manage PCB and PCBA prototyping, pilot runs, and transition to volume production.

- Ensure all processes comply with industry standards such as IPC, ISO, RoHS, and other regulatory requirements.

- Collaborate with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure product quality, cost efficiency, and timely delivery.

- Review and approve technical documentation including BOM (Bill of Materials), process flows, and work instructions.

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

- Lead root cause analysis and drive corrective actions for manufacturing or assembly issues.

- Manage risk assessments and mitigation strategies throughout the project lifecycle.

- Ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.

Communication and Reporting

- Provide regular project updates and reports to senior management.

- Facilitate meetings, review sessions, and project documentation audits.

Continuous Improvement

- Identify cost reduction opportunities to improve PCB/PCBA design, manufacturing, and assembly processes.

- Implement best practices and lessons learned to enhance project efficiency and product quality.

- Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and standards.

The position is based in Bangalore, with frequent travel to supplier sites across Bangalore and other locations within India.

Major Challenges

- Work with Design team of France in a different Time Zone & ECC Bangalore

- Work with multiple Suppliers/multiple projects in tandem for Process Qualification

- Continuously Develop the required technical skills (skilling-up) and capability by effective learning

- Promote collaboration within the team for Technology Specialist, Component Engineers

- Work with Multi Stakeholders(Design/Purchase/Supply chain/Production Engineers)

Opportunities

- The chance to be in contact with people having different cultural background from all across the world

- A young and enthusiastic team looking to take new interesting projects on board

Organization

Skills & Knowledge Required

- Must have experience in technologies qualification plan definition and execution in order to increase technology maturity from TRL3-4 to TRL 5-6

- Must have experience in electronic manufacturing readiness definition and execution in order to increase process maturity from MRL2-4 to MRL7-8

SOFT SKILLS

title: Senior Offensive Security Auditor

- Conduct vulnerability assessments, exploitation and security validation activities.

- Work closely with SOC, DFIR, Threat Hunting and Threat Intelligence teams to provide offensive security expertise and support security investigations when required.

- Contribute to the development and improvement of methodologies, playbooks, testing procedures and reporting standards.

What you bring

Required

- 5+ years of professional experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming or security auditing.
- Strong hands-on experience in:Web application and API security testing.Infrastructure and network penetration testing.Cloud security assessments.Vulnerability assessment and exploitation.Red Team / adversary simulation activities.
- Strong understanding of attack techniques, vulnerabilities and security controls.
- Ability to independently plan and deliver complex security assessments.
- Excellent analytical, reporting and communication skills.
- Ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
- Ability to work effectively with SOC, DFIR, Threat Intelligence and Security Engineering teams.
- English level C1.
- Professional working proficiency in Portuguese.

Nice to have

- Experience with Purple Team exercises and security control validation.
- Experience with cloud offensive security, mobile security, OT/ICS, IoT or social engineering.
- Experience supporting incident response or post-incident investigations from an offensive security perspective.
- Knowledge of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and experience applying them to adversary simulation.
- Experience working directly with customers and presenting technical findings.
- Certifications

Relevant certifications will be highly valued, including:

- Offensive Security: OSEP, OSCP, OSCE3
- SANS: GXPN, GPEN, GWAPT, etc.
- CREST: CCT, CCSAM, CCTIM or equivalent
- Altered Security: CRTE, CARTP
- Other recognised offensive security certifications

What we offer

- A senior technical role within a leading cybersecurity organisation.
- The opportunity to become a technical reference for Offensive Security in Portugal.
- Exposure to complex and diverse cybersecurity projects and customers.
- Continuous learning and professional development through training and certifications.
- Collaboration with highly experienced cybersecurity professionals across different areas and countries.
- Flexible working model according to local policy.
- Medium travel depending on project requirements.
- Competitive compensation package and benefits.

Your career at Thales

At Thales, your career can evolve in different directions. You will have the opportunity to develop your expertise, explore new technologies and work with international teams and customers.

You can continue developing as a technical cybersecurity expert, move towards technical leadership, or explore new areas and opportunities across the Thales Group.

Join Thales and help us build a safer digital world.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Thales has a vacancy for a Senior Project Buyer to support the AJISS Engineering Changes Team across the Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ship In-Service Support (AJISS) program. As a Senior Project Buyer, you will translate engineering change requirements into purchasable, executable work packages—ensuring Purchase Orders (POs) are issued on time, supplier commitments are aligned to delivery and milestone expectations, and risks/issues are identified early and resolved decisively. You will also increase organizational knowledge by mentoring, improving practices, and strengthening end-to-end purchasing/supply execution. You will act as an experienced and independent owner for purchasing execution and supply readiness that enables engineering change delivery and act as the interface between the AJISS engineering team, procurement, and suppliers, ensuring projects meet their targets, risks are managed, and communication remains transparent.

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and /or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.

Key Areas of Responsibility

- Own end-to-end AJISS engineering-change procurement/supply execution: manage sourcing, PO creation/issuance, supplier documentation, and ensure technical/contractual alignment (scope, quantities, specs, terms, lead times, quality/compliance, delivery).
- Drive schedule and milestone performance: track work package progress, proactively identify risks (lead time slippage, capacity, technical clarifications, documentation readiness), and lead recovery actions/escalations to protect AJISS deliverables.
- Manage defense-approved/program-relevant suppliers: build and maintain relationships, support readiness and delivery planning, and ensure suppliers meet commitments for delivery dates, quality, and required documentation.
- Serve as cross-functional purchasing interface: partner with engineering, program/project management, category management, quality, operations, finance, legal, and bid/capture; provide transparent status, forecasts, and risk reporting with timely escalation.
- Run post-award supplier execution & performance management (where applicable): monitor delivery performance, execute supplier recovery/containment support, conduct performance reviews, and ensure corrective actions are initiated, tracked, and verified.
- Support change governance and continuous improvement: represent procurement interests in change review boards and cross-functional meetings; continuously improve purchasing/supply execution workflows to reduce cycle time, rework, and schedule variance (including lessons learned and templates).
- Ensure compliance and audit-ready evidence: maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready records of orders, compliance artifacts, correspondence, and acceptance evidence; ensure all interactions meet contractual, ethical, and regulatory requirements.
- Escalate and lead resolution of systemic issues: identify root causes of purchasing/supply bottlenecks and propose practical mitigations (alternative suppliers, revised delivery sequencing, PO scope/terms updates, revised recovery plans).
- Be a go-to resource and (where needed) mentor others: support the team proactively, reduce friction between functions, and share process knowledge/best practices.

Engagement Points:
Internal:

- Work Package Manager (WPM) / Project Manager (PM): alignment on scope, schedule, risks, issues, and supplier performance; ensure purchasing actions support recovery and commitment management.
- Engineering Design Manager (EDM) / Engineering: Collaborate to clarify technical requirements, manage Statement of Work (SoW) deliverables, and ensure seamless management of technical interfaces.
- Procurement / Category Management: Ensure sourcing strategies are aligned, coordinate handover from pre-award activities, and provide feedback on supplier performance for future sourcing decisions.
- Project Manager: Track and forecast costs, support and manage budgets/EAC, and control milestones and payments related to supplier contracts.
- Quality / Safety / RAM / Industrial / Operations: Monitor and manage supplier performance in quality, safety, industrialization, compliance and timely delivery.
- Legal / Commercial: Support contract variations, claims, disputes, and escalations, ensuring adherence to contractual and legal requirements.
- Bid / Capture Teams: Provide insights on supplier performance, risks, and costs to inform bids and proposals for future projects.

External:

- Key suppliers / subcontractors: Manage day-to-day commercial, and performance relationships to ensure project success.
- Customer representatives (where appropriate): Coordinate supplier-related matters impacting project delivery and customer commitments.
- Auditors or regulatory bodies (as required): Provide evidence of supplier compliance with contractual, ethical, and regulatory requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years’ relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, commercial or contract management, with clear exposure to post award supplier management.
- Experience in procurement or supply chain within the defense or high-compliance industry, ideally supporting in-service support or engineering change programs.
- Strong project management and milestone tracking skills using relevant tools (e.g., SAP, MS Project).
- Excellent supplier engagement and relationship management abilities.
- Proactive risk identification and mitigation skills; able to challenge delays constructively.
- Effective communicator in cross-functional, high-stakes environments.
- Working knowledge of defense industry regulations, government contracting, and AJISS program requirements is highly desirable.
- The candidate must meet all the following criteria:

a) possess a university degree in any field and possess a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 5 years or possess a diploma from a recognized college program in procurement, finance, economics, commerce, accounting or materiel management and possess a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in a procurement and finance related activity within the last 6 years; and

- Own end-to-end delivery across multiple squads (scope, plan, dependencies, risks, and outcomes).

- Establish delivery discipline: predictable cadence, transparent reporting, and continuous improvement.
- Champion an AI-first engineering culture; ensure AI tooling is used safely and effectively.
- Ensure engineering excellence: quality, security, reliability, and operability by design.

AI-Driven SDLC & Transformation

- Embed our AI-driven SDLC (AI-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day-to-day delivery.
- Drive adoption of AI ways of working (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.

- Remove impediments, manage delivery risk early, and drive predictable releases.
- Use metrics to improve flow efficiency, quality, and operational readiness.

People, Talent & Operations

- Own capacity and execution tracking; escalate risks with options.
- Ensure operational excellence (on-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).

What You Bring

- 7+ years in software engineering with 3+ years leading delivery and/or people in multi-team environments.
- Track record delivering cloud-native, distributed and security-sensitive platforms (identity experience a plus).
- Strong delivery management: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.
- Modern SDLC practices (CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps).
- Proven change leadership: scaling new tools and practices, including AI-assisted development.
- AI fluency: hands-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach safe, effective adoption.

- Predictable delivery: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on-time releases with transparent trade-offs.
- AI-driven SDLC adopted across squads with measurable improvements in cycle time, automation coverage, and quality.
- Strong engineering outcomes: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.
- High-performing teams: clear expectations, visible growth, and healthy engagement/retention.

This role reports to the Engineering Director.

title: Senior System Integration Engineer
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Senior Integration Engineer is responsible for the integration of software and hardware components within a complex software centric ATM system. The role involves coordinating and executing integration activities, troubleshooting system issues and ensuring the various components are working seamlessly together while satisfying functional and performance requirements.

Working within a Integrated Product Team, the role may also involve Verification and Validation activities.

KEY ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Sr. Integration Engineer, you are accountable for:

- Conduct the successful integration and the test of incremental software releases for systems and/or subsystems, in accordance with the schedule set by the Technical Leads and WPM
- Manage and/or contribute to the setup of environments to facilitate the integration, testing and acceptance activities required by the program. Provide instruction on the setup of environments to support validation activities.
- Define and/or contribute to testing activities across multiple platforms (regression, interface, simulation scenarios and test tools) to support project milestones and deadlines
- Able to analyse System/Subsystem technical and functional issues, ensuring they are identified early, captured fully and logged according to internal processes.
- To collaborate with System, Subsystem and Infrastructure teams to ensure that the integration activities are in line with the design and specifications
- Output documentation and engineering artefacts (E.g. System Integration Test Documentation) with the expected level of compliance (functional, performance, robustness, security and quality) that are aligned with internal configuration management processes.
- Produce scripts in order to automate system administration tasks.
- Manage and/or implement test & measuring tools used for system performance, loading and response-time assessment
- Provide technical support to junior integrators and the V&V teams
- Support Technical Leads and WPM through:
- Making recommendations on strategies to improve performance or productivity
- Identify risks, and proposing effective solution early and executing mitigation actions
- Providing input into the planning and coordination of program integration activities

- Work directly with the customer and internal integration training (as required)
- Identify risks, and propose effective solutions; execute mitigation actions and report on outcomes / cost savings and residual risks
- Authoring and/or reviewing documentation and documentation updates
- Promote knowledge sharing ensuring that work is captured sufficiently for re-use across projects
- Following Thales processes and practises and contribute to their improvement

KEY KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE

To be successful in your role, you will have demonstrated and/or acquired the following knowledge and experience:

Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or relevant experience

Essential Experience

- 5 years minimum experience holding similar positions integrating complex software-centric real-time systems
- Ability to understand the structure of and troubleshoot Virtualisation Platforms/Operating Systems (Clients/Servers): 3+ years
- Linux/Unix Operating Systems, SNMP Services, RSYSLOG
- Windows Operating systems
- VMWare

- Scripting: Python, Shell, XML: 3+ years
- DevOps and Automation Tools: Ansible, Jenkins
- Configuration Management: GIT (Bitbucket), JIRA
- Cybersecurity: LDAP, AD, PKI
- Network Protocols and technologies: SNMP, UDP, TCP, IP
- Debugging tools e.g. Wireshark
- Infrastructure monitoring tools
- Aptitude to work effectively in a multi-disciplinary integrated team environment with colleagues based in remote sites or other countries.
- A positive attitude combined with excellent interpersonal and motivational skills.
- Ability to effectively communicate complex engineering issues and concepts both verbally and written - tailored appropriately for the stakeholder
- Work experience in integrating large projects, preferably ATC-related (Military of Civilian).

Desirable:

- Programming Languages: Java, C++

- Site integration and deployment experience
- Knowledge of networks and network configuration / exposure to distributed systems

General / Special Requirements

GENERAL

- Assist in ensuring a harmonious work environment in all departments that you are working with by upholding Thales' key values.
- An advocate for diversity and inclusion who will be actively involved in implementing change initiatives to achieve our diversity goals
- An advocate for a culture of continuous improvement
- An advocate for Accountability, transparency and curiosity

description:

Help shape the safety of next-generation defence technologies, ensuring mission-critical systems are safe, compliant and certifiable throughout their lifecycle.

- Shape safety across the entire system lifecycle – from concept and architecture through to certification, in-service support and disposal, you'll have a unique opportunity to influence product development end-to-end and leave a lasting impact on system design
- Drive innovation in a rapidly evolving environment – join a growing business delivering next-generation capabilities at pace, where you'll tackle complex safety challenges, mentor others and help define the future of systems safety engineering within Thales

Our Opportunity

As a Senior System Safety & Environmental Engineer, you'll ensure Thales products achieve certification, meet stringent safety standards and perform safely in operational environments. You'll lead hazard analysis, define safety requirements and drive risk reduction activities across complex engineering programmes. From concept and design through to verification, certification and deployment, you'll provide technical leadership on safety-critical hardware and programmable elements, influencing engineering decisions and developing compelling safety cases backed by robust assurance evidence. Your work will directly enable the delivery of safe, compliant and trusted solutions for our customers.

We're seeking candidates with a strong Systems Safety Engineering background, ideally with experience in software safety assurance. While software safety expertise is highly desirable, we are also keen to hear from experienced Safety Engineers from aerospace, defence or other highly regulated industries.

Building a Future, we can all trust.

Integrated Airspace Protection Systems (IAS) - our main purpose is to protect and defend. We provide rapid integrated solutions for detection, coordination, fire control, engagement and support. We cover three sectors: Surface Attack & Air Defence (UK), Air Defence (International) and Air Operations & Services as well as Space.

What we offer you

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing and professional growth, which includes:

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)
- 24 hours volunteering paid for
- Private healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life cover
- 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app
- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
- Gym membership discounts

Main Responsibilities

- Lead and deliver all Safety & Environmental Management (S&EM) activities within integrated project teams, ensuring compliance with the IAS Safety Management System and the effective assurance of safety-critical programmable elements
- Conduct hazard identification, hazard analysis and risk assessment activities, defining robust safety and environmental requirements across system performance, design, integration, interfaces and verification activities
- Influence multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, developing clear, evidence-based safety arguments that ensure S&EM requirements are understood, implemented and maintained throughout the product lifecycle
- Champion compliance with relevant safety and environmental standards, legislation, policies and governance processes, acting as a trusted subject matter expert and promoting best practice across IAS programmes
- Plan and manage S&EM work packages, including estimating engineering effort, producing high-quality hazard analysis reports and safety cases, and generating the assurance evidence required to support certification and customer confidence

About You

At Thales, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Ideal Experience & Skills

- Proven academic background in Engineering or Science, supported by relevant safety training and professional development; Chartered Engineer status or professional institution membership is highly desirable
- Proven experience leading Safety Engineering activities within complex, highly regulated engineering programmes, delivering risk reduction, compliance and successful project outcomes
- Demonstrated expertise in hazard analysis, risk assessment and safety case development, creating robust safety arguments and assurance evidence to support certification
- Proven knowledge of safety-critical systems engineering, including the development and assurance of programmable elements and the application of SILs, DALs and related assurance methodologies
- Demonstrated understanding of product safety standards, legislation and environmental management principles, including experience applying Defence Standard 00-055 and associated standards
- Acquired capability to apply a whole-life systems engineering approach, influencing design decisions and supporting products from concept through to certification and in-service operation

Ready to influence the safety of some of the world's most advanced defence systems? Join Thales and play a key role in delivering the next generation of safe, compliant and mission-ready technology.

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires Security Clearance (SC). It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

Qualifications

- Postgraduate studies in Systems Engineering (Desirable)

Essential Experience

Regulatory Compliance Requirement

Key Areas of Responsibility

- Tailor the system engineering process, practices and tools.
- Provide timely and accurate status updates.

- Develop the preliminary and detailed designs for system and subsystem elements.

Ben je in brede zin verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van de beschikbaarheid van onderdelen, soft- en hardware, en voorkom je dat systemen uitvallen door veroudering. Het obsolescence beleid en bijbehorende plannen communiceer je binnen Thales naar belangrijke stakeholders en je initieert na goedkeuring van de plannen het change management proces om de plannen uit te laten voeren.

Aangezien onze oplossing vooral IT en beveiligingsapparatuur betreft, is het essentieel dat je al ervaring hebt met dergelijke producten en software en de bijbehorende marktdynamiek.

Wat je gaat doen

- Vaardigheden: Analytisch, leiderschap, effectieve communicatie met interne en externe stakeholders, proactieve houding en vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels. title: SOC Service Delivery Manager (H/F)
description:
Lieu : Elancourt, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

Nos engagements, vos avantages

- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques.

Au sein de Thales, nos équipes de Thales Cyber Solutions fournissent un large spectre de services de cybersécurité, allant de la gouvernance cyber à l’expertise technique pointue en passant par les services de détection et de réponse qui sont délivrés à partir de nos SOC, ou encore l’analyse forensics et l’intelligence sur la menace.

Nos clients sont des grands groupes, des OIV, des OSE ayant à protéger des systèmes IT ou OT critiques ou encore des organisations gouvernementales.

Votre quotidien

Au sein de de Thales, notre équipe assure la surveillance (Monitoring de sécurité 24/7, Log Management, Orchestration, Sondes), la prévention (Veille en relation avec un CERT) et le management des systèmes de sécurité de nos clients (Audits de vulnérabilités, Gestion des Identités et des Accès, Reportings de sécurité).

Intégré(e) à l’équipe « Service Delivery Manager » du SOC, vous synchronisez toutes les parties prenantes, équipes, fournisseurs, clients en vue de réaliser les objectifs d’un contrat. Vous en êtes le chef d’orchestre !

Dans ce contexte, vos missions principales consistent à :

- Assurer la relation client et le suivi du contrat

Participation aux instances de gouvernance avec le client

Suivi de la qualité de la prestation avec l’élaboration et surtout l’exploitation de différents indicateurs

Amélioration continue de la prestation pour accroitre la valeur ajoutée des services et leur productivité

Rapports réguliers : Fournir des rapports détaillés aux parties prenantes sur l'état des projets, incluant les performances actuelles par rapport aux objectifs prévus

Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

For the SMU Team (sensor management unit) we are looking for a software engineer (C/C++) with strong analytical skills and effective communication abilities. You will not only be a developer writing software but also be involved in integrations and troubleshooting, primarily ensuring the software operates correctly across various radar systems. In this role, you will act as a connector across disciplines and work within a close-knit team.

About Thales

Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.

Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.

About the job

Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.

The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.

About you

Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.

The requirement is a completed Master’s degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (minimum 2 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus.

You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.

Screening Criteria

- Minimum of 2+ years of experience in C++ software development
- Experience with Real-Time Software development
- Proficiency with Linux operating systems
- Experience working as part of a large software development organization
- Effective team player
- Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven
- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent
- Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
- Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification
- Language: Native or near-native Dutch (C1/C2), combined with professional English

What's in it for you

- A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
- Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
- A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
- You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
- A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
- 40 days paid-time-off per year.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Location: Praha, Czechia

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language.

The Solution Architect, based in Praha, will define the technical vision and target architecture for secure, scalable IAM platforms and AI-native engineering capabilities. The role combines deep systems architecture expertise with hands-on leadership in agentic AI, AI coding agents, and modern software delivery.

The architect will design identity capabilities for workforce, customer, partner, machine, workload, and AI-agent identities, covering authentication, authorization, governance, adaptive access, threat detection, and secure delegation.

The role will lead AI-native practices across architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, and operations. The successful candidate must use and govern AI coding agents in real engineering workflows and design agentic systems with bounded autonomy, traceability, and enterprise-grade quality, security, privacy, and compliance.

Day in the Life of a Solution Architect:

- Own the target architecture and roadmap for IAM and AI-enabled platforms, aligned with business strategy, Zero Trust, privacy, security, and responsible AI.
- Architect identity, lifecycle, credential, authorization, delegation, governance, audit, and threat-detection capabilities for human and non-human identities.
- Design agentic AI systems that plan, use tools, collaborate, and execute multi-step workflows within defined security and operational boundaries.
- Define guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, human approval, tool access, runtime isolation, context, observability, auditability, and safe failure.
- Lead AI-native engineering across requirements, architecture, coding, testing, reviews, documentation, deployment, and operations.
- Use AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and delivery automation.
- Govern AI-assisted development through approved-tool controls, data protection, output validation, secure review, provenance, and traceability.
- Translate business outcomes into reference architectures, decision records, quality attributes, service objectives, and implementation guardrails.
- Architect resilient cloud-native, distributed, event-driven, and API-first systems with strong production readiness and cost efficiency.
- Lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, technical discovery, proofs of concept, build-versus-buy analysis, and cross-functional decisions.
- Partner with product, engineering, security, data, operations, compliance, and legal teams to deliver secure, auditable, resilient solutions.
- Mentor architects and engineers and produce clear, reusable architecture guidance, threat models, diagrams, evaluations, and runbooks.

Requirements:

- 10+ years designing and delivering complex software platforms, with substantial architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional delivery responsibility.
- Minimum requirement: hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI solutions using planning, tool invocation, retrieval, context or memory, multi-step workflows, and human or policy controls.
- Minimum requirement: hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding agents for repository analysis, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, reviews, documentation, or delivery automation.
- Experience governing AI-generated code through human review, automated testing, security scanning, secrets and dependency checks, provenance, and auditability.
- Strong generative AI knowledge covering models, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, model and tool selection, evaluation, observability, cost, and responsible AI.
- Practical understanding of agent risks, including prompt injection, excessive agency, insecure tool use, data leakage, identity spoofing, supply-chain compromise, and unsafe actions.
- Strong experience with cloud-native, distributed, multi-tenant systems, APIs, asynchronous messaging, containers, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, and observability.
- Deep IAM knowledge, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn, passkeys, PKI, workload identity, secrets, and policy-based authorization.
- Strong system-design fundamentals across domain and API design, resilience, consistency, scalability, performance, security, privacy, data architecture, and operations.
- Hands-on capability across modern programming ecosystems, quality engineering, threat modeling, technical specifications, architecture decisions, and reference implementations.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders, lead technical decisions, mentor engineers, and align product, engineering, security, and operations.
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to have:

- Experience in IAM across customer or workforce identity, federation, SSO, MFA, passwordless access, lifecycle governance, privileged access, and fine-grained authorization.
- Experience architecting identity, authorization, delegation, and governance for AI agents and other non-human identities.
- Experience with secure agent-to-tool and agent-to-agent integration, including Model Context Protocol or equivalent approaches.
- Experience with specification-driven development, reusable AI workflows, and organization-wide AI-assisted engineering adoption.
- Experience evaluating, red-teaming, monitoring, and responding to incidents involving generative or agentic AI systems.
- Experience with AI-enabled identity or security capabilities, including adaptive access, behavioral analytics, threat detection, fraud, risk scoring, or identity proofing.
- Experience designing model-agnostic AI platforms, enterprise knowledge integration, reusable agents, and cost-aware model routing.
- Experience with software and AI supply-chain security, regulated platforms, or contributions to architecture communities, standards, publications, or open source.

title: Sr Software Developer
description:
Location: Vancouver - Burrard St, Canada

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

This is a hybrid position in Vancouver, BC

Position Summary

As a member of a collaborative development team, the Sr. Software Developer will be instrumental in the design and implementation of secure Key Management Platform & SaaS Service.

Essential Functions

- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable microservices in a containerized cloud environment under technical guidance.
- Implement features that support multi-tenancy, high availability, scalability, manageability, and extensibility.
- Apply test-driven development practices and automation to improve software quality and reliability.

- Stay current with relevant cloud, server-side development, database, and security technologies.
- Work closely with customer support and operations teams to investigate production issues and contribute to timely resolution.

Minimum Requirements

- 5-8 years of related experience as a software engineer.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production or production-like environments.
- Experience developing, deploying, or supporting SaaS applications and cloud-native services.
- Programming experience with Go, C, C++, or similar server-side programming languages.
- Experience designing, developing, or consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with API documentation tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI.
- Experience developing high-availability database-centric enterprise software using relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
- Experience troubleshooting software, databases, and application performance issues, including blocking and deadlocking scenarios.
- Experience with Linux software development, packaging, testing, release processes, and scripting languages.
- Working knowledge of security standards or concepts such as PKI, PKCS, or KMIP.
- Familiarity with databases and schema design concepts.
- Strong problem-solving, written, verbal, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience or familiarity with Key Management, cryptographic services, or security-focused platform applications.
- Working knowledge of secure coding practices, security principles, and common application security considerations.
- Familiarity with cloud provider SDKs and services in AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Familiarity with a wide range of commercial agreements, including licensing, hardware, services, software-related contracts, and data privacy terms.
- High integrity, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong written and oral communication skills with significant experience collaborating closely with internal stakeholders and external customers, partners, and suppliers.

Ce stage de 6 mois porte sur la goniométrie qui a pour objectif l’estimation des directions d’arrivée d’émetteurs radioélectriques à partir des signaux reçus sur un réseau d’antennes.

Outre les méthodes de goniométrie classiques telles que le beamforming et MUSIC développées entre les années 60 et 80, de nouvelles méthodes sont apparues au début des années 2000 : les méthodes de goniométrie parcimonieuse. Ces méthodes présentent des performances supérieures en comparaison aux méthodes classiques. Elles permettent notamment d’estimer plus de sources que d’antennes. Les algorithmes de détection et reconnaissance automatique d’objets dans les images nécessitent des bases de données vastes et diversifiées. Cependant, la collecte et l’annotation de données réelles représentent un coût important. L’IA générative, notamment les techniques d’inpainting basées sur des modèles comme Stable Diffusion, offre la possibilité d’augmenter ces bases en générant des images synthétiques réalistes.

Le travail portera à la fois sur la génération des images et à la fois sur des expériences d’entrainements visant à démontrer le gain apporté en complément des bases d’images réelles.

Sur la génération d’images : Le stagiaire pourra s’appuyer sur un pipeline existant d’inpainting permettant d’incruster des véhicules militaires dans des images réelles. L’inpainting est une technique de restauration ou de modification d’images où certaines régions sont complétées ou remplacées par du contenu généré. Les méthodes récentes utilisent des modèles de diffusion (Stable Diffusion notamment), capables de générer des images de haute qualité à partir de masques et de prompts textuels.

Par ailleurs, l’intégration de modèles 3D permet de contrôler précisément la géométrie, la pose et l’éclairage des objets générés (ici des véhicules), améliorant ainsi le réalisme et la variété des incrustations. Par ailleurs, le stagiaire sera amené à faire une veille sur les technologies et dernières avancées dans le domaine de la génération d’images et de vidéo.

Sur les expériences d’entrainement visant à prouver le gain apporté par les bases d’images générées. Le stagiaire s’appuiera sur les bases d’images réelles déjà annotées. Il pourra proposer et mettre en œuvre des plans d’expérience portant à la fois sur les splits train/val/test mais aussi sur les stratégies d’entrainement permettant de limiter que les réseaux ne s’accrochent sur les artefacts liés à l’incrustation ou à la génération d’images.

- Appropriation de la problématique, des outils de génération et (1 mois)

- Génération d’une base d’images destinées à l’entrainement des modèles (2 mois)

- Appropriation des outils d’entrainement, proposition et mise en œuvre d’un plan d’expérience (2 mois)

Pour cela, il réalise notamment des études, des simulations et des essais afin de contribuer au choix des solutions techniques, leur validation physique, ainsi qu'au maintien du produit en conditions opérationnelles. Le résultat des simulations numériques et les données issues des essais constituent un volume de données important et essentiels pour nous accompagner à différentes phases de vie de nos produits.

Il est donc nécessaire de pouvoir questionner ces données, les exploiter pour prédire le comportement statique et dynamique du radar en modulant différents paramètres.

Ce stage a pour objectif principal de faire le pont entre la science des données et l'ingénierie mécanique. Ce rôle permet de transformer la donnée brute en valeur industrielle exploitable en vue de développer des produits fiables et compétitifs.

- Gouvernance des données : Définir l'architecture de stockage des données issues de d’essais et/ou de simulations.
- Nettoyage et standardisation : Traiter les données brutes de capteurs (filtrage du bruit, recalage temporel, correction des anomalies de mesure).
- Structuration des métadonnées : Associer chaque fichier de données au contexte de l'essai (type de radar, configuration du test, vitesse, emplacement du capteur)
- Mise à disposition : Créer des pipelines de données automatiques pour que les ingénieurs calculs et essais accèdent instantanément aux bonnes informations.
- Extraction de caractéristiques : Le signal brut est transformé via des analyses temporelles et fréquentielles
- Dynamique des solides : comprendre interpréter le comportement dynamique des radars

Les approches fondées sur les modèles de diffusion ouvrent une voie prometteuse pour synthétiser des jeux de données à la fois réalistes et massivement diversifiés, permettant d'enrichir et compléter les corpus internes sans dépendre exclusivement de nouvelles campagnes d'acquisition. Le défi central réside dans l'intégration effective de ces jeux de données générés aux boucles d'entraînement existantes. Cette intégration pose deux problèmes majeurs : d'une part garantir que les objets générés portent une information discriminante utile à l'apprentissage et d'autre part intégrer ces données de manière cohérente dans les boucles d'entraînement existantes.

La mission spatiale LISA de l’ESA vise à détecter et observer des ondes gravitationnelles depuis l’espace. Dans ce cadre, le GlobalIndex sert de catalogue interne pour le centre de données, afin de localiser, identifier et consulter les données stockées dans le GlobalStorage via des métadonnées. La première, dite « Flexible », évite un schéma relationnel classique : elle utilise des colonnes fixes pour les métadonnées techniques et des dictionnaires JSON libres pour les métadonnées métier. La seconde, dite « Relationnelle », s’appuie sur des schémas relationnels structurés générés à partir des modèles de données, afin de renforcer l’intégrité, la maintenabilité et les performances à long terme.

Le travail attendu prévoit la conception et le développement de deux prototypes, leur test à une charge représentative, puis une analyse comparative sur la montée en charge, les performances lecture/écriture, l’évolutivité et la complexité d’intégration et d’exploitation.

Entre Nantes et Angers, proche de la côte Atlantique, notre site de Cholet à dominante R&D et à forte empreinte industrielle, est spécialisé dans les radiocommunications de défense, les systèmes de communications par satellites et les solutions de cybersécurité.

La gestion thermique performante génère de forts gradients et une humidité relative importante près des équipements, entraînant diffusion et condensation de vapeur d’eau internes.

La modélisation et la caractérisation expérimentale de ces phénomènes sont essentielles pour anticiper les risques dans des zones critiques, notamment sur les cartes électroniques, en particulier lorsque la respirabilité est assurée via valves ou évents.

- Prendre en main les outils de simulation thermo-fluidiques sur des cas simples,
- Caractériser les phénomènes sur banc de tests et mesurer les vitesses d’équilibrage des pressions,
- Modéliser les phénomènes de diffusion et condensation, comparer les mesures et simulations, vérifier les données fabricants,
- Rédiger une synthèse critique des travaux expérimentaux et de simulation pour valider les modèles.
