Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun.

Une des missions du centre de compétence Hardware Technologies, Tools & Engineering, consiste à définir des protocoles radio et des traitements numériques du signal qui seront

utilisés dans les équipements, ainsi que leur implémentation et leurs évolutions. Dans le contexte des réseaux de communication sans fil, nous étudions des solutions pour optimiser dynamiquement l’allocation des ressources et en particulier les schémas d’allocation de modulation et codage (AMC) selon les conditions de propagation.

Nous avons développé chez Thales une technique d’abstraction de liens utilisant des réseaux de neurones profonds qui permet de prédire la probabilité d’erreur paquet d’un lien à partir des mesures de SNR instantanés estimés au récepteur.

Vos missions

Nous cherchons à compléter cette solution afin de réaliser l’AMC ce qui nécessite d’apprendre plusieurs réseaux de neurones profonds pour différentes configurations de modulation et codage (MCS).

Votre mission sera d’abord de comprendre le modèle du système ainsi que la solution existante chez Thales, et de prendre en main la simulation permettant d’entrainer les réseaux de neurones profonds. Ensuite, l’objectif sera de mettre au point l’algorithme d’AMC et d’en évaluer les performances. La mission s’organisera comme suit :

• Une analyse et prise en main de la partie abstraction de lien comprenant l’apprentissage des réseaux de neurones profonds pour les différents schémas de codage et modulations.

• Développer l’algorithme d’AMC utilisant les réseaux de neurones appris.

• L’évaluation par simulations des solutions proposées.

En nous rejoignant, vous intégrerez le laboratoire High Performance Computing (HPC) de cortAIx, au sein du centre de recherche Thales Research & Technology de Palaiseau. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement de recherche dédié au développement de solutions innovantes pour les systèmes embarqués, avec des expertises en intelligence artificielle embarquée, en conception de calculateurs à haute performance énergétique, en développement logiciel parallèle et en conception matérielle ASIC/FPGA.

Vous contribuerez à des travaux autour du processeur RISC-V CVA6, une plateforme d'étude utilisée pour l'exploration de nouvelles techniques micro-architecturales.

Dans les processeurs modernes, les performances sont souvent limitées par les accès mémoire. Les mécanismes de préchargement (« prefetching ») permettent d'anticiper les données nécessaires à l'exécution afin de réduire les latences mémoire. Toutefois, les approches traditionnelles présentent certaines limites dans des cas d'usage spécifiques.

Des travaux récents menés au laboratoire ont exploré la prédiction d'adresses mémoire à partir du compteur ordinal (Program Counter) d'instructions de chargement. Cette approche ouvre la voie à de nouvelles architectures de préchargement capables d'initier les accès mémoire avant même que l'adresse effective ne soit calculée par le pipeline.

Vos travaux porteront sur l'étude, la conception et l'évaluation d'un mécanisme de préchargement mémoire reposant sur cette prédiction d'adresse et son intégration au sein du processeur RISC-V CVA6. Ils viseront notamment à améliorer les performances des architectures RISC-V et à analyser leur impact sur la hiérarchie mémoire.

Dans ce contexte, vous aurez pour missions :

- Réaliser une étude bibliographique sur les techniques de prédiction d’adresses, de prédiction de valeur et de pré-chargement mémoire matériel. Une attention particulière sera portée aux mécanismes permettant d’anticiper les accès mémoire à partir d’informations disponibles très en amont dans le pipeline.
- Analyser l’architecture du processeur CVA6 ainsi que l’infrastructure de la Load Store Unit (LSU) afin d’identifier le meilleur point d’intégration d’un mécanisme de pré-chargement basé sur une prédiction d’adresse.
- Concevoir une architecture de pré-chargement exploitant les adresses prédites afin de déclencher proactivement des accès mémoire. Plusieurs problématiques de recherche pourront être étudiées :
- Conception d’un indicateur de confiance permettant d’évaluer la fiabilité des prédictions
- Limitation des effets de pollution dans le DTLB et les caches de données
- Étude de mécanismes permettant d’annuler ou retarder certains pré-chargements lorsque leur probabilité de succès est faible
- Analyse des interactions entre l’unité de pré-chargement et les mécanismes de dépendances mémoire déjà présents dans le processeur
- Exploration des synergies possibles avec l’unité de pré-chargement afin d’améliorer les performances globales du pipeline
- Enfin, vous implémenterez la solution proposée en SystemVerilog, l’intégrerez au sein de CVA6 et évaluerez expérimentalement son impact sur différents benchmarks.

Une poursuite en thèse CIFRE pourra être envisagée à l’issue de ce stage.

In Nederland, waar meer dan 2500 medewerkers werkzaam zijn, hebben we vestigingen in zeven steden: Huizen, Amersfoort, Rotterdam, Delft, Breda, Eindhoven en Hengelo (hoofdkantoor). De afdeling en het team;
De Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) afdeling is een belangrijke speler bij Thales als het gaat om het beheren van onze demand en supply op middellange en lange termijn. In de snelgroeiende defensiemarkt is dit proces voor Thales cruciaal. Deze afdeling, sinds 2020 actief en nog steeds in ontwikkeling, heeft een belangrijke rol binnen onze organisatie.

De S&OP afdeling, bestaande uit 9 medewerkers, zorgt voor het plannen en sturen van het demand- en supplyproces. Regelmatig levert de afdeling een gevalideerd demand- en supplyplan, dat door de interne organisatie wordt opgevolgd. Daarnaast helpt de afdeling bij het nemen van beslissingen over toekomstige verschillen tussen demand en supply.

Over de opdracht

De S&OP afdeling bestaat nu vier jaar en maakt de overgang van projectmatig naar procesgericht werken. Door de complexe en specifieke aard van het S&OP proces is het essentieel om alle procedures, regels, criteria en werkwijzen duidelijk en concreet vast te leggen in een handboek.

Wij zijn op zoek naar iemand die deze informatie overzichtelijk kan samenvoegen. Dit handboek moet een nuttig naslagwerk worden voor iedereen die betrokken is bij het S&OP proces, met uitleg en toelichting voor alle relevante onderdelen.

Het proces omvat een breed scala aan aandachtsgebieden en er zijn veel interne afdelingen bij betrokken. Tijdens het opstellen van het handboek heb je regelmatig contact met onder andere Sales, Finance, de Supply Chain en vanzelfsprekend het S&OP team.

- Marketing

Je bent veelzijdig, hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, een helicopterview en kunt gedetailleerde informatie omzetten naar een geordend geheel.

- Een interessante stage-/ of afstudeerplek binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving;

title: STAMP Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer
description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

We are looking for an experienced Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer to join our Air Traffic Control and Network Infrastructure team. This unique role combines overseas operational support in the Falkland Islands with project engineering and system development activities in the UK, offering an exciting opportunity to work on mission-critical communications and air traffic management infrastructure.

This position is ideally suited to someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working independently, and has a passion for maintaining and developing complex technical systems in challenging environments.

Location: Falkland Islands & Crawley

What the role has to offer

You'll play a key role in maintaining and supporting critical network infrastructure and air traffic control systems, ensuring operational availability in a demanding and remote environment.

The role includes rotational deployments to the Falkland Islands, typically comprising 10-week assignments, working alongside a team of engineers to provide continuous support. When not deployed, you will be based in the UK, supporting engineering projects, future network solutions and technology transition activities.

Flights to and from the Falkland Islands are provided, with accommodation and meals supplied whilst in territory.

What you'll be doing

As an Overseas Maintenance & UK Support Engineer, you will:

- Deliver Level 1 and Level 2 maintenance activities, with occasional involvement in Level 3 support activities.
- Perform corrective maintenance including fault diagnosis, troubleshooting, equipment repair and replacement of Line Replaceable Units (LRUs).
- Carry out software updates, system configuration changes and testing activities.
- Undertake preventative maintenance to ensure equipment performance remains within operational parameters.
- Complete planned maintenance tasks including equipment inspections, cleaning, battery checks and system housekeeping activities.
- Produce maintenance reports and provide timely updates to Thales stakeholders.
- Collaborate with remote specialist engineers during complex fault investigations.
- Support engineering project activities, planning and service improvement initiatives.
- Contribute to the development, verification and transition of future network solutions and replacement SDH technologies.
- Support the delivery of critical communications and air traffic management services in a highly operational environment.

About you

We're looking for a motivated engineer who can work independently, solve problems effectively and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues alike.

- Minimum 4 years' experience working with SDH or similar telecommunications/network infrastructure equipment.
- Experience in fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and equipment rectification.
- At least 1 year's experience in an airside engineering maintenance environment.
- Experience working within military or civil Air Traffic Control environments.
- Experience supporting system development, integration or transition into service activities.
- Ability to obtain and maintain UK Security Clearance (SC).

Desirable knowledge

Experience with one or more of the following:

- SDH systems
- Air Traffic Control Tower systems
- Air Navigation or Navigational Aid systems
- Communications and network infrastructure technologies

Skills and behaviours

You'll be someone who demonstrates:

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong report writing and documentation skills.
- Good IT proficiency including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio.
- High levels of self-motivation and initiative.
- The ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
- Adaptability and willingness to work in remote locations.
- A collaborative and team-focused approach.

Security Clearance Requirement

UK Eyes Only:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels.

title: System Product Owner
description:

As a System Product Owner within Thales, you will act as the primary interface between product stakeholders and the engineering team, ensuring that development activities remain aligned with product objectives, customer needs, technical constraints and delivery commitments.

1. Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment

- Ensure completeness, consistency and traceability of requirements across the development lifecycle.
- Define and review User Stories and Acceptance Criteria in collaboration with engineering teams.
- Continuously refine and prioritise backlog items according to business value, technical dependencies, risks and available capacity.

- Promote continuous improvement in requirements quality, engineering collaboration and delivery practices.
- Contribute to improving team autonomy, knowledge sharing and overall product quality.

- You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

- You have previous experience in Product Ownership, technical project management or system-level product development, ideally within an Agile environment.
- You have a strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate them into clear technical and functional requirements.
- You demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex systems and competing priorities.
- You are an effective communicator, able to engage and align engineering teams, product stakeholders and management.
- You are autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of technical and functional decisions within your scope.
- You demonstrate a collaborative mindset, a customer-oriented approach and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Systems Engineering & Technical Expertise

- Solid understanding of Systems Engineering principles, requirements management, system architecture and functional decomposition.

- Familiarity with software development lifecycles, testing practices, configuration management and engineering quality standards.

- Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban and Agile at Scale.
- Experience managing and prioritising backlogs, defining Features and User Stories, and establishing clear Acceptance Criteria.
- Ability to translate Epics and Features into actionable development activities while ensuring functional and technical consistency.
- Proficiency with Agile management tools, particularly Jira.
- Ability to balance customer value, technical constraints, delivery capacity and project commitments.

Stakeholder & Financial Management

- Ability to coordinate effectively with Coordinator Product Owners (CPO), Initiative Owners (IO), engineering teams and other stakeholders.
- Understanding of budget allocation, cost tracking and financial performance monitoring at Epic and Feature levels.
- Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM), progress reporting and variance analysis.

- Experience in Air Traffic Management (ATM), Air Traffic Control (ATC) or other safety-critical systems.
- Knowledge of complex, distributed and real-time software-intensive systems.

title: System Test Engineer
description:
Location: Den Helder, Netherlands

Over het team:

In de huidige wereld van dreiging is de operationele beschikbaarheid van onze klanten van groot belang en daarmee het verlenen van een goede service. Binnen Thales Hengelo is Services een domein wat sterk groeit en is één van de speerpunten voor de toekomst. De services worden geleverd op de geleverde radarsystemen, waaronder technische assistenties, reparaties, overhauls en modificaties/ upgrades. De totale Services-afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 100 mensen.

Over jouw toekomstige baan

In de functie van System Test Engineer maak je deel uit van een team van engineers en monteurs die werkzaam zijn namens Thales Hengelo bij de onderhoudsorganisatie van de Koninklijke Marine (DMI) in Den Helder. De Marine heeft meerdere schepen die zijn uitgerust met high tech radarsystemen van Thales en gedurende de gehele levenscyclus ondersteuning nodig hebben. Daarnaast wordt in Den Helder ook voor de Koninklijke Landmacht de radarsystemen onderhouden. Je bent met het team verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoer van verschillende services activiteiten.

We bieden de mogelijkheid om te werken in een boeiend en technisch uitdagend domein met integratie van radar- en elektro-optische systemen. Deze systemen omvatten ultramoderne radarantennes, verwerkings- en ondersteunende systemen. In de rol van System Test Engineer werk je gedurende de gehele levenscyclus aan deze systemen en zelfstandig integreren en testen van radar- en elektro-optische systemen.

- Uitvoeren van testen op locatie, aan boord in de haven en op zee
- Evaluatie van de prestaties van het systeem in zijn operationele omgeving
- Optreden als troubleshooter bij technische en/of performance problemen
- Diensten verlenen zoals systeemgezondheidscontroles, onderhoud en reparatie.

Het onboardingstraject voor de functie vindt plaats bij Thales in Hengelo voor een periode tussen de 6 en 12 maanden afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Gedurende deze periode zul je diverse trainingen volgen en inwerken op de GM200-systeem. In Den Helder zul je daarnaast inwerken op andere systemen van Thales.

Na de eerste 6 tot 12 maanden werk je hoofdzakelijk op het terrein bij de Marine en eventueel op klantlocaties over de hele wereld om onze services aan de klanten te leveren om ervoor te zorgen dat de systemen operationeel beschikbaar blijven. Incidenteel zul je bij Thales in Hengelo werken.

Belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

- Verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van een of meerdere servicecontracten binnen de gestelde tijd, kwaliteit en budget.
- Het operationeel leiden en vertegenwoordigen van het test engineering supportteam.
- Actieve rol in het bepalen van de productbeleid en instandhoudingsstrategie.
- Ondersteuning in het opzetten van calculaties en analyse van de financiële resultaten.
- Op tijd signaleren en proactief oplossen van blokkerende problemen.
- Continue verbeteren van processen en leveringsresultaten.
- Rapporteren aan het de Project Manager en Workcell Leider van de voortgang van het contract.

Waarom ben jij een goede match:

- In bezit is van een MBO, HBO of WO diploma en bij voorkeur op het gebied van Elektrotechniek, Elektronica, Informatica, Technische Natuurkunde of Mechatronica.
- Affiniteit met radarsystemen, affiniteit met analoge technieken, de Linux terminal of computernetwerken zijn een pré.
- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en in staat om in multi-disciplinaire teams te werken.
- Vloeiend in Engels en Nederlands woord en schrift, andere taalvaardigheden zijn een pré.
- Analytisch en probleem oplossend vermogen.
- Stressbestendig en zelfstandig.
- Inlevingsvermogen in andere culturen en gebruiken.
- Klantgericht en professionaliteit in omgang met de externe klant.
- Beschikbaarheid tot (internationale) reizen.

Wat krijg jij er voor terug

- Een uitdagende baan in een leuk team binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving. Inclusief alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën.
- Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, commercieel of internationaal vlak.
- Waardevolle internationale samenwerkingen met collega’s en klanten.
- Een comfortabele werkplek in een moderne omgeving, met aandacht voor flexibiliteit en de juiste work-life balance.
- Werken mag meestal waar en wanneer je wil. Binnen Thales mikken we op een 60/40 balans, waarbij je in elk geval twee dagen in de week thuis kunt werken als je rol dit toelaat.
- Een goed salaris, passende reiskostenvergoeding en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden te personaliseren: je kunt bijvoorbeeld vrije dagen ruilen voor internetkosten, ons fietsenplan, bedrijfsfitness en verhuiskosten.
- 40 vakantiedagen per jaar. Ja, echt.

Interesse?

Dat betekent dat gelijke kansen, inclusiviteit en een informele cultuur een essentieel onderdeel uitmaken van ons succes. Maar ook dat jouw gezondheid en geluk voor ons erg belangrijk zijn! • Contribute to the definition the cybersecurity technical policy of its scope of responsibility and the associated roadmap
• Report to Head of Cybersecurity the TAS-I cybersecurity risks and KPI regarding Bids and Cyber Security compliance on a regular basis
• Share with TAS-I Centers of Competences the security status and costs of their supplies for projects during Bid and before going into service

- Monitor and manage daily Security operations, ensuring timely handling escalations, and security incidents.

- Analyse web traffic, attack patterns, and anomalous activities across customer environments.

- Actively participate in customer calls to manage escalations and maintain customer confidence.

Technical Leadership & SME Responsibilities

- Support cross-functional teams including TAM, Professional Services, Sales Engineers, and Threat Research teams.

- Lead troubleshooting efforts for complex security incidents

- Collaborate with Product Development teams to improve platform capabilities and operational workflows.

- Participate in weekly technical reviews and escalation management meetings.

Training & Mentorship

- Mentor and onboard new Security engineers through structured training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

- Conduct regular technical workshops and cross-team enablement sessions.

- Audit and provide feedback on cases handled by junior engineers.

- Maintain and improve internal training materials, documentation, and operational runbooks.

- Enable internal stakeholders through product training, traffic profiling guidance, and policy tuning best practices.

Process Improvement & Automation

- Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements, automations, and efficiency initiatives.

- Drive projects that improve team productivity, operational scalability, and incident response effectiveness.

- Contribute to transformation initiatives, automation frameworks, and tooling enhancements.

- Maintain and update internal Knowledge Base documentation with relevant technical and operational information.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with strategic and high-priority customers within the assigned region.

- Assist Services and Support teams during major incidents and escalations.

- Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve customer security configurations and operational outcomes.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- Minimum 4+ years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, SOC Engineering, or related cybersecurity roles.

- Strong understanding of web application security, cloud security, and network security fundamentals.

- Hands-on experience with web technologies and protocols including HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, DNS, TCP/IP, REST APIs, JSON, and JavaScript.

- Experience analyzing security incidents, traffic behavior, and attack mitigation techniques.

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage technical customer interactions.

Preferred Technical Skills

- Experience with Imperva or similar Cloud Application Security/WAF platforms.

- Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or multi-cloud security environments.

- Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).

- Understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and web attack vectors.

- Experience with scripting or automation tools such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

- Exposure to SIEM, SOAR, and security automation technologies.

- Experience creating dashboards and analytical reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Technical Lead/Sr. Technical Lead - System IVVQ Engineer

Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Senior Technical Lead. In this role, you will be responsible for Hardware System and Hardware Solution design Engineer, trade-off analysis, feasibility studies, Proposal preparation, detailed design and IVVQ for various Thales products (Defense and aerospace applications) including Obsolescence redesign.

Qualifications: B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation engineering or equivalent with 10 to 15 years of relevant experience. Higher qualifications of Post-graduation is desirable. Domain experience in Defense, avionics and communication products is desirable.

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As a Lead/ Senior Technical Lead System and Hardware Solution Engineer, you will be a major actor in the System Development, Validation and Test.

- Developing system requirements, requirement validation and contribute to architecture development.

- Maintain traceability of system requirements across hardware, software and firmware

- Perform trade-off analysis of different technologies and feasibility studies to propose the best architecture design

- Lead and co-ordinate the architectural studies of Hardware under his/her responsibility

- Identify risks and opportunities related to the hardware system architecture

- Help team to achieve “System level Design for testability and manufacturability”

- Integration of Hardware, Software and Firmware and performs IVVQ

- Development of Test Plan and Procedures

- Optimize designs to meet performance requirements.

- Suggest and Solve integration issues during verification along with different discipline

- Collaborate with cross functional teams to drive products/solution with quality standards and internal processes

- Develop high-level system development proposal from requirement.

Skills Required

Mandatory Skills:

- Electronics/ Electrical Engineering with 10+ years of experience on Hardware Board design , FPGA designs, Low level software design for Microprocessor/Microcontroller

- Hand-on experience in developing Embedded systems

- Hands-on experience in defining system architecture

- Hands-on experience in Integration of Hardware , Firmware , Software to test and solve integration issues

- Hands-on experience in Board Design and component selection to meet system requirements

- Hands-on experience in developing test plan (ATP, QTP etc.),procedure and perform test

- Hands-on experience in requirement analysis and validation

- Hands-on experience in writing test reports

- Knowledge of BSP and low level driver

- Experience in Ethernet based system development and test

- Different bus protocols like I2C, SPI, QSPI, UART, DDR3/4, PCIe, JTAG, IEEE 802.3, MII/RGMII

- Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

- Usage of Lab Equipment like DSO, Logic Analyzer , Ethernet packet testers, PCIe analyzer

Good to have

- DO-254 development process

- Knowledge of Operating system e.g. Linux

- Configuration management tools e.g. DOORS/Polarion

- FPGA Firmware development and verification using VHDL/Verilog

Educational Qualification

Bachelor or Masters in Electronics & Communication or equivalent

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Description du projet / rôle / missions

En tant que Senior Scrum Product Owner, vous rejoignez les équipes PAY Digital de Thales Cybersecurity & Digital Identity à La Ciotat, qui développent une plateforme cloud native permettant aux banques et institutions financières de proposer une émission instantanée de cartes digitales et des services de paiement basés sur la tokenisation.

Vous prenez la responsabilité du Core Platform et de la suite d’API de Tokenization, véritables piliers des services de paiement digitaux. Dans ce rôle, votre produit n’a pas d’interface graphique : l’API est le produit. Vous pilotez sa stratégie, son évolution et sa feuille de route, en étroite collaboration avec les Architectes, Tech Leads et équipes de développement, afin de garantir des interfaces robustes, sécurisées et fiables pour des infrastructures bancaires critiques. Vos principales missions consistent à :

- Définir, construire et piloter la roadmap produit en conciliant vision stratégique, besoins clients et priorités de delivery.

- Prioriser et animer le backlog produit afin de maximiser la valeur apportée aux clients et partenaires de l’écosystème.

- Traduire les besoins métiers et techniques en User Stories claires, complètes et accompagnées de critères d’acceptation mesurables.

- Garantir le bon déroulement des cérémonies Agile (grooming, sprint planning, sprint review) et veiller au respect de la Definition of Done.

- Piloter la définition fonctionnelle des API en collaboration avec les Solution Architects et Tech Leads, en assurant leur cohérence, leur évolutivité et leur rétrocompatibilité.

- Définir les spécifications fonctionnelles destinées aux développeurs via le Developer Portal et contribuer à une excellente Developer Experience (DX).

- Définir les objectifs de fiabilité des services (SLI, SLO, disponibilité, performance, latence…) afin de garantir une qualité de service répondant aux exigences des infrastructures bancaires.

- Définir les comportements attendus des services en cas d’incident (gestion des erreurs, modes dégradés, alerting) afin d’assurer la continuité des services de paiement.

- Piloter les fonctionnalités liées au cycle de vie des tokens (provisionnement, activation, suspension, reprise) en interaction avec les principaux réseaux de paiement (Visa, Mastercard…).

- Collaborer avec les équipes sécurité afin de garantir la conformité des solutions aux exigences PCI-DSS ainsi qu’aux standards de sécurité Thales.

- Contribuer à la définition des flux fonctionnels entre les systèmes bancaires, les Card Management Systems (CMS) et les services cloud de paiement.

Votre profil

Votre priorité est de concevoir des produits techniques à forte valeur ajoutée, au cœur des services de paiement digitaux ?

Vous avez l’ambition de piloter la stratégie d’un produit API dans un environnement Cloud, Agile et international ?

Vous souhaitez évoluer sur des sujets mêlant architecture, API, tokenisation et services financiers critiques ?

Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur ou Master en informatique), vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en tant que Product Owner, Product Manager ou dans un rôle technique en développement logiciel ou architecture.

- La gestion de produit en environnement Agile (Scrum).

- Les architectures Backend et les API REST (JSON, versionning, contrats d’API…).

- L’anglais courant, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Vision produit, sens de l’organisation, excellentes capacités de communication, esprit d’analyse, capacité à gérer de multiples dépendances et à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires sont des qualités que l’on vous reconnaît ?

description:
Location: Crawley, United Kingdom

Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales is transforming how engineering tools and services are delivered to our teams. We are looking for a Technical Product Owner – Hardware Engineering Environments to help build the next generation of secure engineering environments across Thales UK.

You will play a central role in modernising the tools used by more than 500 hardware engineers. Working across secure network environments and cloud-based platforms where appropriate, you will help define, deliver and evolve the engineering applications that support our hardware design and development activities.

This is an opportunity to combine practical hardware engineering experience with product ownership, technical architecture and stakeholder leadership.

Location(s): Crawley or Reading or Cheadle or Bristol or Glasgow or any other Thales site in the UK

The opportunity

As Technical Product Owner, you will work within an agile development team and as part of the wider Technical Leadership team. You will represent the needs of engineering users, maximise the value delivered by the development and deployment team, and ensure that engineering environments remain fit for purpose.

You will act as the key interface between:

- Hardware engineering users.

- The Engineering Applications Leadership Team.

- Product Owners across Engineering and Information Services.

- Technical architects and delivery teams.

- Engineering Heads of Discipline.

- The Thales Global Services Hardware Tribe.

You will also act as the Technical Authority and Architect for your area, with key design decisions agreed through the Engineering Applications Portfolio Design Authority.

What you’ll be doing

- Represent the needs of engineering users and champion effective ways of working.

- Own and prioritise the product backlog for your team.

- Define requirements, acceptance criteria and feature priorities.

- Validate and approve completed features.

- Collect user feedback through reviews and continuous engagement.

- Lead the evolution, consolidation and migration of hardware engineering applications.

- Align UK engineering toolsets with Thales Group workbench roadmaps.

- Define and deliver modern engineering environment solutions across secure networks and cloud platforms where appropriate.

- Drive the retirement of legacy tools and reduction of technical debt.

- Plan the migration, retention or archiving of programme data.

- Make important technical and product decisions for your area.

- Ensure that engineering practices, processes, tooling, infrastructure and internal services work together effectively.

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Leads, Portfolio Managers and Delivery Managers to deliver the wider engineering applications strategy.

What you’ll bring

We are interested in hearing from candidates at different stages of their careers. You may be an experienced Product Owner, Technical Lead, Applications Architect or hardware engineer ready to take the next step.

You should bring:

- Practical experience of working in a hardware engineering environment.

- A strong understanding of hardware engineering processes and best practice.

- Knowledge of one or more of the following disciplines:

- Mechanical engineering.

- Electronics.

- Interconnect and cabling.

- FPGA engineering.

- Experience defining, architecting, implementing or managing engineering development environments.

- The ability to understand user needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.

- Experience prioritising work, managing backlogs or coordinating delivery across technical teams.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Useful technical experience

Experience with any of the following tools or equivalent platforms would be advantageous:

- PLM/PDM: Windchill, Teamcenter or ENOVIA.

- MCAD: Creo Parametric, NX, CATIA or SolidWorks.

- ECAD: Cadence Allegro or Altium Designer.

- Interconnect and cabling: Siemens Capital.

- Simulation: Ansys, COMSOL, Abaqus or MATLAB.

- FPGA: AMD Vivado or Intel Quartus.

- Requirements management: Polarion or DOORS.

- Version control: Git.

- Agile and ALM: Jira, Bitbucket or Confluence.

You do not need experience with every tool listed. Relevant experience with equivalent engineering applications will be considered.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electronic, Electrical or a related engineering discipline would be beneficial. Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

- Gym membership discounts

This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services.

Thales is transforming the way in which we deliver our tools to engineers. In this role you will be helping to build the next generation of Engineering Environments in the UK using modern deployment methods on a cloud based platform.

As a Technical Product Owner, you will work both as part of an agile development team and as part of our Technical Leadership team. You will maximise the value of the products delivered by the development / deployment team and are in charge of satisfying the needs of the internal customers. You will also act as the primary interface between the development team, the Portfolio Product Owner and the end users of the engineering environments. You will also act as the Technical Authority/Architect for your specific area.

Key responsibilities:

- Represents the engineering customers/users of the Engineering Environments.
- Specifies the needs, validates the acceptance criteria and approves the completed features.
- Defines the order in which the features for their team will be developed and works with the Portfolio Product Owner and other Product Owners to ensure that this fits with the objectives for the overall team.
- Takes important decisions concerning the direction the solutions for their team.
- Is accountable for the Product Backlog for their team in terms of content and priorities.
- Collects feedback from end users and other stakeholders during iteration reviews

Right for this role?

Ideally you'll have a software or systems engineering background in order to understand and credibly represent & promote best practice ways of working and tooled up processes. One of these roles will champion the non-LEWIS applications (old and new, and how we archive programme work securely), and the other will be more cloud software development environment biased.

We recruit at many levels so we would be very interested to hear from you regardless of your length of experience. However, the following would be very beneficial:

- Thorough understanding of, and experience of applying, the current best practices for software development including: DevSecOps, Agile, CI/CD, TDD, BDD, XP and Lean.
- Understanding of both cloud and secure development environments to be able to architect and improve both existing and new bespoke environments.
- Ability to define and implement a suite of service offerings to support their architected development environments including required tooling, infrastructure, and internal services.
- Good understanding of cloud and enabling technologies and practices including Kubernetes, Containers, GitOps.

Experience in some or all of the following software applications is a plus:

- Attlassian Suite (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence)
- Jfrog Platform (Artifactory/XRay)
- GitLab
- Black Duck
- Siemens Polarion

Thales is a great place to work so diversity, integrity and a passion for what we do are very important drivers for us. We are looking for people from a broad range of engineering disciplines, so no matter your background we would love to hear from you.

Benefits:

- Performance-related bonus
- Half day every Friday, usually finishing around 13:00
- 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with opportunity to buy up to 40 hours/year (pro rata)

- Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers

Security Clearance Requirement:

Due to the nature of the work that we do at Thales, many of our roles are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to be a UK National and achieve Security Clearance (SC) without any caveats. It would be advantageous if currently held, however, if not currently held, it is a requirement that the successful applicant undergo, achieve, and maintain SC Clearance prior to commencing employment. If approved by the MOD, a dual national from a non-ITAR country may be considered.

To be eligible for full SC, you generally need to have resided in the UK for the last 5 years. In some circumstances, a minimum of 3 years’ residence in the UK over the last 5 years may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.

Please visit the UKSV website for further guidance:

Technical Support Engineer (w/m/d)

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Le domaine de la Guerre Électronique (GE) en aéronautique connaît une transformation profonde. Historiquement axée sur la protection réactive des aéronefs, nécessitant principalement une programmation préalable des équipements embarqués, la GE évolue désormais vers des missions plus complexes de Renseignement d’Origine Électromagnétique (ROEM) et d’Attaque Électronique (AE). Ces nouvelles missions exploitent la présence simultanée de multiples aéronefs sur les théâtres d’opérations pour des activités collaboratives et coordonnées.

Dans ce contexte évolutif, la planification GE est devenue un impératif. Elle vise à ordonnancer et synchroniser les activités GE, à prévoir leur réalisation par les charges utiles embarquées sur un ou plusieurs aéronefs, et à s’intégrer dans une planification globale de mission.

L’objectif de cette thèse vise à proposer des solutions de planification globales de cette mission faisant intervenir les aéronefs et leur différentes limitations (liées à leur configuration). L’étude s’appuiera sur des méthodes de résolution multi-objectifs qui intègrent les préférences des décideurs.

Les défis scientifiques s’articulent autour du choix des modèles de préférences, du choix des méthodes d’optimisation, de la possibilité de relâcher des contraintes pour assurer la faisabilité de la mission, la replanification globale ou locale pour l’intégration de contraintes dynamiques.

La mise en œuvre sur des instances de taille réelle est aussi un enjeu de cette thèse. Pour atteindre ces objectifs et relever ces défis, les besoins métiers nécessitent une prise en compte de l’explicabilité (être en mesure de présenter et d’expliquer les alternatives à l’opérateur), nécessitent d’imposer les préférences (ne proposer que des solutions conformes), et de proposer des outils de visualisation (permettant notamment de soutenir l’explicabilité).

- Très bonne maîtrise de l’anglais

Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun.

Cette thèse a pour objectif de développer une nouvelle méthode pour analyser la sensibilité et la vulnérabilité des composants radiofréquence (RF) et numériques utilisés dans différents systèmes radio, comme les réseaux terrestres, aéroportés, maritimes et satellites. L’étude portera sur l’ensemble des chaînes RF et numériques, avec un focus particulier sur des cas concrets liés à la radio terrestre et satellite. Les réseaux concernés incluent notamment les réseaux cellulaires 5G, les systèmes de radionavigation par satellite (ex. Galileo), les réseaux satellitaires en orbite basse (ex. Starlink), les réseaux IoT utilisant la bande UHF (ex. LORA/LORAWAN).

Au sein du département cybersécurité de Thales SIX, vous intégrez le département DES et plus spécifiquement une équipe technique de 10 personnes spécialisées dans les domaines du durcissement électromagnétique de systèmes électroniques, des mesures et de la simulation CEM. Cette équipe jouit également du support d’un expert technique en traitement de signal et forme d'onde composée afin de permettre au futur doctorant d'être encadré et suivi lors de sa thèse.

De plus, le laboratoire XLIM de l'université de Limoges, et plus spécifiquement l’équipe CEM & diffraction, sera aussi porteur du sujet dans le cadre de cette thèse CIFRE. Cette équipe mène des activités de recherche expérimentales, sur l’influence des incertitudes sur les observables, les modèles appris et sur le développement de méthodes numériques et la susceptibilité sur les cartes électroniques. Des techniques numériques sont mises au point pour la modélisation de différentes problématiques CEM et Radar couvrant : les circuits, les topologies de câbles et les structures complexes 3D comme les avions.

Le doctorant sera à la fois amené à travailler au sein de Thales Gennevilliers ainsi qu'au laboratoire XLIM à Limoges. La thèse sera encadrée par l’Université de Limoges (XLIM) et réalisée en collaboration avec Thales SIX (département DES).

Cette thèse sera essentiellement consacrée aux infrastructures et aux terminaux radios civils, et sera partagée entre plusieurs thèmes progressifs et complémentaires, qui aborderont les problématiques scientifiques de :

- Couplage électromagnétique front-door en fonction de la forme d’onde rayonnée sur l’antenne d’une cible RF.

- Dimensionnement des résiduelles conduites en sortie des composants classiques de protection des accès RF.

- Modélisation des susceptibilités de composants constituant les chaînes d’émission / réception RF-NUM actuelles.

- Modélisation des vulnérabilités des chaînes d’émission / réception RF-NUM actuelles complètes.

- Validation des modèles par l’expérimentation.

Cette thèse s’inscrit vise notamment à adresser la multiplication de la présence de drones dans l’espace aérien. Thales développe des systèmes qui doivent permettre une détection précoce et fiable d'objets ou d'individus d'intérêt, souvent observés à grande distance et dans des conditions environnementales dégradées. Les caméras intégrées sur des véhicules en mouvement, offrent un large champ de vision indispensable à la surveillance de l'environnement, mais conduisent à une résolution spatiale limitée des objets d'intérêt, lesquels n'occupent alors que quelques pixels dans l'image. Il s'agit de détecter, le plus en amont possible, des mouvements ou des comportements susceptibles de signaler un événement d'intérêt, dans des environnements complexes. Le déplacement du véhicule porteur du capteur induit un mouvement apparent important de la scène observée, auquel s'ajoutent des effets de parallaxe, des vibrations et des perturbations liées au terrain. Dans ces conditions, le flot optique estimé à partir des séquences d'images est largement dominé par le mouvement propre de la caméra, masquant le mouvement réel des objets d'intérêt faiblement résolus.

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

For decades, Ottawa has been a global technology leader. Today, Canada’s capital holds one of the brightest and most diverse technological ecosystems in North America. Voted as Canada’s best place to live 2017 by Maclean's, Ottawa offers a low cost of living with a high quality of life. The Thales Ottawa office has been a major supplier and long-term trusted partner to DND, enabling the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard to achieve mission success.

Training Solutions Specialist

Ottawa, ON- Hybrid

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

- Requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Export Control List, the ITAR or the EAR
- Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
- Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level

Position Summary

We have a current vacancy for a Training Solutions Specialist who serves as the focal point for the development, sustainment, and continuous improvement of AJISS training solutions. Acting as the link between engineering, supportability, operations, suppliers, and Royal Canadian Navy (RCN) stakeholders, the specialist ensures training products and services remain aligned with evolving system configurations, operational requirements, and customer expectations.

The role combines instructional systems design, courseware development, stakeholder engagement, and training governance activities to support the full lifecycle of AJISS training solutions. The incumbent contributes to training needs analysis, curriculum development, qualification standard support, courseware maintenance, and training delivery coordination while driving improvements to training effectiveness and learner outcomes. Through close collaboration with subject matter experts, suppliers, and customer stakeholders, the Training Solutions Specialist helps ensure AJISS training solutions remain effective, compliant, and operationally relevant.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Training Analysis & Curriculum Development

- Conduct Training Needs Analyses (TNA) to identify and define training requirements in support of AOPS, JSS, and future AJISS capabilities.
- Apply Canadian Forces Individual Training and Education System (CFITES) methodologies and principles in the analysis, design, development, validation, implementation, and evaluation of training programs.
- Develop and maintain training documentation including Training Plans, Qualification Standards and Plans (QSPs), Course Training Standards, Learning Objectives, Assessment Strategies, and supporting curriculum documentation.
- Develop learning objectives, performance measures, and assessment strategies consistent with CFITES methodologies and customer requirements.
- Collaborate with operational, engineering, and supportability subject matter experts to define training requirements and learning outcomes.
- Support the development of training strategies for new capabilities, system upgrades, and in-service support initiatives.

Courseware Design & Development

Design, develop, and maintain instructor-led, practical, and blended learning materials supporting AJISS training objectives.

- Create and revise lesson specifications, lesson plans, instructor guides, student guides, presentations, assessments, practical exercises, and reference materials.
- Ensure training products are technically accurate, instructionally sound, and aligned with approved training standards and operational requirements.
- Coordinate the development and review of training products with SMEs, suppliers, OEMs, and customer stakeholders.
- Support the validation and verification of new or revised training materials prior to implementation.

Training Sustainment & Configuration Management

- Maintain training products throughout the system lifecycle by incorporating engineering, configuration, and procedural changes.
- Assess the training impacts of Engineering Change Proposals, design modifications, and configuration baseline updates.
- Ensure training materials remain aligned with approved technical documentation, system design, and operational procedures.
- Manage training product revisions and maintain configuration control of training documentation and courseware.
- Coordinate translation and publication activities for AJISS training products and documentation.

Training Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

- Assess training effectiveness through learner feedback, stakeholder engagement, performance data, and training evaluations.
- Identify opportunities to improve course content, instructional methodologies, training aids, and learner outcomes.
- Conduct periodic reviews of training programs to ensure continued compliance with customer requirements and CFITES principles.
- Support lessons-learned activities and implement improvements across AJISS training products and processes.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Liaise with RCN stakeholders, training establishments, engineering teams, OEMs, suppliers, and internal AJISS organizations regarding training requirements and deliverables.
- Support the development of training-related Statements of Work, technical requirements, and deliverables.
- Participate in training working groups, design reviews, integrated product teams, and customer engagements related to AJISS training solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

- Post-secondary education in Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

- Prior experience developing and maintaining courseware, training materials, and learner assessments.

- Demonstrated experience collaborating with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to analyze requirements and develop training solutions.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in instructional systems design, curriculum development, training systems development, and/or technical training development.

- Experience applying Canadian Forces Individual Training and Education System (CFITES) principles and methodologies.

- Experience conducting Training Needs Analyses (TNA) and developing performance-based training solutions.

- Experience supporting Royal Canadian Navy (RCN), Department of National Defence (DND), or other defence programs.

- Experience working within configuration-controlled environments and incorporating engineering changes into training products.

- Familiarity with Qualifications Standards and Plans (QSPs), Training Plans, and military training documentation.

- Experience coordinating with OEMs, suppliers, and subcontractors in the development of technical training materials.

- Instructor qualification or adult education certification.

If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Special Position Requirements

Schedule: 40 hours per week

Physical Environment: Hybrid position – which is a mix of working from home and onsite (in office, at customer site or on board ships alongside in harbour)

Travel: Occasional domestic travel maybe required in support of the ships

The reference Total Target Compensation (TTC) market range for this position, inclusive of annual base salary and the variable compensation target, is between Total Target Cash (TTC) $90,000- $105,000 CAD Annual.

This reflects how companies in a similar industry and geographic region generally pay for similar jobs. This range helps the Company make pay decisions as one data point among many. Where a position falls within this range is also dependent on other factors including – but not limited to – the employee’s career path history, competencies, skills and performance, as well as the company’s annual salary budget, the customer’s program requirements, and the company’s internal equity. title: Técnico/a de mantenimiento
description:
Location: Barcelona, Spain

More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

- Los estándares de calidad establecidos bajo las más estrictas normativas llevando a cabo el mantenimiento predictivo, preventivo y correctivo de todos los equipos de Producción.
- Redactar instrucciones de funcionamiento de los equipos instalados para el equipo de Producción.
- Redactar la instrucción de mantenimiento preventivo para el equipo de Producción, según las indicaciones del fabricante del equipo y/o experiencia en equipos.
- Redactar la instrucción de mantenimiento preventivo para el equipo de Mantenimiento, según los criterios del fabricante y/o experiencia en equipos.

- Instalación y puesta en marcha de los equipos de producción.
- Implantación de soluciones y/o mejoras corporativas en los equipos de Producción.
- Mantener actualizadas las versiones de software de los equipos de Producción.
- Mejora de máquinas para aumentar la productividad o la seguridad.
- El correcto estado de orden y limpieza de los elementos, herramientas, componentes y áreas destinadas al mantenimiento repartidas por las diferentes áreas de trabajo.
- El funcionamiento de las instalaciones del edificio, haciendo el primer nivel de mantenimiento o contactar con la empresa mantenedora para solucionar la incidencia.

- Capacidad de análisis y de interpretar cualquier tipo de información sobre maquinaria industrial.
- Persona analítica, resolutiva, organizada y metódica.
- Experiencia mínima de 3 años en mantenimiento
